title: AI Native Creative Director - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Director (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

**This isn’t another content job.** Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX**
-------------------------------------------

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

**1. Read the signals.** Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.

**2. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

**3. Generate in our voice.** Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.

**4. Ship.** Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy**

* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.

### **2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery**

* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

### **3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents**

* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
* At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Fuel the Growth Engine**

* Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
* The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
* At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.

### **5. Go global, and keep the soul**

* We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
* And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
* Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
* Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
* AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**Traits :**

* Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
* Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
* A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
* Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

-> 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

-> Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**
------------------

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

A 6 to 8 minutes application survey, with links to content you made and something you built with AI

A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s content team

A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the creative vision and the next milestones to build

Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

Welcome aboard!

**About our hiring process**

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

If you’re not joining to post content.

If you’re here to build a media that changes how millions of people grow.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

title: Creative Strategist Ads - Chile
description:
**Creative Strategist – Chile**
===============================

**Sobre Natulim**
-----------------

Natulim es una marca de productos de limpieza ecológicos que está experimentando un fuerte crecimiento internacional. Nuestra ambición es convertirnos en **la marca de referencia en Europa en el sector de la limpieza ecológica**, construyendo una marca DTC sólida, innovadora y cercana a sus consumidores.

Nuestro producto estrella son las **láminas de detergente biodegradables**, una alternativa más sencilla y sostenible a los detergentes tradicionales.

Actualmente operamos en distintos mercados internacionales y nuestro crecimiento se basa en una estrategia **DTC, data-driven y altamente orientada a resultados**, que combina Shopify, adquisición de clientes, contenido, CRM y una cultura de experimentación constante.

Somos un equipo joven, internacional y **remote-first**, donde cada persona tiene un alto nivel de autonomía, responsabilidad e impacto en el negocio.

Actualmente buscamos impulsar nuestro crecimiento en **Chile**, y para ello queremos incorporar a un/a **Creative Strategist** que conozca profundamente el mercado chileno y sea capaz de liderar nuestra estrategia creativa y contribuir al desarrollo del negocio en el país.

**El puesto**
-------------

Buscamos una persona **muy creativa, orientada a resultados y con una fuerte visión de negocio** para impulsar el crecimiento de Natulim en el mercado chileno.

El principal motor de crecimiento será la **creación, testeo y optimización de nuestras campañas publicitarias**. Por eso, necesitamos a alguien capaz de transformar insights de consumidores en ángulos creativos, conceptos publicitarios y contenidos que generen ventas.

Combinarás **creatividad y análisis de datos**: entender qué funciona, identificar por qué, desarrollar nuevas hipótesis y mejorar continuamente nuestro sistema creativo.

No buscamos simplemente a alguien que gestione un ecommerce, sino a una persona que sea capaz de **entender al consumidor chileno, identificar nuevos ángulos de comunicación y transformar la creatividad en crecimiento de negocio**.

**Tus responsabilidades**
-------------------------

### **1. Creative Strategy & Performance Ads**

* Analizar periódicamente el rendimiento de las campañas y creatividades para identificar los **ángulos, hooks, formatos y mensajes** que generan mejores resultados.
* Detectar nuevas oportunidades creativas a partir de datos, insights de consumidores, tendencias, competencia y cultura chilena.
* Desarrollar nuevas hipótesis creativas y proponer conceptos publicitarios adaptados al mercado local.
* Elaborar briefs creativos y colaborar con los equipos internos, creadores de contenido y partners para producir nuevas piezas publicitarias.
* Diseñar y testear diferentes ángulos, hooks, formatos, mensajes y propuestas de valor.
* Identificar qué elementos hacen que una creatividad funcione y transformar los aprendizajes en nuevas iteraciones.
* Construir progresivamente un **sistema creativo escalable**, capaz de generar nuevas ideas y creatividades de forma continua.
* Mantenerse al día sobre marcas DTC, tendencias en redes sociales y nuevas estrategias creativas en el mercado chileno.
* Trabajar estrechamente con el equipo de Paid Media para convertir los insights creativos en crecimiento y adquisición rentable.

### **2. Growth & Performance**

* Hacer seguimiento de los principales KPI de adquisición y rendimiento: **CAC, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, AOV, LTV**, etc.
* Comprender la relación entre el rendimiento de las creatividades, la adquisición de clientes y la conversión del ecommerce.
* Identificar puntos de fricción en el funnel y proponer acciones para mejorar el rendimiento global.
* Priorizar iniciativas en función de su impacto potencial en el negocio.
* Analizar los resultados del mercado chileno y transformar los datos en recomendaciones concretas.
* Testear, aprender, iterar y escalar las iniciativas que mejor funcionen.

### **3. E-commerce & CRO**

* Gestionar y optimizar la experiencia de compra en Shopify para el mercado chileno.
* Identificar oportunidades de mejora del **tasa de conversión, ticket promedio (AOV) y facturación**.
* Gestionar y optimizar productos, colecciones, promociones, packs, fichas de producto y landing pages.
* Proponer y coordinar experimentos y tests A/B.
* Identificar fricciones en el proceso de compra y colaborar con los equipos correspondientes para resolverlas.
* Garantizar una excelente experiencia de usuario, especialmente en dispositivos móviles.
* Contribuir a adaptar la experiencia de compra a las particularidades del consumidor chileno.

### **4. CRM & Retention**

* Coordinar campañas y automatizaciones de CRM a través de **Klaviyo**.
* Garantizar la coherencia entre las campañas de adquisición y el recorrido del cliente.
* Identificar oportunidades para mejorar la **retención, reactivación y LTV**.
* Colaborar con los equipos correspondientes para maximizar el valor generado por cada cliente.

### **5. Desarrollo del mercado chileno**

* Comprender en profundidad al **consumidor chileno**, sus necesidades, objeciones, hábitos de compra y comportamiento digital.
* Adaptar los mensajes, creatividades y propuestas de valor a la cultura y particularidades del mercado local.
* Identificar tendencias de consumo, oportunidades de crecimiento y referencias competitivas en Chile.
* Analizar cómo comunican y venden otras marcas del sector en el mercado chileno.
* Contribuir a posicionar Natulim como una marca reconocida y competitiva en Chile.
* Trabajar de forma autónoma, con ownership sobre el mercado, colaborando estrechamente con el equipo central ubicado en España.

**Perfil que buscamos**
-----------------------

* Experiencia en **ecommerce DTC, Growth, Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing o en posiciones similares**.
* **Ser chileno/a nativo/a y tener español nativo**, con un conocimiento profundo de la cultura, expresiones, hábitos de consumo y particularidades del mercado chileno.
* Residencia en Chile o conocimiento directo y actualizado del mercado local.
* Alta sensibilidad creativa y capacidad para generar ideas, ángulos y conceptos publicitarios.
* Experiencia en la creación, testeo u optimización de anuncios digitales.
* Conocimiento sólido de **Meta Ads** y de los principales canales de Performance Marketing.
* Capacidad analítica para interpretar resultados y transformar datos en insights creativos y de negocio.
* Comprensión de los principales KPI: **CAC, ROAS, CTR, CVR, AOV, LTV**, etc.
* Experiencia trabajando con Shopify u otras plataformas de ecommerce.
* Conocimientos de CRO, UX y optimización del funnel de conversión.
* Conocimientos de CRM y, preferiblemente, experiencia con Klaviyo.
* Capacidad para trabajar de forma hands-on, autónoma y con un alto nivel de ownership.
* Mentalidad emprendedora y capacidad para desenvolverse en un entorno dinámico y en constante evolución.
* **Inglés profesional**, para poder comunicarse y colaborar con el equipo internacional.

**¿Qué marcará la diferencia?**
-------------------------------

* Una auténtica **obsesión por la creatividad y las ideas que venden**.
* Experiencia en entornos DTC, startups o marcas de alto crecimiento.
* Experiencia desarrollando contenidos UGC, anuncios para redes sociales o sistemas de creative testing.
* Conocimiento de las tendencias digitales, creadores de contenido y códigos culturales del mercado chileno.
* Capacidad para pasar rápidamente de la **idea al concepto al test al aprendizaje a la iteración**.
* Mentalidad analítica sin perder la creatividad.
* Experiencia participando en el lanzamiento, posicionamiento o crecimiento de una marca en Chile.
* Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de mercado y convertirlas en iniciativas concretas de crecimiento.

title: Senior Art Director
description:
Established in 2004, **OLIVER** is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of **The Brandtech Group**, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our **AI solutions** enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

### 

### **SENIOR ART DIRECTOR**

**LOCATION:** Barcelona, Spain

**REPORTING TO:** Creative Director

  

### **A LITTLE BIT ABOUT THE ROLE AND TEAM**

Working in direct partnership with a leading European pet care client (part of a major international food group), the Senior Art Director will lead the visual craft, conceptual design, and art direction for four iconic pet care brands.

Embedded within our dedicated on-site agency hub in Barcelona, you will partner closely with a Senior Copywriter to form a powerhouse conceptual creative duo. Working directly with the client's Global Brand Teams, your focus will be upstream and platform-defining: translating global strategy into arresting visual ideas, distinct brand identities, hero campaign assets, and comprehensive global master toolkits designed for worldwide impact.

This role is built for a visually ambitious, craft-obsessed Art Director who thrives on conceptual storytelling, setting high aesthetic standards, and creating campaigns that celebrate the bond between pets and pet parents globally.

### 

### **WHAT IS REQUIRED**

* **Conceptual campaign ideation:** Partner with the Senior Copywriter to ideate, craft, and pitch big, multi-channel campaign platforms and visual territories for global briefs.
* **Global master toolkits & guidelines:** Architect and design comprehensive visual master toolkits, campaign playbooks, photography and motion style guides, and design systems for global rollouts.
* **Visual craft & execution:** Direct and craft high-end visual executions across the full campaign ecosystem, including brand films, digital and social activations, key visuals, print, packaging touchpoints, and retail/POS.
* **Art direction & shoot leadership:** Provide visual direction on film and photography shoots, collaborating with production partners, directors, photographers, and retouchers to bring creative concepts to life.
* **AI proficiency:** Comfort producing static images and videos with the help of different AI platforms is expected.
* **Client pitching & influence:** Present visual concepts, design rationale, and art direction territories directly to the client's Global Brand Directors and marketing leads with clarity and conviction.
* **Brand guardianship:** Ensure visual consistency, premium craft, and distinct identity separation across each of the four unique pet food brands.
* **Studio mentorship:** Collaborate with and mentor designers, artworkers, and junior creatives, elevating the overall design and art direction benchmark across the studio.

### **WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE**

* **Experience:** 6+ years of art direction and conceptual design experience within top-tier advertising agencies, design studios, or dedicated creative setups.
* **Portfolio:** An outstanding portfolio showcasing big-idea conceptual thinking, integrated global campaigns, impeccable typography, and modern digital and visual craft.
* **Sector background:** Experience working on FMCG, CPG, Pet Care, or lifestyle brands is highly desirable. Experience developing distinct visual worlds for multiple brands within a single portfolio is a strong plus.
* **Global campaign scope:** Demonstrated experience building global master toolkits, key visuals, and multi-market design systems (beyond local production and adaptation).
* **Technical mastery:** Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma. Experience with motion graphics and video editing tools (After Effects, Premiere Pro) or 3D/AI creative tools is a distinct advantage.
* **Collaborative chemistry:** Proven success working collaboratively in an Art Director / Copywriter team setup, with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
* **Languages:** Professional working fluency in Spanish and English is essential, as these are the working languages for both local and global briefs, and for the day-to-day relationship with the client team in Barcelona.

  

*At the time of this posting, this position has a starting salary from €47,000 gross annually. Individual compensation will be determined using objective, job-related criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, work location, and the scope of responsibilities.*

description:

------------

description:
**About the Company**
---------------------

We are a fast-growing international consumer goods brand focused on developing innovative and sustainable cleaning products. Our ambition is to make sustainable cleaning more accessible to consumers through convenient, effective and environmentally conscious alternatives to traditional household products.

We operate across several European markets, combining a direct-to-consumer (DTC) business model with a data-driven and highly performance-oriented approach. Our growth is driven by creative production, paid acquisition, e-commerce and a culture of continuous experimentation.

We are a young, international and **remote-first** team, where everyone has a high level of autonomy and ownership. We are now looking to accelerate our growth in **Italy**, a strategic market for our business.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for a **highly creative, performance-driven and consumer-oriented person** to become the creative engine behind our growth in the Italian market.

**Creativity is at the heart of this role.** We are looking for someone who can deeply understand the Italian consumer, identify compelling communication angles and turn insights into **advertising concepts, hooks and creatives that capture attention and drive sales**.

Your main responsibility will be to develop, test and continuously improve advertising creatives, identifying new ways to communicate our value proposition and stand out in the market. You will combine creative thinking with performance analysis, using data to understand what works, generate new ideas and improve the effectiveness of our campaigns.

We are not simply looking for someone who can manage an e-commerce business or analyze marketing data. **We are looking for a creative thinker who knows how to turn ideas into advertising that sells.**

Experience in areas such as e-commerce, CRO, CRM or broader Growth is a plus, but **your creative mindset, ability to generate strong advertising concepts and understanding of performance-driven creative strategy are what matter most**.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **Creative Strategy & Performance Ads**

* Develop creative concepts and advertising angles tailored to the **Italian market and consumer**.
* Identify new ways to communicate the company's value proposition, product benefits and competitive advantages.
* Generate compelling **hooks, messages, storytelling concepts and creative formats** that capture attention and drive conversions.
* Research Italian consumer behaviour, cultural insights, social media trends, competitors and successful advertising approaches to inspire new creatives.
* Develop creative hypotheses and translate them into actionable concepts for paid advertising.
* Create clear and effective **creative briefs** for internal teams, content creators, UGC creators and external partners.
* Explore different creative approaches, including UGC, testimonials, product demonstrations, problem-solution concepts, educational content and other performance-driven formats.
* Collaborate with the Creative and Paid Media teams to produce, launch and test new advertising creatives.
* Analyze creative performance to understand which hooks, angles, messages and formats work best, using these insights to generate new ideas and improve existing concepts.
* Continuously iterate on successful creatives, finding new variations and opportunities to scale their performance.
* Build a **repeatable and scalable creative testing system** that consistently generates fresh ideas and advertising assets for the Italian market.
* Ensure that advertising feels authentic and relevant to Italian consumers, rather than simply translating campaigns from other countries.

### **Creative Performance & Growth**

* Monitor creative and campaign performance to understand which concepts generate the strongest results.
* Use relevant KPIs such as **CTR, CPA, CAC, ROAS and CVR** to evaluate creative effectiveness and inform new hypotheses.
* Identify the relationship between creative messaging, audience response and conversion performance.
* Work closely with the Paid Media team to understand campaign results and turn performance insights into new creative opportunities.
* Prioritize creative initiatives based on their potential impact on acquisition and business growth.
* Test, learn, iterate and continuously improve the creative strategy based on results.

### **E-commerce, CRO & CRM**

Although creativity is the main focus of the role, experience in other areas of digital growth would be a valuable advantage.

* Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate across the Italian e-commerce experience.
* Contribute ideas to optimize product pages, landing pages, promotions, bundles and value propositions.
* Understand how creative messaging connects with the website experience and influences conversion.
* Contribute to CRO initiatives and A/B testing by identifying opportunities to improve the customer journey.
* Support the alignment of advertising creatives with CRM campaigns and customer communications.
* Experience with **Shopify, Klaviyo, CRO, UX or retention marketing** is a plus.

### **Italian Market Insights**

* Develop a strong understanding of the **Italian consumer**, including their needs, motivations, objections, purchasing habits and perceptions of sustainable household products.
* Identify local insights, cultural nuances and consumer pain points that can inspire effective advertising concepts.
* Research Italian competitors, DTC brands, social media trends and relevant creative approaches.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate the brand and strengthen its positioning in the Italian market.
* Bring new ideas and creative perspectives to the wider team, helping adapt the company's communication to local consumer expectations.

**About You**
-------------

* **Native Italian speaker** with professional English proficiency.
* A strong creative mindset and the ability to generate original, compelling and commercially relevant ideas.
* A genuine interest in advertising, consumer psychology, storytelling and understanding what makes people pay attention and buy.
* Ability to turn consumer insights into **creative angles, hooks, concepts and advertising messages**.
* Understanding of social media content and digital advertising formats, particularly Meta Ads.
* Ability to think beyond standard advertising approaches and propose fresh ways to communicate a product's value.
* Understanding of performance-driven creative principles, including testing different concepts, analyzing results and iterating based on learnings.
* Ability to combine creativity with analytical thinking and use data to improve creative decisions.
* A proactive, hands-on and autonomous approach to work.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international environment.
* **Experience in Creative Strategy, content creation, digital advertising, performance marketing or a related creative role is desirable.** We are open to different professional backgrounds as long as you can demonstrate strong creative thinking and potential.

Experience with Shopify, e-commerce management, CRO, CRM or Klaviyo is a plus.

**What Will Make You Stand Out**
--------------------------------

* A genuine **obsession with creative ideas that sell**.

* Experience developing creative testing frameworks or iterating on ads based on performance data.

title: AI Native Creative Strategist - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Strategist (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

**This isn’t another content job.** Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX**
-------------------------------------------

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

**1. Read the signals.** Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.

**2. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

**3. Generate in our voice.** Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.

**4. Ship.** Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy**

* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.

### **2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery**

* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

### **3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents**

* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
* At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Fuel the Growth Engine**

* Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
* The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
* At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.

### **5. Go global, and keep the soul**

* We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
* And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
* Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
* Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
* AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**Traits :**

* Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
* Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
* A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
* Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

-> 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

-> Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**
------------------

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

A 6 to 8 minutes application survey, with links to content you made and something you built with AI

A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s content team

A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the creative vision and the next milestones to build

Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

Welcome aboard!

**About our hiring process**

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

If you’re not joining to post content.

If you’re here to build a media that changes how millions of people grow.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.

With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.

We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.

This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.

Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.
  
  
Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.
  
  
**What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖**
Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.
  
  
**Our Creative Machine Has To Be Able To**

* Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.
* Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.
* Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.
* Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.
* Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.
* Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.
  
  
**OUR MISSION**
At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.
  
  
Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.
  
  
People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.
  
  
That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.
  
  
**We Do That By Merging**

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.
  
  
**Short history**
Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION 🚀**
You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.
  
  
Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.
  
  
In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.
  
  
**🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**

* Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy
* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* ❌ The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.
* Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery
* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* ❌ The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.
* Build the Content Factory: humans and agents
* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* ❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.
* Fuel the Growth Engine
* Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
* ❌ The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.

* And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:**
you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.
  
  
**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍**
**Experience**

* Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
* Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
* Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
* AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**Traits :**

* Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
* Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.

* No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

**WHY JOIN US ❤️**

title: Creative Director
description:
**Creative Director**

**One5 Creative** · Full-time · Remote

**NOTE:** We will not email you from any other web address than www.One5Creative.com. Please beware of scammers.

**Location:** Fully remote within the U.S. You'll work Eastern or Central time hours, with occasional travel to Cleveland for team time.  
**Salary:** $100,000–$120,000, depending on experience

**WE ARE**

A small, nimble creative agency out of Cleveland that makes a *lot* of content. Our primary focus right now is national QSR and CPG brands, and we take on other brands as they come our way. We run the full content engine, from commercials to paid and organic social, email, in-store and brand activations, plus the photo and video shoots that feed all of it. We like big ideas, tight systems and food that looks so good you can taste it through the screen. 2027 is a growth year, and we're looking for a Creative Director who still loves getting their hands dirty.

**This is a design-led role.** We're looking for a Creative Director who came up through the art director path and still designs.

**WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE**

* You'll shape the look of a national brand. Your work shows up on screens, in social feeds, in inboxes, in restaurants and on store shelves across the country
* Variety is built in. QSR and CPG brands are our main focus today, and you'll also lead the creative for new brands as they come through our doors
* You'll build the team, not inherit it. We're hiring our 2027 creative crew now, and you'll help shape who joins and how we work
* You'll make the work, not just review it. This is a player-coach role for someone who still wants to be in the files
* We use AI to clear out the busywork so we can spend more time on ideas and craft

**YOU ARE**

* **An art director at heart.** You came up through the art director path, and your eye for layout, type, color and food photography is still your superpower
* **A player-coach.** You're happiest designing the hero work yourself while lifting the people around you
* **A true collaborator.** You love building ideas with others. You're secure enough in your craft to share the whiteboard and let the best idea win, wherever it came from
* **A clear, concise communicator.** Your feedback is specific and kind, and your presentations make the idea obvious
* **A systems thinker.** You build visual systems and templates that scale across hundreds of assets without losing the craft
* **Fast and steady.** Tight turnarounds, multiple campaigns and a surprise ask in the same week? You keep the quality high and the team calm
* **At home on a small team.** We're a tight crew, so everyone pitches in. You'll concept a campaign in the morning and resize a story frame in the afternoon. No task is "not my job"
* **AI-fluent.** You use AI tools in your creative process and have a point of view on where they help and where they don't

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Make the work**

* Lead the design on our biggest campaigns, from concept to final files
* Art direct commercials, paid and organic social, email, in-store and brand activations
* Own each brand's look and keep it consistent as the volume scales
* Build visual systems and templates that let the team move fast without breaking the brand
* Set the visual direction for photo and video shoots (mood, shot lists and styling), then shape the final look in selects and the edit

**Build and lead the team**

* Direct our editors, designers and freelance partners day to day, and raise the bar at every review
* Help hire, onboard and mentor the creative team as we grow in 2027
* Partner with our incoming Senior Creative Strategist, who will lead copy and messaging, and our Project Manager / Producer, who will keep the work on time and on scope

**Concept with the cofounders**

* Concepting is a true collaboration with our hands-on cofounders, from the first sketch
* Present work alongside our cofounders, who lead strategy and the client relationship and give final creative approval

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 8–10+ years in creative roles, with a strong art director background (agency or in-house creative team)
* 2+ years leading or mentoring designers or creative teams
* A portfolio that shows range across commercials, paid and organic social, email and brand activations, from big-idea campaigns to high-volume content
* Deep skill in Adobe Creative Suite and/or Figma, and experience setting the visual direction for photo and video
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in your creative workflow – without it feeling like slop.
* Able to work Eastern or Central time hours, and travel to Cleveland occasionally for team time

**BONUS POINTS**

* QSR, restaurant or CPG brand experience, especially food photography and styling
* Franchise brand experience (local store marketing, regional versioning, in-store and point-of-sale)
* Motion Design layout experience
* Experience building brand systems or design systems that scale across many assets

**TO APPLY**

Send your resume, a link to your portfolio, and a short note that answers four questions:

* Show us a campaign you led from concept to final. What was your role, and what did you personally design?
* Tell us about a visual system or template you built that helped a team produce more without losing quality.
* How do you give feedback that makes a designer's work better? Walk us through a recent example.
* How do you use AI in your creative work today? Roughly what percentage of your workflow involves AI, and which tasks or tools?

Pay: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

title: Creative Director
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Creative Director is a strategic, commercially minded leader who leads Magenta’s creative organization across branded and private label home categories. This role is responsible for establishing the creative vision, developing and maintaining high-performing design teams, and translating consumer and trend insights into commercially successful products for mass retail customers.

The ideal candidate is not only an exceptional creative thinker, but also a proven people leader who has successfully lead teams, created scalable processes, and driven accountability across a design organization.

The Creative Director oversees Design Managers and Designers while partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product Development, Sourcing, Marketing, and Retail partners to bring compelling seasonal and everyday collections to market.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Creative Vision & Strategy

* Establish a clear creative vision across all brands, categories, and retail channels.
* Translate macro consumer, lifestyle, and trend insights into actionable product strategies.
* Connect trend forecasting to retailer needs, customer behavior, assortment opportunities, and business objectives.
* Define seasonal creative direction, color strategy, materials, forms, finishes, and key visual storytelling elements.
* Ensure all creative output reflects both brand positioning and commercial viability.

Team Leadership & Development

* Lead, coach, and develop Design Managers. Coach Design Managers to ensure they lead high performing teams of Designers.
* Set clear expectations, accountability, and performance standards.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct talent reviews, succession planning, hiring, and professional development planning.
* Mentor emerging creative leaders and build organizational capability.

Creative Excellence & Accountability

* Establish creative standards and ensure design excellence across all categories.
* Lead creative reviews and provide actionable feedback that elevates work.
* Create clear ownership structures and decision-making accountability.
* Ensure teams move efficiently from concept through execution.
* Balance creative innovation with speed, business objectives, and operational realities.

Trend-to-Product Translation

* Own the organization’s trend forecasting process.
* Establish repeatable frameworks for trend research, competitive shopping, consumer insights, inspiration gathering, and product translation.
* Guide teams in converting trends into product concepts, assortments, graphic assets, packaging, and brand storytelling.

Scalable Processes & Systems

* Develop and implement SOPs, templates, and creative operating mechanisms that increase efficiency and consistency.
* Improve frameworks for Creative Alignment Briefs, trend reporting, color direction, design reviews, product ideation, and sample reviews.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and eliminate administrative inefficiencies.

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Serve as the primary creative partner to Sales, Product Development, Sourcing, and Executive Leadership.
* Present creative direction to retailers and key stakeholders.
* Participate in customer meetings and strategic planning discussions.
* Build strong relationships internally and externally to drive alignment and influence outcomes.

Product & Category Leadership

* Lead creative direction across categories including Tabletop, Seasonal, Home Décor, Frames, Wall Décor, Garden, Pet, Gift, and Kitchen & Entertaining.
* Partner with overseas development teams to ensure design intent, quality, cost targets, and manufacturing feasibility are maintained throughout development.

**KEY QUALIFICATIONS**

Education

* Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, Graphic Design, Illustration, Fine Arts, or related field.

Leadership Experience

* 8–15+ years of experience in Product Design, Creative Direction, Brand Design, or Product Development.
* Minimum 5+ years leading creative teams.
* Experience managing Design Managers, Senior Designers, or multidisciplinary creative teams.
* Proven track record in hiring, coaching, and developing talent.

Retail & Product Experience

* Strong experience supporting mass retail customers such as TJX, Target, Walmart, Kohl’s, Burlington, Ross, Michaels, HomeGoods, or similar channels.
* Experience developing products in home, seasonal, gift, tabletop, décor, or adjacent categories.
* Demonstrated success translating trends into commercially successful product collections.

Manufacturing & Development

* Experience partnering with overseas factories and development teams.
* Strong understanding of product development cycles, sampling processes, cost engineering, manufacturing constraints, and material and finishing capabilities.
* Experience working with China, Vietnam, India, or other global sourcing regions preferred.

Pay: $135,000.00 - $175,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Product Design/Development or Creative Direction: 8 years (Preferred)
* People Leadership: 5 years (Required)

Location:

* United States (Required)

Work Location: Remote

### **What you’ll get:**

You'll do well here if you can spot the gap between good and great, close it with clear feedback, and still ship on the committed date. You use AI to get more out of a small team, and you hold every asset to the same standard whether an employee, a freelancer, or an agency made it.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**The creative standard**

* Write and publish a quality standard with real examples for each surface, including web, email, video, social, and events, within your first 90 days.
* Review work and give specific feedback that raises it in a single round of revisions.
* By day 90, the CEO and SVP, Brand review your team's output and agree that 90% of randomly selected pieces meet the bar.

**A brand system that morphs**

* Own a brand system that flexes to the standards of each channel and context, so what good looks like differs by surface while the brand remains unmistakably one brand.
* Bring every surface up to the new standard by month 6, from website and product imagery to newsletters, YouTube, and our offices.

**The team**

* Lead, coach, and grow a small design team of fewer than five direct reports.
* Decide where in-house talent, freelancers, and outside firms each fit, and hold all of them to the same bar.

**Predictable, well-run delivery**

* Run design intake and delivery so requesters always know what is coming and when. By month 6, at least 90% of requests ship by the committed date.
* Get at least 85% of assets approved within one round of revisions, and end day-before creative notes on delivered work.
* Keep the team aligned to business priorities, and flag requests that are not aligned early and often.

**How You'll Work**
-------------------

You'll work closely with Brand, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Product. You'll take feedback from senior leadership and partner teams, and you'll give it back just as directly. Politics have no place here, and the best work wins the argument.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Experience**

* 8+ years in design, with experience leading design teams.
* A portfolio of luxury or premium brand work that spans web, brand, and motion.

**Leadership and mindset**

* Exacting taste and the judgment to tell great work from good work.
* The ability to define a quality bar, explain it, and coach others to it.
* Full ownership of the output of the entire design function, including vendors and freelancers.
* Comfort influencing senior stakeholders, including the CEO.

* Command of brand systems across web, email, video, social, and events.
* Strong process and operational habits for intake, prioritization, and review.

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States, with a **preference for New York, Los Angeles, or Austin.**

**Primary Focus:**

As Director, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You'll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.
* Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.
* Translate business objectives and player insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative agency, including scripts, hook variations and iteration briefs on winning concepts.
* Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.
* Drive a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, continuously improving hit rate and speed to learning.
* Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.
* Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Casino players.
* Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs
* Embed performance requirements into brand and full-funnel campaign briefs from the outset (in collaboration with integrated marketing and media), ensuring channel, audience, format and measurement needs are clear before creative development begins. Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.
* Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.
* Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.
* Lead performance strategy/creative insight sessions and contribute a strong POV to creative brainstorms, working closely with the Casino Creative Studio.
* Present performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews, turning results into a clear story for senior leadership.
* Lead, mentor and develop an Associate, building their craft in briefing, analysis and testing.

**How This Role Connects Across the Team:**

* Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.
* Partners with the Casino Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.
* Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.
* Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.
* Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.
* Partner with the affiliates teams to produce UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice, adapting content that's optimised for performance (via creative briefs)

**Skills & Qualifications:**

Sequencing.com turns clinical-grade whole genome sequencing into a lifelong source of personalized health insights, from everyday wellness questions to serious health decisions. We're rebuilding how that story looks, sounds, and performs, and we need an Associate Creative Director to lead it.

You'll define the new brand and make it earn its keep in paid channels. description:
GE Vernova is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior (Sr.) Engineer – Product Security Response to join the Wind Product Security team. This role leads the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) function for the Wind portfolio of products. It is responsible for coordinated vulnerability disclosure, vulnerability triage and remediation coordination, and product-related cyber security incident response across wind turbines, SCADA systems, Wind Farm software, and digital service platforms.
  
  
Wind farms are critical energy infrastructure, and adversaries are evolving quickly, including through AI-enabled tooling and attacks targeting operational technology (OT) environments. This role is the front line for coordinating the response in the underlying systems in a wind generation facility that GE Vernova’s customers rely on to generate and deliver power. It ensures vulnerabilities in Wind’s products are handled quickly, transparently, and in line with industry standards and regulatory timelines.
  
  
This position reports to Wind's Product Security Leader, who oversees Wind's Product Security Team. The PSIRT Leader works in close partnership with GE Vernova's enterprise PSIRT, CNA (CVE Numbering Authority) program, and CERT functions to keep Wind's cyber response operations aligned with company-wide processes.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor role with high visibility to business and executive leadership, and direct engagement with customers, suppliers, and industry partners as well as possibly government agencies and regulators as required.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Lead Wind security response operations end to end:** Own intake, triage, tracking, remediation coordination, and public disclosure of vulnerabilities affecting Wind products, following GE Vernova's PSIRT standard and Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) procedure.
* **Manage coordinated vulnerability disclosure (CVD):** Work with external researchers, customers, vendors, and government bodies, and manage the full lifecycle of vulnerability reports from receipt through closure and disclosure.
* **Support the CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) program for Wind:** Work with the GE Vernova’s enterprise CAN team to ensure timely, accurate CVE records and security advisories for Wind related products.
* **Drive regulatory reporting readiness:** Support compliance with mandatory notification timelines, including EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) reporting to ENISA and national CSIRTs, and with other applicable regional and customer requirements.
* **Lead product-related incident response:** Direct the response to cyber security incidents involving Wind products at customer sites, coordinating with engineering, services, legal, GE Vernova CERT, commercial, and customer teams. Maintain and exercise incident response playbooks specific to wind turbines, wind farm SCADA, and digital service platforms.
* **Assess third-party and component vulnerabilities:** Evaluate the impact of vulnerabilities in third-party and open-source components (e.g., operating systems, hypervisors, network and firewall software, and firmware) on Wind products, using SBOM and product configuration data. Provide prioritized remediation guidance.
* **Coordinate remediation across Wind subsystems:** Work with product development, engineering, projects, services, and R&D teams to define fixes, mitigations, compensating controls, and customer guidance. Work with the Wind patch validation effort so patches are validated against fielded SCADA and controller configurations.
* **Apply risk-based prioritization:** Use CVE, CVSS, CWE, exploit intelligence, and the Wind product context (exposure, deployment architecture, impact to operations and safety) to drive consistent severity and remediation decisions.
* **Deploy AI-enabled tooling:** Lead the adoption of AI-powered and automated tools for vulnerability scoring, triage, threat intelligence, and situational awareness, to scale PSIRT capacity as threat volume grows.
* **Engage with external stakeholders:** Represent Wind with customers, government agencies, law enforcement, regulators, and industry information sharing groups (e.g., E-ISAC). Support sensitive communications during active incidents.
* **Support customer communications:** Provide technical guidance in response to customer security inquiries, and review security advisories and customer-facing documentation for accuracy and clarity.

Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – 8.1M members in Prime
