title: AI Native Right Hand of the CEO - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact.

If you dream of a life that is more like an adventure than a stable life, then becoming **the AI-native right hand of our CEO** is for you.

**This isn’t another chief of staff or right hand job.**

Most companies call themselves AI-first because they gave everyone a ChatGPT licence. We think that’s level 2, and there are 10.

At Paradox our ambition is $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents. Here, AI doesn’t assist the work. It runs the loops, in every department. Your job is to make that true for the whole company, side by side with the CEO.

**But wait a minute.**

**Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with…**

* **Freedom:** working remotely or hybrid, and being trusted to deliver
* **Ambition:** building one of the first truly AI-native companies, with teammates who push AI to its limits every week
* **Impact:** changing the trajectory of a whole company, not one line of a roadmap, with a product that transforms people’s lives at scale

Then, you have found the next adventure that will fulfill you.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE MEANS AT PARADOX**
-----------------------------------

In a company of fewer than 10 people, the right hand used to be the person who absorbed everything the CEO couldn’t do. Here, the right hand builds the machine that does it.

**Our company has to be able to:**

* **Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, offers, decisions, procedures, member stories and past experiments, in one shared company brain that every person and every agent reads before acting.
* **Turn every decision into execution.** A meeting, a voice note or a call with the CEO becomes briefs, tickets, follow-ups and deadlines, without anyone retyping it.
* **Act across every tool.** Not a chatbot in a tab: agents read and write in our whole stack, from code to CRM, billing, analytics, ads, email, calendar and documents.
* **Ship.** Produce the analysis, the contract draft, the page, the offer or the process, and put it live.
* **Measure with real KPIs.** Revenue, cash, margin, retention and the transformation of our members, not activity.
* **Learn and loop on its own.** Keep what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

People set the ambition, the taste and the standards. The machine runs the loop, and gets better every week.

**This is already real.** Our company brain holds our decisions and procedures. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment with its result. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars and audit our tracking after every live. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day, by text and by voice.

**But maybe YOU WONDER WHAT’S OUR STORY?**
------------------------------------------

**We believe self-help is broken.** Most people use learning platforms the same way: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

They deserve more than content and more than motivation.

They deserve **a system that knows them**, one that adapts, challenges and grows with them.

That’s why we merge:

* **Human Intelligence** (coaches, peers and mentors)
* **Structured Intelligence** (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* **Technological Intelligence** (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

into one seamless ecosystem: **Paradox OS, the Operating System for Human Greatness, augmented with AI.**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world, and for something that will outlive any individual, its founder included.

**Here’s the bet:** A small team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

And that’s where you come in.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

**Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will help him run and grow the company.**

Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches.

The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls. With fewer than 10 people, there is no department to hand things to. You build it.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1 - Be the CEO’s operating system**

* **The old way:** a chief of staff takes notes in meetings, chases people by email and builds the weekly report by hand.
* **At Paradox:** you build the agents that turn every CEO decision into execution. Meetings, voice notes and calls become briefs, tickets and follow-ups. Every Monday, the CEO gets one brief: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs his call.
* You decide what the CEO must see and what he never needs to see again. His time goes to vision, product and members, not to coordination.

### **2 - Run strategic projects as a Pirate Squad of one, plus agents**

Depending on your zone of genius, these are examples of strategic projects you could own:

* **Growth:** run experiments with agents that generate, ship and measure them
* **Partnerships & sponsorships:** find and close partners aligned with our brand, for our YouTube channel and events
* **International:** build the machine that turns our French content into English, and open new countries
* **Launches:** take a new offer or product from idea to live
* **People:** find and assess the rare people who join a team of fewer than 10

* **The old way:** each new initiative needs a team, a roadmap and three months.
* **At Paradox:** one person with the right agents launches an offer, a channel or a country without disrupting the core. That’s what our Pirate Squad means now.

### **3 - Build AI-native operations**

* **The old way:** an ops manager processes invoices, chases contracts, onboards people and answers the same support questions every week.
* **At Paradox:** finance, legal, HR, admin and customer support each get their agents, their context, their KPIs and their loop. You write the skills, plug them into our tools and write the evals that define "good": a reconciliation that matches to the cent, a contract that respects our playbook, an answer a member is happy with.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. An agent moves up a level only when its track record earns it.
* **Example:** in your first month, you build the agent that reconciles payments, refunds and failed charges every night. In month one it only reports. By month three it fixes the simple cases alone, and you only see the exceptions.

### **4 - Strategy and business intelligence that check themselves**

* **The old way:** someone builds dashboards in a BI tool, exports them to a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody fully trusts the numbers.
* **At Paradox:** agents watch revenue, cash, acquisition, retention, churn and competitors continuously, find where our sources disagree, and explain what changed and why.
* **Strategy:** screen markets and competition, build growth models, explore business models, partnerships and acquisitions. Then challenge, formalize and ensure good execution of the strategy.
* At Paradox things move fast, and our CEO is always reading business books and meeting great entrepreneurs. You’ll turn the best strategies and tactics into systems and agents the whole company uses.

### **5 - Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul**

* **The old way:** lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* **At Paradox:** every decision, result and lesson goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before acting. The company never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: the share of work done without a human, the time from decision to execution, the agents that moved up an autonomy level this month, and revenue per person. You push those numbers up.
* You help the team become AI-native too: you spot the work still done by hand, and you build the agent or show a teammate how to build it.
* And always: our members trust us with their lives. No fake claims, no fake scarcity, data handled with care. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. People do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. The company’s output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.

**DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF?**
------------------------------

### **Experience**

* **Top tier Business or Engineering School** (HEC, ESSEC, INSEAD, EM Lyon, EDHEC, ESCP, Stanford, …) or other high-level academic training (Les Mines, X, Sciences Po Paris, etc.)
* **A wide-scope role behind you:** founder, chief of staff, founder’s associate, strategy, consulting or operations in a fast-growing startup
* **You’ve built with AI and agents yourself:** Claude Code, agent SDKs, MCP, automations, APIs, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

### **Traits**

* **Driven with strong work ethic:** this position requires a strong commitment and perseverance
* **Entrepreneurship spirit:** able to own a project from scratch, with few resources and little guidance, doing a lot yourself
* **Builder, not coordinator:** you’d rather build the agent than chase a person twice
* **Taste:** you know the difference between an output that works and one that is great, and you hold agents to the second
* **Growth over ego:** you are at ease with regular feedback, obsessed with learning and growing, able to put your ego aside
* **Analytical and system thinker:** you quickly identify and formulate problems, and solve complex ones with data
* **Excels in communication:** both written and verbal

### **Language**

French: native or bilingual. English: fluent, you can hold a detailed conversation with English-speaking colleagues. Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

* We are inspired by a culture of performance and ambition. Everything is fast-paced and there is a lot of change. You won’t always be told what to do or how to do it.
* We tell each other things, even if they are uncomfortable. We value growth over ego. At Paradox, expressing disagreement to a manager and knowing how to debate is valued! We encourage critical and strategic thinking.
* If you use AI for first drafts but your way of working looks the same as two years ago: wrong role.
* If you want to manage a lot of people: we aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each managing a dozen agents.
* If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If all this makes sense with you, then we’ll love working with you (and you with us, you’ll be pampered!)

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Build one of the first truly AI-native companies from inside the CEO’s office, and write the playbook others will copy. You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

A work with **Impact**, **Freedom** and **Ambition**

**Growth & Ambition**

* Being **surrounded by A-players who strive to perform**, whilst being in a good mood
* No more bosses, but ongoing conversations to support your growth
* ️Learning to build with AI faster than almost anywhere else

**Impact & Meaning**

* **Playing a crucial role in the development of a company** whose content and products are used by millions of people
* **Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference** is something! We receive messages every day from members who quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships and changed their lives.

**But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…**

**Freedom & Well Being**

* **A company culture based on autonomy & accountability**
* **Flexible working hours** (but very hard working)
* **A remote culture from day one** with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* **Standing desks** paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* **Work on Mac**
* **350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself** (for your gym, a dance class or whatever makes you feel great)
* **150€ of books or education**: at Paradox, we are learner lovers
* **Access to Athena**, our AI coach, supporting you on anything personal or professional

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

Any copy-pasted and non-personalized application goes directly to the trash can.

To complete the recruitment process, **each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this: do not apply**

### **Hiring process**

* **A 6 to 8 minute application survey**, with a short video and a link to something you built with AI
* **A 30-minute video call** with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions
* **A live build session:** you solve a real Paradox problem with AI in front of us. We look at how you prompt, push back on the output and iterate, more than at a polished result.
* **A 1h culture-fit video call**, to assess alignment with our values and mindset
* **A 1h final video call with David, CEO**, on the company’s next milestones and how you’d build them
* **Reference calls** with your previous managers
* **Welcome aboard!**

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

title: Head of search
description:
##### **Valsea - Where Innovation Meets Entertainment**

At Valsea, we’re shaping the future of entertainment with immersive, engaging experiences that captivate players worldwide. Based in sunny Marbella, Spain, our vibrant open-space office is home to an international team of developers, marketers, product owners, and much more.

Valsea operates a leading scalable technology platform, 100% owned by us. This gives us the freedom to deliver results fast. We integrate selected outside companies into our ecosystem to ensure we provide fresh and vibrant products for our customers.

We work in a fast-paced environment, creating new brands, maintaining and improving our tech stack, launching leading acquisition and retention campaigns, and developing fresh features. Our ethos is simple - be best-in-class in everything we do.

Despite our rapid growth, Valsea still has that exciting start-up feel. We embrace a hybrid working model to balance professional growth with personal well-being. With a dynamic work environment, attractive salary, and a culture that thrives on collaboration, our power is our people.

We provide company laptops and other things you may need to work comfortably. Remote workers are always invited to our annual company trip and other team events. Ready to be part of something exciting?

##### **What are we looking for now?**

We are looking for a Head of Search to own organic growth across our markets and make our casino and sportsbook the first choice of both search engines and AI assistants.

This is a senior role with a clear commercial focus, coming with a proven background in SEO and AI Search (GEO). Working in a small, focused team, you will set the strategy, win priority on the product roadmap and be measured on revenue performance, not just rankings. You will do it in a competitive, affiliate-heavy and tightly regulated search vertical.

##### **What you will be accountable for:**

* Incremental non-brand organic revenue in all our markets: growth in first-time depositors (FTDs) and net gaming revenue (NGR) from non-brand organic search.
* Organic share of total traffic and acquisition, protected and grown in a search landscape reshaped by AI Overviews and AI assistants, and less dependent on paid media and affiliates.
* Value per organic visitor: FTD conversion rate and NGR per organic session, bringing players who register, deposit and stay, not only sessions.

##### **What you will do:**

Strategy and leadership

* Define and deliver the SEO and AI search strategy, roadmap, forecast and budget for our markets.
* Lead, coach and grow the SEO team, and manage agencies and freelancers on outcomes.
* Collaborate with Acquisition, Retention, Casino and Sportsbook Product, and Marketing.
* Write business cases and requirements, and work with Product and Technology to deliver them in the roadmap.
* Run SEO experiments, measure incrementality and report results and forecasts to top management.

Technical SEO

* Own technical SEO direction for a very large, fast-changing sites: thousands of game pages, provider and category lobbies, live event and odds pages, promotions and help content.
* Set the direction for site architecture, category and filter pages, internal linking, crawl budget, indexation, JavaScript rendering, Core Web Vitals and international setup (hreflang, market and language variants, geo-restriction handling).
* Manage the SEO side of short-lived content: live and upcoming events, expiring promotions, removed games and market-specific restrictions.

AI search (GEO/AEO)

* Build our GEO/AEO practice: measure and grow the visibility and citations of our brand, games and sports content in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and other AI assistants.
* Set the policy for AI crawlers and make game data (provider, RTP, volatility, features), odds, promotions and terms clean, structured and accessible to LLMs and agents.
* Make sure AI-surfaced information about us is accurate and compliant, including bonus terms and responsible gambling messaging.

Content and automation

* Scale content with AI: game reviews, category and provider pages, sports previews and guides, metadata and internal links, with editorial and compliance quality control and measurable impact.
* Automate the team's own work with AI tools and agents, so specialists spend their time on decisions.

Conversion and off-site

* Improve landing-page quality and conversion of organic traffic into registrations and first deposits, with Product, UX, UI and Analytics.
* Lead off-site strategy: digital PR, safe and compliant link acquisition, brand mentions and reputation in search results, including review sites and affiliate listings.
* Work with Legal and Compliance so all SEO and content activity meets licence conditions, advertising rules and responsible gambling standards in each market.

**What we expect:**

* 5+ years of SEO experience, including 2+ years leading an SEO team.
* A track record on a large igaming, betting, ecommerce or marketplace site with proven, measured non-brand organic revenue growth. Direct igaming experience, operator or affiliate side, is a strong advantage.
* Strong technical SEO: you understand how search engines crawl, render and index complex, JavaScript-heavy architectures, and you can challenge both developers and technical specialists.
* International SEO experience across several countries and languages.
* Hands-on GEO/AEO experience: you have measured and improved visibility in AI search, and can show how.
* Solid knowledge of how LLM-based search retrieves, grounds and cites content, of AI crawlers, and of structured data and data feeds (Schema.org and similar).
* Experience building AI-assisted content and SEO workflows at scale with quality control.
* A clear understanding of the compliance limits on gambling marketing: regulator advertising rules, responsible gambling, and search engine policies for gambling content and links.
* Commercial and analytical mindset: forecasting, budgeting, ROI, GA4, Search Console, BI tools; SQL or BigQuery is an advantage.
* Experience running SEO tests and working in sprints with Product and Technology.
* Ability to present clearly to top management and to turn strategy into tasks for the team.
* Experience in Nordic or other small-language search markets.

##### **What We offer:**

* Hybrid working model (office 3 days/ week)
* Innovative international company that uses cutting-edge tech equipment
* Collaborative teams and agile multicultural environment
* Competitive salary with flexible working hours
* 23 paid vacation days + public holidays
* Private health insurance for you and your family
* Free Online English/Spanish lessons
* Corporate events throughout the year
* Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities

##### **In-office perks such as:**

* Daily breakfast and freshly cooked lunch 3 days a week
* 50% discount on personal training sessions and physiotherapy sessions
* Games room, full kitchen with hot drinks, fruit, soft drinks
* Gym, massage room and much more

At Valsea, we want diversity and inclusion in an environment where unique perspectives and new talents thrive. Join us in creating a workplace where everyone can shine and contribute to our collective success. Protecting your privacy and data security is a longstanding top priority for Valsea. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://valsea.teamtailor.com/data-privacy) to learn more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: Head of Retention & Customer Experience
description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention & Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.

We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.

**The mission of this role**

Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**

We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
* Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.

**Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* **Subscriptions and churn:** own the subscription program for both brands, keep at least one save or retention test live every week, grow the share of new customers who subscribe (working with the CRO Lead on on-site and post-purchase offers), and report subscribers, MRR, churn and save rate by brand every week.
* **Email, SMS and lifecycle:** own email and SMS strategy, manage the retention agency, keep the calendar live and flows in testing, keep list health and deliverability strong, and plan sale and launch campaigns with the Head of Growth and the Head of Brand & Community.
* **Post-purchase experience and loyalty:** ship at least one post-purchase improvement every month, and use cancellation reasons, reviews, surveys and support contact reasons to find why customers leave and fix the cause with the owning team.
* **Customer experience and support:** lead the Customer Experience Manager, own the weekly CX KPI scorecard (CSAT, first response time, AI resolution rate, refund rate and chargebacks), set customer service policy, and grow 4- and 5-star reviews.
* **Retention data and reporting:** track cohort retention, repeat purchase rate and lifetime value by brand and channel, report retention KPIs weekly, run a monthly retention review with the CEO, and write the retention playbook as SOPs so it runs without one person.

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening Interview

(2) In-Depth Interview with our CEO

(3) Reference Calls

(4) Final Interview with our CEO

**Salary Expectation**

USD $115,000 to $145,000 a year (based on experience and expertise) + performance bonus of 15-20% of base after the trial period.

title: Retail Marketing Manager
description:
**¿Todo listo para tu nueva aventura?**

En blue banana creemos firmemente que las personas son el centro de nuestro desarrollo como marca.

Por ello, nuestro objetivo es atraer el mejor talento para seguir creciendo en este proyecto sin límites, donde trabajamos para empoderar a las nuevas generaciones a hacer de sus vidas una aventura. Nuestra misión nos invita a conectar con nuestro consumidor de una manera significativa, a través de la creación de contenido, de historias inspiradoras y de productos icónicos de alta calidad, responsables con el medioambiente.

No solo somos una marca, ¡SOMOS UN ESTILO DE VIDA! y queremos influir positivamente en el mundo.

¿Te identificas con nuestra pasión y propósito? Si es así, sigue leyendo y descubre cómo puedes ser parte de esta emocionante misión.

**El puesto**

Buscamos un perfil de Retail Marketing Manager con experiencia en moda o retail que haga de la tienda física el corazón de cada campaña. Reportarás directamente al Head of Marketing y serás quien conecte marca, tienda y negocio en España y Portugal.

Si te gusta pisar tienda, entender al cliente y ver cómo una campaña se convierte en entradas y ventas, este puesto es para ti.

Tu contribución en blue banana brand será excepcional si desarrollas estas funciones:

**La tienda física como eje**

* Convertir los objetivos de marketing en planes de trade marketing para España y Portugal, con prioridades, calendario, presupuesto y KPIs: captar nuevas audiencias, aumentar los clientes activos, generar awareness, vender la nueva colección por género, atraer tráfico a tienda y mejorar el lifetime value y el rendimiento del canal retail.
* Llevar esos planes del retail calendar a campañas omnicanal con la tienda como eje, con un mensaje claro para el cliente y conectadas de forma coherente con digital, CRM y PR.
* Liderar de principio a fin las acciones en El Corte Inglés, centros comerciales, outlets y pop-up stores, coordinándote con Brand, Visual y Retail, y con los equipos de marketing de cada canal, para crear planes a medida y medibles.
* Asegurar la coherencia entre marca y acción comercial en todos los puntos de venta, en el resto de canales y en ambos mercados.

**Cada canal, con su estrategia**

* Conocer a fondo cómo funciona cada canal y quién compra en él: tiendas propias, corners de El Corte Inglés y centros comerciales.
* Adaptar cada campaña a la realidad y al presupuesto de cada canal: espacios y formatos disponibles, normativas de implantación, calendarios comerciales y acciones conjuntas con centros comerciales y grandes almacenes.
* Seguir los resultados de cada canal y campaña (tráfico, conversión, ticket medio, unidades por ticket, ventas por tienda y captación de clientes), detectar desviaciones y proponer ajustes para la siguiente activación.

**Mano a mano con Visual**

* Trabajar con Visual para que marca y negocio vayan de la mano en tienda: escaparates, PLV, señalética, ratio de atracción, categorización por familias y conversión.
* Definir qué necesita cada canal y cada tienda, para producir materiales eficaces y con el coste justo.
* Medir el impacto de escaparates y materiales en el comportamiento del cliente y en las ventas, y aplicar lo aprendido en las siguientes campañas.
* Preparar kits de campaña y guías de implantación claras para los equipos de tienda, junto a Retail y Operaciones.

**El cliente en el centro**

* Entender qué busca el cliente en cada tienda: por qué compra, cómo se mueve y qué le hace volver. Para ello combinarás datos, el feedback de los equipos de tienda y el análisis del mercado, la competencia y las tendencias.
* Trabajar con el equipo de CRM en la estrategia de cliente (nuevos y fieles) con foco en tienda: captación en el punto de venta, recurrencia y nuestro club Adventure Pass.

**Datos, reporting y presupuesto**

* Medir la rentabilidad de cada inversión por canal y por campaña, y priorizar con datos lo que más impacto tiene.
* Preparar el reporting para dirección y comité: cuadro de mando semanal, informe mensual y recaps de las campañas clave del retail calendar.
* Ser owner del presupuesto y de los objetivos de retail marketing.
* Usar la IA para analizar, decidir y convertir ideas en campañas.
* Impulsar una cultura de medición y mejora continua, y hacer visible el impacto de marketing en el negocio.

**¿Qué te hará triunfar con nosotros?**

* Más de 6 años en marketing en empresas de moda o retail. Valoramos la experiencia en entornos internacionales.
* Al menos 4 años como Retail Marketing Manager, Trade Marketing Manager o Marketing Manager con responsabilidad sobre el punto de venta, con experiencia en:

  + Campañas 360 con foco en tienda física.
  + Tiendas propias, corners de El Corte Inglés y centros comerciales, coordinándote con sus equipos de marketing.
  + Visual merchandising: escaparates, PLV y materiales de punto de venta.
  + Análisis de ventas y KPIs de tienda por canal.
  + Cliente, hábitos de compra, CRM y loyalty.
  + Gestión de presupuesto y cumplimiento de objetivos.
* Dominio de Shopify, Excel avanzado y PowerPoint (imprescindible).
* Uso de herramientas de IA para análisis, gestión y reporting.
* Valorable: Smile y Klaviyo.
* Español e inglés, hablado y escrito. El portugués será un plus.

**Lo que te define**

* Te gusta pisar tienda y entiendes cómo se vive una campaña en cada canal.
* Piensas con datos y con estrategia.
* Tienes creatividad, sobre todo a la hora de ejecutar.
* Tienes visión de negocio y vas a por resultados.
* Planificas, priorizas y sigues tus KPIs de cerca.
* Sabes influir y trabajar con muchos equipos: Visual, Retail, tiendas y los equipos de marketing de cada canal.
* Tienes iniciativa, autonomía y mentalidad ganadora.

**¿Te preguntas qué ganas al unirte a nosotrxs? ¡Aquí van nuestros beneficios!**

**️ Estilo X:** Accede a todos nuestros productos con un **50% de descuento** desde el primer día y disfruta de **bonos de regalo por temporada**. ¿Lo mejor? También puedes **compartir un 30%** de descuento con tus personas más cercanas.

**️ Flexibilidad y conciliación:** En blue banana, entendemos que los tiempos cambian. Con un **modelo híbrido del 40% de teletrabajo** semanal y en épocas estivales, **flexibilidad en entrada y salida.** Además, el **día de tu cumpleaños** es para disfrutarlo, ¡aquí lo tendrás libre!

**️ Evoluciona con nosotros:** En blue banana, las personas son el centro. Cada persona vive su propio viaje profesional, con feedback constante, a través de nuestro **Adventure Career Plan** personalizado y formación continua.

**️ Cuidamos de ti:** Priorizamos la salud con nuestro programa de bienestar. **Wellhub** ofrece experiencias únicas para cuidar cuerpo y mente.

**️ Teambuildings épicos**: Inspiramos a nuevas generaciones y a nuestros trabajadores a hacer de su vida una aventura con **eventos únicos** y nuestras **blue banana expert talks**, donde podrás escuchar y sacar inspiración de grandes profesionales alineados con nuestra marca.

**️ Espíritu Z:** Únete a un proyecto con un equipo inconformista y lleno de experiencia donde te sentirás rodeado de compañeros que se apoyan mutuamente. Sé parte de un **proyecto internacional** donde cada día impactas y sumas rompiendo las reglas del juego.

**️ Comunicación y transparencia 360º:** Nos encanta escuchar y debatir, trabajando con pasión y humildad para superarnos cada día. Te sentirás parte integral del proyecto con detalles de nuestro crecimiento compartidos en nuestras **Quarterlies** y resúmenes mensuales.

**️ Oficinas que molan:** Además de **café y fruta siempre disponible**, nuestras oficinas tienen espacios abiertos y zonas de desconexión. En blue banana, te sentirás como en casa.

**️ Sé parte del cambio:** En Blue Banana somos una empresa certificada B Corp. Eso significa que no solo trabajamos por crecer, sino por hacerlo generando un impacto positivo real en las personas y en el planeta.

**¿Quieres conocernos mejor?**

* Pásate por nuestra web o por cualquiera de nuestras tiendas.
* Sigue nuestros viajes desde nuestro canal de Youtube y conoce el lado B de la aventura. No todo es tan bonito como lo pintamos en nuestras fotos.
* Si tienes cualquier duda, escríbenos. Estamos para ayudar.

Gracias por haber leído hasta aquí y bienvenidx, aventurerx.

*Blue Banana manifiesta su compromiso con la igualdad de género y de oportunidades a todos los niveles y para todas las personas trabajadoras, y garantiza la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión en todos sus procesos.*

*Blue Banana promueve un futuro más sostenible, diseñando y produciendo colecciones de una forma más responsable. Trabajamos a todos los niveles para garantizar el mínimo impacto ambiental y social de nuestros productos, cumpliendo los beneficios e incentivos que ofrecemos de sostenibilidad y responsabilidad social.*

title: Head of Partnerships, EMEA
description:
**Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.**

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers. Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* You'll lead the development and execution of our EMEA partnership expansion strategy across key European markets including Germany, Italy, Spain, France, the Netherlands and the UK.

* You'll own and prioritise the European partnership pipeline, ensuring opportunities are commercially attractive, operationally deliverable and strategically aligned.

* You'll identify, secure and grow large-scale partnerships across airlines, online travel agencies, banks, payment providers, retailers, telcos, aggregators and embedded insurance channels.

* You'll build strong relationships with Zurich business units, distributors and strategic partners to accelerate growth across the region.

* You'll lead partner proposition development, commercial modelling, business case preparation and executive-level recommendations.

* You'll negotiate commercially successful partnership agreements that deliver value for customers, partners and the business.

* You'll provide commercial leadership to cross-functional teams spanning product, underwriting, technology, operations, claims, finance, legal, risk and compliance.

* You'll drive successful market entry and partnership launches, removing barriers and maintaining momentum across multiple countries and stakeholder groups.

* You'll represent the EMEA growth agenda in executive forums, governance committees and strategic partner discussions.

* You'll lead and develop a high-performing partnerships team while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation and collaboration.

**What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey:**

* You'll bring significant experience in partnerships, business development, commercial strategy, market expansion or distribution leadership.

* You'll have a proven track record of originating, negotiating and delivering strategic partnerships in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

* You'll understand the dynamics of insurance, travel, affinity, embedded insurance, digital distribution or financial services markets.

* You'll have experience leading growth and market-entry initiatives across European or EMEA markets.

* You'll bring strong commercial acumen with the ability to assess market opportunities, partner economics, operational feasibility and return on investment.

* You'll understand modern partnership and distribution models including B2B2C, embedded insurance, API integrations, white-label solutions and aggregator channels.

* You'll be comfortable influencing senior executives, strategic partners and cross-functional teams across a matrixed international environment.

* You'll have exceptional negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex commercial and regulatory concepts.

* You'll balance commercial ambition with governance, customer outcomes and execution excellence.

* You'll bring European language capability and existing European insurance or partnership networks as an advantage.

**Why you’ll love working with us!**

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.

**Career growth****.** This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.

**Take the time you need, for you and your community****.** We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual, personal and volunteer leave benefits.

**Diversity and inclusion****.** We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.

  

**Apply today and let’s go to great places together!**

**#LI-Remote**

title: Director of External Communications
description:
**We power people’s progress.**
-------------------------------

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

**Meet the team!**
------------------

We are hiring a Director of External Communications to operate as an extension of the Chief Brand Officer, owning and scaling Preply’s external narrative at company level.

Today, much of our narrative lives centrally. Your mission is to decentralize, systematize, and scale it into a high-impact narrative engine that shapes global perception and drives business outcomes.

This is not a traditional PR role.

Your mission is to build and own a scalable narrative system that:

* Shapes how Preply is perceived globally
* Positions Preply as a leader in AI-driven learning
* Drives measurable impact on growth, hiring, and brand authority
* Eliminates dependency on any single individual for storytelling

You will operate at the intersection of Brand, Product, Talent, and Leadership, influencing without authority and driving execution across the company.

**What you will own:**
----------------------

**Company Narrative & Market Position**

* Define and evolve Preply’s global narrative, including:

  + AI & product positioning
  + Marketplace dynamics (tutors & learners)
  + Social impact and mission
* Own how Preply shows up across all external touchpoints
* Establish Preply as a category-defining voice in AI-powered learning

**Narrative Engine & Content System**

* Build a scalable storytelling system connecting:

  + Inputs: product, research, data, insights
  + Outputs: PR, SEO, content, executive communications
* Ensure consistency across all formats:

  + Media, reports, op-eds, events, owned content
* Move from campaigns repeatable narrative infrastructure

**Employer Brand & Talent Narrative**

* Define and scale a global employer narrative
* Build targeted storytelling for key audiences:

  + AI, Engineering, Design, Tutors
* Partner with Talent to directly impact hiring outcomes

**Executive Positioning & Thought Leadership**

* Shape leadership voice and positioning in the market
* Develop strong POVs on:

  + AI in education
  + Marketplace dynamics
  + Future of learning
* Drive visibility across:

  + Tier 1 media
  + Conferences
  + Long-form content

**Cross-Functional Narrative Orchestration**

* Align senior stakeholders across Brand, Product, Talent, and Marketing
* Create frameworks enabling teams to contribute to a unified narrative
* Drive execution without direct authority

**Strategy -> Execution (Critical)**

* Own both direction and delivery
* Personally contribute to:

  + Writing and storytelling
  + Key launches and initiatives
  + High-impact narrative moments

This is a hands-on leadership role. We are looking for builders, not coordinators.

**Reputation & Crisis Leadership**

* Define communication strategies for high-stakes situations
* Prepare leadership for complex media environments
* Anticipate and manage reputational risks

**This role is not**

* A traditional PR leadership role
* A coordination layer between teams
* A purely strategic or purely managerial position

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* 12+ years in communications, content, or narrative strategy in high-growth tech environments
* Proven experience owning company-level narrative or market positioning
* Strong track record connecting storytelling business impact
* Experience working closely with senior stakeholders and executives
* Ability to operate as both:

  + Strategic leader
  + Hands-on executor
* Native fluency in English required (Spanish is a strong plus)

**Critical Differentiators**
----------------------------

* Deep understanding of AI / LLM landscape and its narrative implications
* Ability to shape market perception, not just run campaigns
* Experience building scalable systems, not one-off initiatives
* Strong editorial instinct combined with data-driven thinking
* High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in ambiguity

**Why you’ll love it at Preply**
--------------------------------

* An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
* A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
* A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
* Access to free mental health support platforms;
* The opportunity to shape the lives of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).

**Our Principles**
------------------

* **Care to change the world** - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
* **We do it for learners** - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
* **Keep perfecting** - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
* **Now is the time** - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
* **Disciplined execution** - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
* **Dive deep** - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
* **Growth mindset** - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
* **Raise the bar** - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
* **Challenge, disagree and commit** - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
* **One Preply** - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
------------------------------------

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

title: HRBP Southern Europe
description:
At Ceva Animal Health, people truly matter. We value pragmatism, collaboration, accountability and trust, and we empower our leaders and HR teams to make decisions close to the business.

We are seeking an experienced **HR Business Partner** to support our **Southern Europe region (220 employees across Spain, Portugal, Italy and Greece).**  
  
This is a senior HRBP position, with the management of an HR team of 4 based in Spain and Italy.  
You will partner closely with senior business leaders, providing both strategic HR advice and hands-on operational support in a fast-paced, commercial environment. This role will suit an HR professional who enjoys autonomy, is comfortable being the go-to HR partner, and can confidently balance strategy with day-to-day delivery.  
  
Reporting to the southern Europe Vice President and functionally to the Europe HR Director, you will be the primary HR point of contact for all people-related matters across the sub-region. You will play a critical role in shaping organisational capability, supporting leaders through change, and embedding CEVA’s values and HR frameworks locally.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Business Partnering & Leadership Support**  

* Act as a trusted HR advisor to senior leaders on organisational design and workforce planning and performance management and leadership effectiveness
* Talent development and succession planning
* Change initiatives and restructures
* Provide clear, pragmatic advice, often at pace and with incomplete information.
* Build strong, credible relationships with leadership teams and Headquarters.

  
**Operational HR & Employee Relations**  

* Supervise the day-to-day HR agenda across the region.
* Coach and advise managers on employee relations and performance matters.
* Manage sensitive employee relations matters, including claims and litigation, in close collaboration with external legal support.
* Ensure compliance with local employment laws and company policies.

* Ensure swift relations with the works council.

**Reward, Performance & Compensation**  

* Responsible for Compensation & Benefits processes up to Grade 17.
* Provide input into:

Performance outcomes  
Short-Term Incentive Plans (STIP)  
Internal pay consistency and European alignment  

* Maintain a strong focus on governance, consistency and meeting deadlines.

  
**Talent & Organisation**  

* Lead people review and talent discussions.
* Support the development of senior leaders and high-potential talent.
* Contribute to wider European HR initiatives.

**Your profile :**

**Experience:**  

* Senior HR Business Partner with 8+ years of experience.
* Strong exposure to employment law across Southern Europe, particularly Spain, Italy, Portugal and Greece.
* Experience working across multiple countries and cultural environments.

title: AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
**This isn’t another growth job**

Most growth teams call themselves data-driven. They have a dashboard, an agency and a ChatGPT licence to write ad copy faster. That’s the 99%.

We want to be part of the 0.1%: a company where AI doesn’t just help the growth team, it runs the growth loop. Every day, on every channel.

**Then it’s your chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.**

Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.

We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Head of Growth who can ideate, write the copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE GROWTH MEANS AT PARADOX**
------------------------------------------

Our growth machine has to be able to:

**1. Generate hypotheses.** Read the signals (ad performance, webinar attendance, sales calls, objections, churn reasons, comments, competitors’ ads) and propose what to test next, with a cost and an expected impact.

**2. Act across every tool.** Not a chatbot in a tab: it reads and writes in our whole stack, from ad accounts to CRM, landing pages, webinars, email, social DMs and analytics.

**3. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, offers, voice, member stories, past campaigns and what they taught us, in one shared company brain.

**4. Ship its hypotheses.** Produce the hook, the ad cut, the page, the email sequence or the funnel variant, and put it live.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Every test is tied to a number that matters (cost per qualified lead, show-up rate, close rate, CAC, payback, LTV), not to likes or reach.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Scale what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and launch the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment, with its result. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars, wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations and audit our tracking after every live. Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox,

We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

Growth at Paradox means bringing people into something that actually changes their life, and proving it.

We do that by merging :

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.

You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Build the agents that run growth**

* The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.

### **2. Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night**

* The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.

### **3. Build a creative machine with taste**

* The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Build measurement that checks itself**

* The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.

### **5. Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul**

* The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.
* And always: no fake scarcity, no fake claims, real stories told with consent. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. Most experiments are generated and shipped by agents. The output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.

**You’ll own these KPIs:** LTV / CAC ratio, funnel conversion rate by stage, experiments launched per week.

**Desired outcomes:** conversion rates 2x better than baseline, growth experimentation that runs continuously, a predictable growth engine.

**Tools you’ll master:** GA4, Optibase, Vidalytics, Clarity, Hotjar, Amplitude, Figma, Looker Studio, VWO, Optimizely, Claude Code, and whatever helps you see what others miss.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* You have ideally a minimum of 3 years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization, Growth Experimentation, or Performance Marketing, ideally within SaaS, e-commerce, or digital product environments.
* You have a track record of designing, implementing, and scaling A/B and multivariate tests that have generated measurable improvements in revenue, user activation, or conversion.
* You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, automations, APIs, evals, creative pipelines. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**You are :**

* A Conversion Architect, skilled at diagnosing funnel bottlenecks and translating data into structured experimentation roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* A Behavioral Strategist, fascinated by what drives human action, able to mix cognitive psychology, UX, and persuasion frameworks to design experiences that convert because they resonate.
* A Data-driven Creator, fluent in GA4, Hotjar, AB Tasty, VWO, Amplitude, not just running tests, but connecting insights to revenue, retention, and lifetime value.

**Traits :**

* Loop thinker: you see every channel as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* Taste: you know a great hook in two seconds, and you’d rather ship one great ad than ten average ones.
* Numbers-honest: you say when a test failed. You care about real revenue, not vanity metrics.
* Builder, not manager: you’d rather build the system than coordinate an agency.
* Growth over ego: you love hard feedback, you read, study and learn fast.
* Cross-disciplinary: you move from psychology to spreadsheet to creative brief to code.
* Analytical: you turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, a metric and an experiment.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.

If you build to deliver, not to elevate — wrong mission.

If you want to optimize without getting your hands dirty in landing pages, copy, or design — wrong role.

If you want to manage agencies and budgets rather than build a machine — wrong role.

If you’re obsessed with psychology, systems and creative…

If you want to build the growth machine that learns faster than anyone else…

If you dream of using AI to bring transformation to millions of people…

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Build one of the first truly self-learning growth machines, and write the playbook others will copy.

Grow something that genuinely changes lives, with the proof to show it.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

-> 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

-> Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**
------------------

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

A 6 to 8 minutes application survey (with a short video assignment)

A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s Growth team

A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the growth vision and the next milestones to build

Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

Welcome aboard!

**About our hiring process**

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

If you’re not joining to tweak landing pages.

If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

**You are the account manager. We do not have any.** You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.** Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.** We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

**You can live anywhere.** We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

 **Requirements**

**What the job looks like**

* **Own a set of DTC accounts** as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
* **Own the client relationship.** There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
* **Audit before you touch anything.** Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
* **Run brand and non brand as different businesses.** Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
* **Know what PMax is actually doing.** The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
* **Keep Google's automation on a leash.** Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
* **Own the feed.** Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
* **Own the tracking.** GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
* **Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.** Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
* **Build the things the account needs.** Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

**You are a fit if**

* **You have done this with real money.** Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
* **You are fluent in the whole stack**, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
* **You are AI native, and you build.** This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
* **You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.** You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
* **You are skeptical of your own numbers.** You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
* **You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.** Where you live is up to you.
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
* You want to be told what to do this week.
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

  
**Benefits**

**Why this role is exciting**

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.
