**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

**About the Role**

We are seeking an entrepreneurial, commercially driven, and inspirational Consulting and Research Leader to oversee and scale our Consulting and Research practice.

In this senior role, you will be the strategic anchor and trusted advisor to premier sports rights holders, brands and agencies across key markets. You will hold end-to-end accountability for regional revenue growth, delivery excellence, and client satisfaction while spearheading operational innovation, team development, and scalable collaboration with our Global Delivery Team (GDT).

**Key Responsibilities.**

**1. Commercial Leadership & Strategic Advisory**

* Own overall commercial targets across key markets, spearheading client renewals, account upsells, and strategic new business acquisition.
* Serve as a strategic counselor to marquee sports and entertainment clients, translating data intelligence into decisive commercial actions.
* Direct and contribute to regional RFP responses, competitive pitches, and custom advisory scoping in close coordination with Revenue teams.
* Identify emerging client needs and partner with International Solutions and Product teams to deploy next-generation analytics tools, sponsorship valuation models, and consulting offerings.

**2. People Leadership, Talent & Culture**

* Directly lead, inspire, and manage consulting and research professionals, establishing clear performance expectations and individual development plans.
* Identify skill gaps and implement tailored learning programs to cultivate advanced strategic consulting, data literacy, and consultative selling capabilities.

**3. Operational Delivery, Capacity & Innovation**

* Actively drive and deliver projects hands-on from commercial pitch to execution, taking a direct role in delivery while governing and managing coordination across internal resources and clients.
* Lead and evolve the collaborative framework between local on-shore consultants and Global Delivery Teams (GDT), fostering continuous feedback loops, reporting standardisation, and operational agility.
* Synthesize cross-market insights, sponsorship benchmarks, and audience trends to provide high-value, actionable intelligence for landmark advisory projects.
* Provide continuous strategic counsel and executive support to the Market Leader and cross-border leadership teams.

 **Qualifications**

* Extensive experience in management consulting, strategic advisory, or commercial sports/media analytics, with proven experience leading distributed teams.
* Demonstrated success driving revenue, winning major advisory RFPs, and expanding client relationships
* Deep understanding of the sports ecosystem, media rights valuations, sponsorship ROI measurement, and emerging fan engagement models.
* Exceptional capacity to translate complex quantitative datasets and econometric models into clear, high-impact C-suite narratives and board presentations.
* Proven ability to serve as a prominent face in the market, leading client engagements on the front lines and presenting key results with executive presence.
* Mastered acumen in deal pricing, scope definition, and contract negotiation that balances client value with long-term business margins.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Management, Marketing, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Professional executive fluency in English and Spanish** (spoken and written) is required to engage with regional stakeholders and international leadership. Italian is a plus.
* For employees outside India and United States: Willingness to serve as a local internal subsidiary director to represent the entity in country, with full support from corporate teams, in governance matters.

 **Additional Information**

**What can we offer you as an employee of Nielsen Media**

In addition to a competitive salary and benefits we offer a varied area of responsibility as well as an open corporate culture with numerous development opportunities. Above all, our employees appreciate the ability to work independently in a motivated and very friendly team. Social responsibility, open communication and living our values can be found not only on our homepage, but also in everyday work. An informal atmosphere in a dynamic media company with opportunities for ownership and personal development.

**Compensation**

The stated salary range represents the full compensation scale for this level. To allow for future progression and development, new employees are typically hired into the lower to middle portion of this range. An individual's exact starting salary at Nielsen depends on several factors, including geographic location, skills, experience, training, certifications, and other business needs.

The annual salary for this position ranges from 69700 - 129400 EUR gross. **The compensation stated includes a sales incentive plan of 40% of the on target earnings.**

title: 3D Animator
description:
**Company Description**

**THE WORLD OF UBISOFT**

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

**Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile** brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

 **Job Description**

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Create believable, high-quality animations and directly participating in implementing them in games.
* Define the animation style and workflows for new products under the supervision of the Producer and Lead Artist.
* Be able to rigging/skinning with low to medium polygon counts.
* Take active part in the game creation process by interacting with the design team.
* Contribute effectively to the art pipeline while understanding target platform constraints.
* Have a strong time management skills to reach project deadlines/milestones.
* Collaborate with the rest of the Art Team to obtain a consistent visual style for the game.
* Work with the Programming Team to integrate your animations in the game while respecting technical constraints.

  
**Qualifications**

**PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS**

In order for your application to be considered, you must submit a portfolio or other samples of your work. All portfolios must contain a detailed shot breakdown of the work. It must be very clear what you, the applicant, are responsible for in your reel, screenshots, scanned pictures, web page portfolio, etc.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Examples of basic cycles of a character. Cycle of walk, run, idle, attack, jump, etc.
* Examples of physics of movement. It can be a character doing parkour, moving weight, a skateboarder, etc.
* Examples of combination of cycles. Idle + attack, idle + run + attack, etc.
* It would also be interesting if among all the examples there is some quadrupeds, or characters of more than two feet.

* At least 4 or more years of experience in 3D Studio Max, Maya or Blender.
* Have a clear understanding of character motion, camera movement, physics-based motion and of the fundamental principles of animation.
* Be able to define and execute creative and stylish animations (vehicles, objects, characters).
* Positive attitude with the ability to receive and provide objective feedback
* Be a team player: we use agile development methods, where the team members are in permanent contact. Open mind and good communication skills are a must.
* Attention to detail, meticulous and organized working habits. Ability to multi-task and to adapt easily to change.
* Good command of English.
* Work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is a must.

Bonus

* Solid background in academic drawing, sketching and/or illustration.
* Working Unity experience.
* Have modelling skills (2D/3D), knowledge and experience of Blender, Unity, particle effects creation programs (e.g. combustion, particle illusion, Fork) and motion graphics programs (eg After Effects).
* Experience working on mobile games.
* Passion for games and some knowledge of the games industry.
* Spanish or Catalan is a plus.

  
**Additional Information**

**YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)**

* **Ticket Restaurant:** 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery free of taxes).
* **Flexible working hours:** 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
* **Reduced schedule** (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
* **Personal Matters Hours:** 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
* **Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day** on yourUbi-Birthday.
* **5 extra holiday days** on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
* **Health insurance** with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
* **Life Insurance** with AXA.
* **Office Gym** open from 7 AM to 8 PM
* **Mobile Device Grant** of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
* **Language training** for English, Spanish, and French.
* **Professional development training & programs**, based upon request.
* **Ubisoft games** are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
* **Locally roasted craft coffee** by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).

Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

title: Professional Services Architect
description:
### **Our Purpose**

  

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

### **About Us**

  

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

### **What Are We Looking For?**

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

SentinelOne is looking for a Professional Services Architect with solid enterprise cybersecurity expertise, strong hands-on delivery experience, and a proven ability to design and implement effective security solutions for complex customer environments.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role. You are not a people manager, and you are not primarily pre-sales. You are a skilled technical practitioner who takes ownership of customer engagements from discovery and solution design through to deployment, handover, and long-term customer success. You bring technical credibility, clear communication, and a consultative approach to every engagement you lead.

Strong candidates will come from cybersecurity vendors, professional services practices, MSSPs, system integrators, and enterprise security teams. Prior experience with SentinelOne is an advantage, but demonstrable expertise in the relevant technology domains is what matters.

### **What will you do?**

Primary responsibilities include:

* Act as the primary technical owner for customer engagements spanning SentinelOne EDR/XDR deployments and Prompt Security implementations.
* Lead technical discovery, solution design, and architecture across endpoint protection, identity, cloud security, and security operations, with a primary focus on EDR/XDR environments and their integration into the broader security ecosystem.
* Deploy and configure Prompt Security across enterprise scenarios, including employee AI tool access, developer AI workflows, home-grown AI applications, and browser-based controls via enterprise MDM.
* Advise customers on AI governance, data protection, and policy enforcement, addressing risks such as prompt injection and shadow AI usage.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges during active deployments, escalating appropriately when complex architectural decisions arise.
* Partner with pre-sales teams to scope engagements and provide technical input into Statements of Work (SOWs).
* Work alongside channel partners (MSSPs, system integrators, resellers), providing technical guidance during joint engagements, building their delivery capability over time.
* Contribute to internal and partner-facing delivery documentation, implementation guides, and technical reference materials.
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and represent their technical needs internally.

### **What skills and knowledge should you bring?**

Ideal candidates will have:

* 5+ years of experience in enterprise cybersecurity, with meaningful time in customer-facing technical roles such as Professional Service or Security Engineering.
* Solid hands-on experience with enterprise EDR/XDR, including deployment, configuration, integration, and migrations from incumbent platforms.
* Good understanding of endpoint telemetry, detection and response workflows, and integration with SIEM, identity, and cloud security platforms.
* Experience contributing to engagement scoping, effort estimation, and SOW input.
* Strong communication skills across technical and business stakeholders.
* Proficiency across Windows, Linux, and/or macOS environments (installation, configuration, administration, security best practices).
* Strong working knowledge of security and network concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, LAN/WAN, firewalls, IDS/IPS, etc.).
* Proficiency with automation tools or scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash).
* Highly desirable:
  + Experience working alongside channel partners in a delivery or advisory capacity.
  + Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  + Practical experience designing and delivering AI security controls - Prompt Security or a comparable platform; understanding of browser-based AI security deployment via MDM and API-level integration patterns; and awareness of AI security risks, including prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, shadow AI, and agentic AI workflows.
  + A plus are also relevant industry certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CEH, CCSP, or equivalent).

### **Why SentinelOne?**

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

**Equity & Rewards**

* Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

**Time Off & Wellbeing**

* Competitive leave benefits
* Gender-neutral parental leave

**Insurance & Financial Security**

* Medical and insurance benefits
* Pension
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**Work Perks & Flexibility**

* Global home office allowance
* Monthly home office, internet and mobile phone allowance

**Wellness & Lifestyle**

* Meal allowance
* Transportation allowance

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure.

title: Security Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

**About the Role**

The Security Engineer plays a critical role in protecting our technology infrastructure and maintaining the security posture of our gaming platform. This position exists to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate security vulnerabilities while serving as a trusted security advisor to engineering teams across the organization. The role directly impacts our ability to safeguard user data, maintain platform integrity, and ensure secure development practices are embedded throughout our product development lifecycle.

This position is essential for building and maintaining robust security defenses in a fast-paced, remote-first technology environment where security expertise must be seamlessly integrated into daily engineering operations and strategic decision-making processes.

**What you'll do**

* **Lead vulnerability management program** by triaging, reproducing, and assessing security vulnerabilities submitted through Bug Bounty programs, working directly with engineering teams to prioritize and remediate discovered security gaps
* **Conduct comprehensive threat modeling** by collaborating with engineering teams to analyze proposed solutions, ensuring designs meet security industry standards and identifying potential attack vectors before implementation
* **Manage security incident response** by reviewing penetration testing results and SIEM reports, translating technical findings into actionable remediation tasks, and tracking resolution progress through completion
* **Optimize security infrastructure** by applying updates to Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and other security systems, ensuring configurations align with current threat landscape and organizational needs
* **Drive security tool evaluation and implementation** by researching, evaluating, and recommending security software solutions, attending vendor demonstrations, and leading procurement processes from requirements gathering through deployment
* **Provide security consultation and guidance** by serving as subject matter expert to development teams, ensuring security best practices are integrated into software development lifecycle and architectural decisions
* **Maintain security awareness and documentation** by communicating security updates, progress reports, and recommendations to stakeholders through established channels and maintaining current security policies and procedures

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum 3+ years of professional experience specifically in web application security
* Demonstrated expertise with security testing tools such as Burp Suite or equivalent web request analysis and tampering tools
* Strong written communication skills in English with ability to clearly explain technical security concepts to diverse audiences
* Experience working effectively in fully distributed/remote team environments
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering and development teams

**Preferred Skills and Qualifications**

* Previous hands-on experience managing or participating in Bug Bounty programs
* Programming experience in PHP or JavaScript
* Experience with penetration testing methodologies and tools
* Knowledge of SIEM platforms and security monitoring systems
* Familiarity with Web Application Firewall (WAF) configuration and management
* Understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices
* Experience with Jira or similar project management and issue tracking systems
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability in a flat organizational structure
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with evolving security threats and technologies

**About the Opportunity**

* This is a full-time opportunity
* We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!)

description:

**At ING we are looking for a Customer Journey Expert – Discretionary Portfolio Management**
============================================================================================

**Your role and work environment:**

ING Bank is entering in the Private Banking segment in Spain, a large market serving more than €600b in household wealth and showing a growth rate of 4% annually. ING Bank is in the process of launching a comprehensive new proposition tailored to Private Banking, digitally savvy customers. Join us in shaping the future of banking for Spain’s Private Banking & Investment.

ING Spain is building a new Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM) proposition as a key component of its Private Banking offering. We are looking for a hands-on **Customer Journey Expert** to join the DPM team, help complete delivery and close existing gaps, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of the product.

You will contribute across the **end-to-end DPM journey**, from requirements and testing to implementation, banker training and continuous improvement. Working closely with the Product Owner and the wider team, you will connect customer and banker needs with technology, operations and regulatory requirements.

You will work in a **highly international and cross-functional environment**, collaborating with **One Investment Platform** and teams across Investments, Technology, Operations, Data, Finance, Risk, Legal and Compliance.

This is a **hands-on Customer Journey Expert role within the DPM team**, combining product delivery, customer experience and support for bankers. You will take responsibility for agreed activities and contribute to product improvements, while backlog ownership and prioritization remain with the Product Owner.

**Your key responsibilities:**

You will contribute to **DPM delivery, day-to-day product improvements and further evolution** through the following activities:

* **Complete the remaining DPM delivery**: Define and refine business requirements, document user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with technology and operations teams to bring outstanding capabilities into production.

* **Close existing gaps**: Identify and analyse functional, operational and customer journey gaps, help define practical solutions, and follow agreed actions through to resolution.

* **Support testing and implementation**: Prepare and execute end-to-end business and user acceptance tests, follow up on defects, and support release readiness and post-implementation validation.

* **Train and support bankers:** Prepare practical training materials and product guides, deliver DPM training sessions, and gather banker feedback to improve both the service and the assisted journey.

* **Contribute to product evolution:** Help define and implement new DPM capabilities and proposition enhancements, including pDPM, in line with the product roadmap and priorities agreed with the Product Owner.

* **Improve the digital and assisted experience:** Work with UX, design and technology teams on visual improvements, clearer portfolio information and simpler customer journeys, aligned with the Private Banking Digital Experience.

* **Keep the end-to-end service coherent:** Collaborate with Investments, One Investment Platform, retail product tribes and control functions to align processes, customer communications and operational handovers as DPM evolves.

As a **Customer Journey Expert** you are responsible of:

* **Customer Experience:** Provide the **best customer experience** by designing, mapping and constantly improving the customer journey. With an end-to-end process view being able to collect CX and data, translating into UX and IT landscapes

* **Digital Strategy**: As expert in digital experience, be proactive in the identification of new capabilities in our digital platform to **engage our customers** and increase **efficiency** of our assisted channels bringing the best experience in the moments of truth

* **Commercial Support:** Collaborate with marketing, customer interactions teams and bankers to translate the DPM value proposition into clear customer communications and practical supporting materials, incorporating feedback from the assisted channel.

* **Data Fluency:** Comprehend, define, select, and analyze data to gain insights that enhance the **decision-making process**. Use product and journey data, together with customer and banker feedback, to identify gaps, assess improvements and contribute to balanced cost-benefit assessments before and after implementation.

* **Agile Delivery:** Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Work on items prioritized by the Product Owner, contribute to refinement, and deliver agreed activities in short cycles with the team. Identify dependencies, risks and impediments early, support their resolution, and use testing and feedback to improve solutions while reducing complexity.

**What are we looking for?**

Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!

**A pioneer of the agile culture displaying the following behaviors:**

Ability to display flexibility to teams and adapt plans, approach and behavior to the different needs and situations

* Ability to take responsibility for agreed deliverables and contribute to team decisions based on facts, data and customer feedback

Strong resilience: ability to navigate through ambiguity

* Negotiation skills

* Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to follow delivery activities and open issues through to completion

* Passionate about innovation, new market trends and investment products

* Clear communications skills (written and oral)

* Ability to work on an international level

* Excellent oral and written English skills

* Team player

* Loving to collaborate with different people

* Able to work in an autonomous way and to take initiative

* Making things happen thanks to your ‘can do’ attitude

**Proven track record and technical skills**

* University degree, master’s in finance related is also a plus

* 5+ years’ professional experience in banking

* Experience with investment products and/or Private Banking customer journeys; familiarity with DPM is a plus

* Omnichannel experience management

* Research techniques and UX product design is a plus

* Practical experience translating business needs into requirements and supporting user acceptance testing and implementation

* Ability to explain investment products and processes clearly and prepare practical training materials for bankers

* Strong command of written and spoken English
  

  
  

**What do we offer?**

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.

  

Check out what is waiting for you!

**Balance That Works.**

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

**Restaurant card.**

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.

**Health insurance.**

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).

**Life insurance.**

We help you protect what matters most to you.

**Flexible remuneration.**

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…

**Free company shuttle.**

It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.

**Banking benefits.**

Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!

**More vitality and more belonging**

360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).

Physiotherapy service on site.

Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.

Gympass service.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

**Get to know Us**

We are a team of more than 1900 people sharing one idea: **doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves**, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.

A **fully online bank** where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with **agile methodologies**.

We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of **Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging** to foster a culture of **collaboration and innovation** that represents all collectives in the society.

**En ING buscamos un/a Customer Journey Expert – Gestión Discrecional de Carteras**
===================================================================================

  
  

**Tu rol y entorno de trabajo:**

  
  

ING Bank está entrando en el segmento de Banca Privada en España, un gran mercado que gestiona más de 600.000 millones de euros de patrimonio de los hogares y que muestra una tasa de crecimiento anual del 4 %. ING Bank está en proceso de lanzar una nueva propuesta integral adaptada a clientes de Banca Privada con una alta afinidad digital. Únete a nosotros para dar forma al futuro de la banca para Banca Privada e Inversiones en España.

  
  

ING España está desarrollando una nueva propuesta de Gestión Discrecional de Carteras (DPM, por sus siglas en inglés) como componente clave de su oferta de Banca Privada. Buscamos un/a **Customer Journey Expert** con un enfoque práctico para incorporarse al equipo de DPM, ayudar a completar la implementación y cerrar las brechas existentes, así como contribuir a la evolución continua del producto.

  
  

Contribuirás a lo largo del **journey end-to-end de DPM**, desde los requisitos y las pruebas hasta la implementación, la formación a bankers y la mejora continua. Trabajando estrechamente con el Product Owner y el resto del equipo, conectarás las necesidades de clientes y bankers con los requisitos tecnológicos, operativos y regulatorios.

  
  

Trabajarás en un **entorno altamente internacional y transversal**, colaborando con **One Investment Platform** y con equipos de Inversiones, Tecnología, Operaciones, Data, Finanzas, Riesgos, Legal y Compliance.

  
  

Este es un **rol de Customer Journey Expert con un enfoque práctico dentro del equipo de DPM**, que combina delivery de producto, experiencia de cliente y soporte a bankers. Asumirás la responsabilidad de las actividades acordadas y contribuirás a las mejoras del producto, mientras que la gestión y priorización del backlog seguirán siendo responsabilidad del Product Owner.

  
  

**Tus principales responsabilidades:**

  
  

Contribuirás al **delivery de DPM, las mejoras del día a día del producto y su evolución futura** mediante las siguientes actividades:

* **Completar el delivery pendiente de DPM:** Definir y refinar requisitos de negocio, documentar user stories y criterios de aceptación, y trabajar con los equipos de tecnología y operaciones para llevar a producción las funcionalidades pendientes.
* **Cerrar las brechas existentes:** Identificar y analizar brechas funcionales, operativas y del customer journey, ayudar a definir soluciones prácticas y realizar el seguimiento de las acciones acordadas hasta su resolución.
* **Dar soporte a las pruebas y la implementación:** Preparar y ejecutar pruebas de negocio end-to-end y pruebas de aceptación de usuario, realizar el seguimiento de defectos y apoyar la preparación de releases y la validación posterior a la implementación.
* **Formar y dar soporte a bankers:** Preparar materiales prácticos de formación y guías de producto, impartir sesiones de formación sobre DPM y recopilar el feedback de bankers para mejorar tanto el servicio como el journey asistido.
* **Contribuir a la evolución del producto:** Ayudar a definir e implementar nuevas funcionalidades de DPM y mejoras de la propuesta, incluyendo pDPM, en línea con el roadmap del producto y las prioridades acordadas con el Product Owner.
* **Mejorar la experiencia digital y asistida:** Trabajar con los equipos de UX, diseño y tecnología en mejoras visuales, información más clara sobre las carteras y customer journeys más sencillos, alineados con la Experiencia Digital de Banca Privada.
* **Mantener la coherencia del servicio end-to-end:** Colaborar con Inversiones, One Investment Platform, las tribus de producto de retail y las funciones de control para alinear procesos, comunicaciones con clientes y transiciones operativas a medida que evoluciona DPM.
  

  

Como **Customer Journey Expert** eres responsable de:

* **Experiencia de Cliente:** Ofrecer la **mejor experiencia de cliente** diseñando, mapeando y mejorando constantemente el customer journey. Con una visión end-to-end del proceso, ser capaz de recopilar datos y aspectos relacionados con CX y traducirlos a entornos de UX e IT.
* **Estrategia Digital:** Como especialista en experiencia digital, ser proactivo/a en la identificación de nuevas funcionalidades en nuestra plataforma digital para **involucrar a nuestros clientes** y aumentar la **eficiencia** de nuestros canales asistidos, ofreciendo la mejor experiencia en los momentos de la verdad.
* **Soporte Comercial:** Colaborar con marketing, los equipos de interacción con clientes y bankers para trasladar la propuesta de valor de DPM a comunicaciones claras para clientes y materiales prácticos de apoyo, incorporando el feedback del canal asistido.
* **Fluidez con Datos:** Comprender, definir, seleccionar y analizar datos para obtener insights que mejoren el **proceso de toma de decisiones**. Utilizar datos de producto y del journey, junto con el feedback de clientes y bankers, para identificar brechas, evaluar mejoras y contribuir a análisis equilibrados de coste-beneficio antes y después de la implementación.
* **Agile Delivery:** Traducir las necesidades de negocio en requisitos claros, user stories y criterios de aceptación. Trabajar en los elementos priorizados por el Product Owner, contribuir al refinamiento y entregar las actividades acordadas en ciclos cortos junto con el equipo. Identificar dependencias, riesgos e impedimentos de manera temprana, apoyar su resolución y utilizar las pruebas y el feedback para mejorar las soluciones reduciendo al mismo tiempo la complejidad.
  

  

**¿Qué buscamos?**

  
  

¿Quieres saber si este puesto está hecho para ti? Estas son algunas de las cualidades que más valoramos para este rol. Y si encajan contigo… ¡no dudes en presentar tu candidatura!

  
  

**Una persona pionera de la cultura agile que demuestre los siguientes comportamientos:**

Capacidad para mostrar flexibilidad hacia los equipos y adaptar los planes, el enfoque y el comportamiento a las diferentes necesidades y situaciones.

* Capacidad para asumir la responsabilidad de los entregables acordados y contribuir a las decisiones del equipo basándose en hechos, datos y feedback de clientes.

Gran resiliencia: capacidad para desenvolverse en entornos de ambigüedad.

* Habilidades de negociación.
* Sólidas habilidades de planificación y organización, con capacidad para realizar el seguimiento de las actividades de delivery y de los asuntos pendientes hasta su finalización.
* Pasión por la innovación, las nuevas tendencias del mercado y los productos de inversión.
* Habilidades de comunicación claras, tanto escritas como orales.
* Capacidad para trabajar a nivel internacional.
* Excelente nivel de inglés oral y escrito.
* Capacidad para trabajar en equipo.
* Pasión por colaborar con diferentes personas.
* Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y tomar la iniciativa.
* Capacidad para hacer que las cosas sucedan gracias a una actitud «can do».
  

  

**Experiencia demostrable y habilidades técnicas**

* Titulación universitaria; contar con un máster relacionado con finanzas también será un plus.
* Más de 5 años de experiencia profesional en banca.
* Experiencia con productos de inversión y/o customer journeys de Banca Privada; estar familiarizado/a con DPM será un plus.
* Experiencia en gestión omnicanal de la experiencia.
* Conocimientos de técnicas de investigación y diseño de productos UX serán un plus.
* Experiencia práctica traduciendo necesidades de negocio en requisitos y dando soporte a pruebas de aceptación de usuario e implementación.
* Capacidad para explicar productos y procesos de inversión de forma clara y preparar materiales prácticos de formación para bankers.
* Sólido dominio del inglés escrito y hablado.
  

  

**¿Qué ofrecemos?**

  
  

El tiempo que pasas en el trabajo, los retos a los que te enfrentas o las lecciones que aprendes son muy importantes, pero… ¿qué pasa con tu vida personal? En ING queremos que tu trabajo te llene en todos los sentidos, y por eso cuidamos hasta el más mínimo detalle.

¡Descubre todo lo que te espera!

  
  

**Balance That Works.**
  
Ponemos el equilibrio a trabajar para que tú también puedas hacerlo. Teniendo en cuenta primero las necesidades de nuestros clientes, las del equipo y las tuyas propias, acordamos cuándo venir a ING MAD y cuándo es mejor trabajar desde casa. Más tiempo juntos cuando importa, más libertad cuando la necesitas.

  
  

**Tarjeta restaurante.**
  
Para que pensar qué comer no te quite tiempo ni te quite las ganas.

  
  

**Nuestra casa será tu hogar.**
  
En nuestras oficinas podrás encontrar soluciones de movilidad eléctrica, servicio médico, peluquería, gimnasio, The Good Service (para ayudarte con tus gestiones) ¡y mucho más!

  
  

**Seguro médico.**
  
Para ti y toda tu familia (cónyuge/pareja e hijos/as).

  
  

**Seguro de vida.**
  
Te ayudamos a proteger lo que más te importa.

  
  

**Retribución flexible.**
  
Además, disfrutarás de nuestro modelo de retribución flexible, a través del cual y de una forma fiscalmente más ventajosa podrás acceder a otros servicios como guardería, tarjeta de transporte, ayudas para formación…

  
  

**Transporte gratuito de empresa.**
  
No importa dónde vivas. Disponemos de 6 rutas (Norte, Centro, Sur, A5, A42 y A6) para que puedas llegar cómodamente a nuestra oficina de ING en Madrid.

  
  

**Beneficios bancarios.**
  
Préstamos especiales con condiciones más ventajosas.
  
Condiciones hipotecarias especiales tras 6 meses trabajando en el banco.
  
¡Y podrás beneficiarte de nuestro plan de pensiones después de 1 mes con nosotros!

  
  

**Más vitalidad y más sentimiento de pertenencia**

Cuidado 360º del/de la empleado/a (bienestar físico, mental, conexión social y propósito).
  
Servicio de fisioterapia en las instalaciones.
  
Clínicas con deportistas profesionales de primer nivel.
  
Servicio Gympass.
  
Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.
  
Programa internacional de trabajo en remoto.

  
  

**Conócenos**

Somos un equipo de más de 1.900 personas que compartimos una misma idea: **aportar nuestro granito de arena para ayudar a nuestros clientes a crear un futuro mejor para sí mismos**, proporcionándoles las herramientas que necesitan para llegar adonde quieren.

  
  

Un **banco completamente online** donde la tecnología, la innovación, la sencillez y la transparencia son los ingredientes principales, y el primero en trabajar con **metodologías agile**.

  
  

Y aunque estamos en España, **tenemos la suerte de trabajar en un banco internacional con presencia en más de 35 países.**

Estamos orgullosos de contar con un equipo diverso y estamos comprometidos con seguir desarrollando una cultura de **Diversidad, Inclusión y Pertenencia** para fomentar una cultura de **colaboración e innovación** que represente a todos los colectivos de la sociedad.

  
  

Y aunque por fuera nos veas naranjas, **por dentro somos verdes**. Nuestra ambición en materia de Sostenibilidad es **Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey**. Estamos emprendiendo nuestro propio camino, por nosotros, pero también estamos ahí cuando nuestros clientes deciden emprender este viaje.

  
  

**Hacer que las cosas sucedan, ayudar a los demás a tener éxito y estar siempre un paso por delante: ese es nuestro ADN.** Si te miras al espejo y tu reflejo encaja con nuestra forma de ser y trabajar… ¡estamos deseando conocerte!

*En ING, perteneces tal y como eres. Contratamos y apoyamos a las personas por su talento y potencial, y sabemos que cuando puedes ser tú mismo/a, haces tu mejor trabajo.*

  
  

**Recordatorio de seguridad para candidaturas**

Estamos observando un aumento de ofertas de empleo fraudulentas. Para protegerte, sigue estas pautas clave al presentar tu candidatura a puestos de ING:

* **Presenta tu candidatura únicamente a través de las plataformas oficiales de ING:** ING utiliza **Workday** y **LinkedIn** como sistema interno de selección. Las candidaturas deben enviarse **únicamente a través de nuestra web oficial de carreras profesionales o de las ofertas de empleo de ING publicadas en LinkedIn**.
* **Comprueba cuidadosamente el correo electrónico de quien te escribe:** Las comunicaciones legítimas siempre procederán de **@ing.com** y/o **@myworkday.com**.
* **Nunca te solicitaremos pagos ni datos bancarios:** Si alguien te pide esta información, se trata de un fraude.

title: Global Permitting & Approvals Manager
description:
### **About the company**

**About the company**

**Utopia** is an ultra-luxury hospitality and lifestyle brand creating a global ecosystem of properties and experiences.

We develop private villa retreats in beautiful locations around the world, each with high-end service. **Utopia** also offers a wider ecosystem of leisure experiences and services available both to those staying on property and to external visitors.

**Utopia** designs and builds its properties in-house. Our projects span the full journey: from concept and architecture to construction, interiors, landscape, guest experience, and long-term operation. For architects and designers, this means contributing on properties from the ground up, with the ability to influence how each place is planned, built, and experienced. For hospitality professionals, it means collaborating with a brand where service is personal, attentive, and built around each guest’s stay.

We’re a young, ambitious team with high standards and a hands-on approach. We value strong ideas, practical thinking, attention to detail, and people who are ready to take ownership of their part of each project. If you’re interested in architecture, design, hospitality, or guest experience, we invite you to explore opportunities with **Utopia.**

**About the role**

We are looking for a hands-on Global Permitting & Approvals Manager to lead permitting and regulatory approvals across our international development portfolio.

You will research local requirements, translate them into clear technical tasks for project teams, coordinate AORs and local consultants, and drive approval processes through to completion.

This role requires independent problem-solving, strong execution skills and the ability to establish effective processes in a fast-moving international environment.

Projects span Spain, South Africa, Brazil, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, the UAE and other locations, each with different regulatory requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Own permitting and regulatory approvals across multiple countries and projects.
* Research local regulations and establish approval strategies and schedules.
* Translate statutory requirements into technical documentation tasks for internal teams.
* Participate in selecting and managing local AORs and permitting consultants.
* Coordinate application submissions, authority comments and final approvals.
* Identify critical risks, resolve blockers and protect construction milestones.
* Implement standardized permitting processes and portfolio-wide reporting.

  
**Requirements**  

* Hands-on construction permitting experience in at least two countries and three project locations.
* Proven record of personally securing development or construction approvals.
* Experience of permitting in at least 2 of selected locations: Spain, South Africa, Brazil, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, the UAE
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and technical submission documentation.
* Experience managing local AORs, consultants and government authorities.
* Ability to research new jurisdictions and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong ownership, analytical thinking and process-building capabilities.
* Fluent English

**Nice to Have**

* Spanish and/or Portuguese.
* Hands-on permitting experience in Spain, Brazil, Latin America, the UAE, or South Africa.
* Background in luxury residential or hospitality development.

  
**Benefits**  

* **Fully remote with business trips.** You'll collaborate from anywhere within GMT-3 to GMT+3.
* **All the tools you need.** A laptop and access to our project and documentation tools from day one.
* **Properties across three continents.** You'll take projects through approval in Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and Latin America, so you won't be limited to one market, one regulator, or one type of permit.
* **A team that spans 30+ countries.** Developers, architects, engineers, and legal specialists from every corner of the world, held to the same standards and the same bar for quality.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

title: Product Expert - Vault Safety
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

### **The Role**

Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Safety (Pharmacovigilance) domain to drive customer success with our Veeva Safety Suite products.

As part of the Veeva Safety product team and collaborating with broader global Product Experts, your experience will play a key role in the Product organization. You will:

* Build and nurture highly engaged user communities by maintaining regular communication across various forums to deliver clear, impactful messaging that drives shared understanding, encourages product adoption, and enhances customer value
* Represent the Product organization in customer meetings, online communities, with internal team education and at industry events – driving increased customer value through release education and product capability promotion
* Serve as the Voice of the Customer, capturing their needs and industry intelligence before sharing insights with product managers. This helps to guide product decisions and design improvements, ultimately delivering better Safety solutions that drive regulatory compliance and operational efficiency
* Develop rich relationships with key product users / influencers
* Collaborate effectively with Veeva field teams to drive customer success, product excellence, best practices (Good Vault Practice) and Veeva success!

This role is ideal for someone passionate about Pharmacovigilance, eager to collaborate with customers, and excited to drive their success.

### **What You'll Do**

* Be the product evangelist, providing subject matter expertise for the Veeva Safety products and champion for Veeva's key product enhancements
* Contribute to best practices and process recommendations within the Veeva Safety products
* Stay up to date with the latest features and roadmap direction
* Engage with customer stakeholders to communicate our product roadmaps and vision
* Provide product education to Veeva Safety customers in our online communities (Veeva Connect) and a range of in-person forums; Ensuring we are communicating the problems we are solving, value delivered and product functionality.
* Act as the customer advocate by collecting, analyzing and prioritizing their feedback to contribute to future product innovations, helping to inform product roadmaps. Be a customer advocate internally!
* Collaborate with Product teams to create effective release communications and resources.
* Provide cross-functional support to internal teams, including Services, Strategy, Sales, and Product Support.

### **Requirements**

* 5+ years within the life sciences industry, ideally within Pharmacovigilance (Safety)
* Experience in using and/or implementing Safety applications and processes including substantial experience working with case processing, safety operations, aggregate reporting and signal management
* Ability to understand customer business requirements and to translate them to technical product requirements, preferences, and limitations – communicated to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to understand product vision, technical specifications and software development documentation, and translate them into language and content relevant for end users and business teams.
* Strong organizational, analytical and communication/ English skills (written, verbal, and formal presentations). Ability to understand and engage technical users (safety scientists, data analysts).
* Prior experience leading workshops and product discovery, displaying high levels of curiosity
* A strong passion for emerging technologies (specifically AI) and the ability to quickly grasp, articulate, and conceptualize how AI-driven features can solve related real-world challenges (including some exposure to AI in driving efficiencies in your existing role and/ or optimizing workflows)
* SQL & PV Data Mastery: Proficiency writing and auditing complex SQL queries (AI-assisted coding experience a plus).
* Self-directed team player with a positive attitude and strong sense of ownership.
* Willingness to travel up to 25%.
* Based in Europe with ability to work across time-zones.

### **Nice to Have**

* Veeva Product experience (including Veeva Safety / case processing)
* Statistical Signal Detection: Understanding of the statistical algorithms used in quantitative signal detection, such as Disproportionality Analysis (PRR, ROR, EBGM).
* Experience performing software demonstrations
* Creating engaging videos with familiarity with video recording/ editing software (e.g. Camtasia)

Note: Veeva will consider applicants from European countries where Veeva has representatives.

### **Interviewing with Veeva**

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

* Follow the application process and submit your resume.
* Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
* Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
* If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

  + A conversation with the hiring manager
  + A practical case exercise
  + A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
* Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

### **Compensation**

* Total compensation: 70,000-140,000 EUR
* The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

title: AI & Cybersecurity Conformity Assessment Specialist – Machinery Safety
description:
**Company Description**

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over **2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries**, supported **by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals**. We proudly deliver our **expert services** through the **SGS name** and a portfolio of **trusted specialized brands**, including **Applied Technical Services**, **Brightsight**, **Bluesign** and **Nutrasource**.

 **Job Description**

**Main Purpose of Role**

* Act as the One NoBo technical reference for the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (focusing on cyber resilience and AI), owning interpretations, procedures and templates applied consistently across all SGS notifications and executing affiliates.
* Qualify, authorise and monitor certification personnel under the One NoBo competence scheme, enabling EU-bound certification to be delivered locally under EU notifications.
* Lead the adoption of digital and AI tools in the certification process, keeping every conformity-assessment decision under qualified human control.
* Bridge One NoBo with SGS notified capacity in Spain, including the Rail Notified Body.

**Key Accountabilities**

* **AI-enabled machinery –** Build SGS assessment capability for machinery and safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning (Annex I Part A), and for the AI-related health and safety requirements being added to the Regulation through Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.
* **Cybersecurity of machinery –** Build SGS assessment capability for protection against corruption and for the safety and reliability of control systems (Annex III, sections 1.1.9 and 1.2.1), including the interface with the Cyber Resilience Act and the IEC 62443 series.
* **Technical review and decision –** Perform technical file reviews and, once qualified, take certification decisions for machinery files routed under the selected SGS notification, in line with ISO/IEC 17065.
* **Technical advisory –** Develop and deliver technical advisory services on the Machinery Regulation, including AI and cyber requirements, for SGS affiliates and clients, kept strictly separate from the certification of the same clients in line with ISO/IEC 17065 impartiality requirements.
* **SGS NoBos network –** Develop, release and maintain One NoBo procedures, checklists and certificate templates, harmonising practice across SGS Notified Bodies and supporting their international collaboration.
* **Competence and qualification –** Own the One NoBo competence matrix (person × scope × authorisation) in ProCert; define qualification criteria, perform witness assessments and monitor evaluators in executing affiliates, including SGS China.
* **Accreditation and notification –** Support accreditation assessments and notifying-authority applications for machinery scope; represent SGS in the European coordination group of Notified Bodies for machinery (NB-M) and apply its Recommendations for Use.
* **Authorised affiliates –** Plan and perform One NoBo process assessments of authorised affiliates against the One NoBo Policy, follow up findings and report results to the One NoBo Committee.
* **AI in certification –** Act as product owner for AI-assisted certification workflows (AI Bot portfolio, ProCert integrations): define requirements, validate outputs, manage data governance and ensure AI never issues deliverables or takes conformity decisions.
* **Platform and KPIs –** Act as ProCert key user for machinery workflows; monitor turnaround time, certificates issued and resource utilisation through Power BI and drive corrective actions.
* **Collaboration with SGS Spain –** Work with SGS Spain, including the Rail Notified Body, to share experience and qualified resources and to align processes within the One NoBo framework.
* At all times, comply with SGS Code of Integrity and Professional Conduct and with the impartiality requirements of the Notified Body.

  
**Qualifications**

**Core Competencies**

* Sound technical judgement, impartiality and integrity
* Structured, evidence-based and documented decision-making
* Delivery focused, biased to action
* Learning agility with digital and AI tools
* Strong collaboration across cultures in a matrix organisation
* Clear written and verbal communication, including to authorities and accreditation bodies
* Self-motivated and able to work independently

**Skills & Knowledge**

* **NoBo framework –** In-depth knowledge of the New Legislative Framework (Regulation (EC) 765/2008, Decision 768/2008/EC), the Blue Guide, and the role, obligations and impartiality requirements of Notified Bodies.
* **Accreditation –** ISO/IEC 17065 in depth; working knowledge of ISO/IEC 17020, 17021-1 and 17025 and of competence management in conformity assessment bodies.
* **Machinery Regulation –** Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, including the essential health and safety requirements of Annex III and the conformity assessment procedures; Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and the transition between the two.
* **Machinery standards –** EN ISO 12100, EN ISO 13849-1/-2, EN IEC 62061 and relevant type-C standards; functional safety assessment (PL/SIL) of safety-related control systems.
* **Cyber and software –** Protection against corruption and safety and reliability of control systems under the Regulation; IEC 62443 series; interplay with the Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847).
* **AI regulation –** Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), in particular high-risk AI systems as safety components of products, and its integration into the Machinery Regulation through Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.
* **AI technical –** Machine-learning lifecycle, data quality, verification and validation of AI-based safety functions; ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894 and ISO/IEC TR 5469.
* **AI tools –** Practical use of generative AI tools, prompt design, and the ability to specify, test and validate AI-assisted workflows with appropriate data protection.
* **Digital –** Certification management platforms (ProCert or similar), Power BI, SharePoint; Python or low-code automation is an advantage.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5 years in a Notified Body or conformity assessment body for machinery (technical file review, EC/EU type-examination, quality system assessment), with documented qualification as assessor or reviewer.
* Direct experience of accreditation assessments and notifying-authority processes.
* Experience in functional safety assessment of machinery control systems.
* Experience in deploying or validating digital or AI tools in a regulated or technical environment – advantageous.
* Experience working with international affiliates, including APAC, in a matrix organisation – advantageous.
* Exposure to the Rail Interoperability Directive (EU) 2016/797 – advantageous.

**Qualifications**

* Must – Master's degree in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics or automation engineering, or equivalent.
* Must – business-grade English and fluent Spanish.
* Desirable – functional safety qualification (e.g. FS Engineer, CMSE).
* Desirable – formal AI training or qualification (e.g. ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, machine-learning coursework).
* Desirable – Auditor/Lead Auditor qualification (ISO 19011) issued by an accredited body; additional language capability.

**Performance Indicators & Deliverables**

* Machinery Regulation procedures and templates released in ProCert and in use within 6 months of onboarding.
* Number of resources qualified and authorised for machinery under One NoBo (including China) versus annual plan.
* Turnaround time of machinery files routed through One NoBo versus annual target.
* Share of machinery projects managed in ProCert (target 100%).
* No major findings on machinery scope in accreditation and notification assessments.
* AI-assisted workflows validated and deployed, with measured time saved and no conformity decisions taken by AI.
* Process assessments of authorised affiliates completed as planned.

  
**Additional Information**

* Enjoy a flexible schedule and remote work model with some visits per month to our office in Madrid.
* Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.

Unlike traditional rule-based chatbots, our AI agents can understand context, reason across multiple steps, and execute actions on behalf of customers. Your challenge will be to make these capabilities accessible through conversations that feel natural, trustworthy, and effortless.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Conversational Experience Design**

* Design end-to-end conversational experiences for AI agents, primarily focused on voice interactions.
* Define conversation flows, dialogue patterns, agent personality, tone of voice, and communication guidelines.
* Design natural interactions that account for interruptions, ambiguity, clarifications, context retention, and unexpected user behavior.
* Create effective fallback strategies, error recovery mechanisms, and seamless escalation to human agents.
* Ensure conversational experiences are accessible, inclusive, and aligned with customer expectations.

**Agentic AI Experience Design**

* Translate complex business processes into intuitive conversational journeys that leverage autonomous AI capabilities.
* Design interactions where AI agents can gather information, make decisions, execute actions, and guide users through multi-step processes.
* Define appropriate conversational boundaries, confirmation mechanisms, and user control over AI-driven actions.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize agent instructions, conversational behaviors, and orchestration from a UX perspective.
* Balance conversational flexibility with predictability, reliability, and business requirements.

**UX Research & Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze customer journeys, use cases, and user needs to identify opportunities for conversational automation.
* Conduct conversation reviews, usability testing, and iterative design improvements.
* Analyze transcripts and interaction metrics to identify friction, misunderstandings, and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with engineering and customer teams to continuously refine conversational experiences based on real-world usage.
* Help define and track conversational quality metrics, including task completion, containment, customer satisfaction, and interaction efficiency.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work alongside Forward Deployed Engineers to design and implement conversational experiences for enterprise customers.
* Participate in customer workshops to understand business requirements, user expectations, and operational constraints.
* Collaborate with product and AI engineering teams to align conversational design with platform capabilities.
* Produce clear design documentation, conversation flows, sample dialogues, and behavioral guidelines.
* Advocate for human-centered design principles throughout the development lifecycle.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Experience in Conversational UX Design, Voice UX Design, Conversation Design, or a closely related discipline.
* Hands-on experience designing conversational interfaces such as voice assistants, virtual agents, or AI-powered chatbots.
* Strong understanding of conversational design principles, dialogue management, and user-centered design methodologies.
* Experience creating conversation flows, dialogue scripts, and conversational prototypes.
* Familiarity with Natural Language Understanding (NLU), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Generative AI.
* Ability to translate complex requirements into clear, intuitive conversational experiences.
* Experience analyzing user interactions and using qualitative or quantitative insights to improve UX.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and customers.
* Professional proficiency in English.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience designing conversational experiences for contact centers, customer service, or enterprise automation.
* Practical experience with LLM-powered conversational agents and agentic AI systems.
* Familiarity with prompt design, AI behavioral instructions, and conversational guardrails.
* Understanding of voice-specific technologies and challenges, including speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS), latency, and turn-taking.
* Experience working with conversational AI platforms such as Talkdesk, Google Dialogflow, Cognigy, or similar solutions.
* Familiarity with conversational analytics, intent classification, and knowledge-base optimization.
* Experience in consulting, customer-facing delivery, or multidisciplinary technology projects.
* Additional languages, particularly Spanish or Portuguese.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* AI agents deliver natural, coherent, and effective conversational experiences.
* Customers can successfully complete complex tasks through intuitive voice interactions.
* Conversational friction, unnecessary repetitions, and failed interactions are progressively reduced.
* Engineering teams receive clear, actionable conversational design specifications.
* Conversational experiences are continuously improved using real customer interactions and measurable outcomes.

We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive our success and every voice belongs. Combining the stability of a global leader with the agility of a disruptor, Talkdeskers are empowered with the autonomy to drive meaningful impact, while giving back to the communities and environment around us.

title: Senior ML & AI Engineer
description:
At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed.

We are looking for a **Senior ML & AI Engineer** to join us as part of our team.

### **About the role**

PitchBook’s Machine Learning Engineer is responsible for using machine learning, statistical modeling, and natural language processing (NLP) to collect a high-volume of data for the PitchBook Platform and surface insights for the capital markets. This role will also serve as a resource and mentor for junior members of the team. A strong motivation to succeed is critical and everyone has the opportunity to shape the long-term direction of our team.

**About the project**

PitchBook — a platform for investment professionals. Our software provides access to data and the analytical tools to get answers fast and discover promising opportunities. Uncovers actionable insights and trends hidden within the financial data of more than three million companies. Users all over the world include large corporations, start-ups, venture capital and private equity firms, investment banks, and many others. Features of PitchBook: Advanced search / Discovery & insights / Company profiles / Workflow & efficiency / Financials and many more.

**Team**

1 EM, 6 ML Engineers

The role offers a flexible work schedule, allowing you to adapt your working hours with the requirement to attend all team meetings. The team follows a Scrum-based Agile methodology.

Use PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and Spacy to build NLP pipelines. Implement vector databases for high-dimensional data embeddings and develop hybrid models to extract insights from diverse data sources.

Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling client growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients.

Enjoy the freedom of fully remote work with a flexible working schedule. Empower yourself with a stable workload and a stable income, supported by provided laptops and licensed software. We focus on lasting cooperation and unite result-oriented individuals who stand on a high-performance approach to work.

Benefit from performance and merit reviews, elevate your skills with personal development plans, and individual learnings through the corporate library, public speaking support, and more.

Work with a team of one mind who cares about what they do and how they do. Collaborate with top-notch experts who are always ready to help and support you through any challenges.
