title: Head Chef - Lucia Marbella Beach Club
description:
**Join the Nikki Beach Hospitality Group!**

**Position:** Head Chef – Lucia Marbella Beach Club  
**Location:** Marbella, Spain  
**Contract:** Full-time, permanent, year-round  
**Start Date:** Ideally January 2027, with earlier availability welcomed

 **Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, creative, and passionate Head Chef to lead the culinary operations at Lucia Marbella Beach Club.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key leadership role in shaping the culinary identity of Lucia, delivering exceptional dining experiences that reflect the concept's vibrant Mediterranean spirit and commitment to luxury hospitality.

Working closely with the Regional and Corporate Executive Chef, the Head Chef will oversee all aspects of kitchen operations, from menu development and culinary innovation to team leadership, financial performance, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional culinary expertise with strong leadership and business acumen, thriving in a dynamic, high-volume luxury hospitality environment.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute innovative menus aligned with the Lucia culinary concept, in collaboration with the Regional and Corporate Chef.
* Ensure exceptional standards of food quality, presentation, consistency, and guest satisfaction.
* Incorporate fresh, seasonal, and locally sourced ingredients while maintaining the concept's culinary identity.
* Continuously identify opportunities to enhance the dining experience through creativity and innovation.
* Maintain consistency in culinary execution across all services, including peak operational periods and special events.

* Oversee daily kitchen operations, ensuring efficiency, organization, and seamless service delivery.
* Manage food costs, inventory, purchasing, stock control, and waste reduction to achieve financial targets.
* Monitor kitchen budgets and operational performance, implementing improvements where necessary.
* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure product quality, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, HACCP, hygiene, and health and safety regulations.

* Recruit, train, mentor, and develop a high-performing culinary team.
* Foster a positive, collaborative, and professional working environment that encourages creativity, accountability, and excellence.
* Manage team scheduling, staffing levels, and productivity according to operational requirements.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations and identify opportunities for professional development.
* Lead by example, maintaining high standards of professionalism, discipline, and teamwork.

* Work closely with the Regional and Corporate Chef to ensure alignment with the group's culinary standards and strategic objectives.
* Collaborate with the General Manager, F&B leadership, and service teams to deliver an exceptional guest experience.
* Support special events, private functions, and culinary activations.
* Respond proactively to guest feedback and continuously improve culinary offerings.

 **What we offer**  

* Full company benefits package, including service charge and other applicable benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career development within an internationally renowned luxury hospitality group.

  
**What We're Looking For**

* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive culinary experience, including at least 2–3 years in a senior kitchen leadership position such as Head Chef or Executive Sous Chef.
* Proven experience in luxury hospitality, premium beach clubs, upscale restaurants, or internationally recognized dining concepts.
* Strong understanding of Mediterranean cuisine, seasonal ingredients, and contemporary culinary trends.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate multicultural culinary teams in high-volume environments.
* Excellent knowledge of food cost management, budgeting, inventory control, and kitchen profitability.
* Strong understanding of HACCP, food safety regulations, and operational best practices.
* Exceptional organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Creative, proactive, and hands-on leadership style with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to remain composed and deliver consistent results under pressure.
* Fluency in Spanish and professional working proficiency in English are highly desirable.
* Flexibility to work according to operational requirements, including weekends and holidays.

 **Why Join Nikki Beach?**

Established by Jack and Lucia Penrod, Nikki Beach Hospitality Group epitomizes barefoot luxury hospitality, curating transformative lifestyle experiences through its global collection of iconic beach clubs, hotels, resorts, residences, dining concepts, and pop-ups. Recognized among the world's best beach clubs and resorts, the brand continues to expand into new destinations and concepts, including Lucia, a restaurant and beach concept introduced in 2024.

For our team members, this means the chance to be part of a hospitality group with a celebrated 25-year legacy and an exciting future. Joining Nikki Beach Hospitality Group offers opportunities for growth and international exposure, with the ability to build a career across some of the world's most sought-after destinations. As part of the Nikki Beach family, you will help shape unforgettable moments and contribute to the future of luxury hospitality.

**Ready to bring your culinary vision to Lucia Marbella Beach Club? We would love to hear from you!**

**Nice to have:** experience at a higher education institution, or exposure to the startup/innovation ecosystem (incubators, accelerators, venture events).

Organizational accuracy and attention to detail

Handling queries with judgment, care and a consistent tone; knowing what to resolve directly and what to escalate to the AD

Booking rooms and vendors (e.g. catering), coordinating on-site logistics, and solving problems in real time during an event

Content & communication pieces

Producing clear, on-brand emails, slides and other materials for students and events

Front-office delivery

Comfortable speaking to groups and representing the Center in informational sessions

Administrative reliability

Accurately compiling and handing off invoices and paperwork to the Center's assistant; audit-ready recordkeeping

Process-mindedness

Noticing inefficiencies on the ground and feeding back practical suggestions, without owning process redesign

Excellent written and spoken English and Spanish (C1 or higher); clear, on-brand communication

Digital fluency

Comfort with CRM, scheduling and collaboration tools, and the curiosity to adopt new ones

Mindset

Proactive, service-oriented, resourceful and adaptable in a fast-moving, front-line environment

**Knowledge you should bring:**

* A thrive for entrepreneurship and innovation.
* Event and community management practices.

title: R&D Director – Ecosystem & Commerce
description:
**Location:** Spain (preferred), MEA (Lebanon subject to local employment requirements)

**Publication Date:** 19/11/2026

If you apply, please include your CV.

  

We are looking for an **R&D Director – Ecosystem & Commerce** to join the Cargo Business Unit leadership team.

Together with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce, this role builds, runs and scales the businesses that surround Cargospot, connect it and monetise it. Product defines what we build and why; this role owns how it is built, run and scaled.
  
  
It is also CHAMP’s lead role for AI-native engineering: making MCP and agentic access a core capability of our products, and making AI a standard part of how every CHAMP team designs, builds, tests and ships software.

**Mission**

Build and lead the Ecosystem & Commerce R&D organisation and own the technology end to end, from architecture and cloud to delivery and operations, for four lines of business:

* **Joint Business & Interline Middleware —** the leading and largest interline and joint-business system for air cargo;
* **Cargospot Pay —** a new line of business with the ambition to become the number one payment provider in air cargo;
* **MCP & Agentic Layer —** the AI-native access layer that lets customers, partners and their AI agents use Cargospot products;
* **Booking Portals & APIs —** the digital channels and APIs through which the market quotes, books, tracks and pays with Cargospot airlines.
  

In parallel, lead the adoption of AI across CHAMP’s software development lifecycle.

**Why This Role**

* **Build, not inherit —** Build a new R&D organisation and platform around four growth businesses, with the mandate to set its architecture, standards and culture.
* **Global scale from day one —** Work from an installed base of over 200 airlines and GSAs and some 5,600 forwarders and GHAs, with real data and real transaction volumes from day one.
* **Shape AI at CHAMP —** Lead MCP, agentic products and AI-assisted engineering for the whole company, not just one team.
* **Stability and visibility —** A profitable company within the SITA Group, a seat on the Cargo Business Unit leadership team and direct exposure to EXCO.

##### **Responsibilities :**

*R&D Organisation and Leadership*

* Build and lead the Ecosystem & Commerce R&D organisation: engineering managers, tech leads, architects, developers, QA and SRE/cloud engineers, across locations and time zones.
* Define team topology, roles, career paths for leadership and senior IC tracks, and a strong hiring bar; lead senior engineering hiring and talent development.
* Build an ownership-driven, high-velocity engineering culture with strict quality standards; define and support the staff retention plan aligned with CHAMP objectives.
  

*Delivery of the Ecosystem & Commerce Portfolio*

* Own engineering delivery for joint-business and interline middleware, Cargospot Pay, the MCP and agentic layer, and booking portals and APIs, against the roadmap set with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce.
* Plan capacity, sequence releases and keep committed dates credible; make trade-offs, risks and dependencies visible early.
* Productise integration: standard connectors, reusable patterns and API standards that reduce the time and cost of every new airline, partner and integration.
* Support the COO’s delivery organisation with technical leadership on implementations, and pre-sales and RFP/RFI responses with architecture and technical answers.
  

*Architecture, Cloud and Technology Ownership*

* Own the overall architecture and technology roadmap for the Ecosystem & Commerce portfolio: integration layer, event-driven and API-first design, data model and platform services, aligned with Neo and the Director of Engineering & Platform.
* Own the cloud estate for this area: infrastructure, environments, cost management (FinOps), scalability and multi-region deployment.
* Own production reliability and operations: SRE practices, observability, incident management, availability and performance targets, and disaster recovery.
* Ensure security and compliance by design, including identity and access, data protection and, for Cargospot Pay, payment-industry requirements such as PCI DSS.
* Lead build, partner or buy assessments and the technical side of strategic partnerships, including payment providers and integration partners.
  

  

*MCP and Agentic Layer*

* Architect and build the MCP and agentic layer around Cargospot products, so customers’, partners’ and CHAMP’s own AI agents can securely discover, consume and transact through our APIs.
* Define the standards for agent access: authentication and authorisation, guardrails, auditability, rate limiting and usage metering.
* Build shared AI services that other CHAMP product lines can reuse.
  

*AI in the SDLC across CHAMP*

* Lead and promote AI-assisted engineering across CHAMP: tools, skills and plugins for coding, code review, testing, triage and documentation.
* Define the governance that keeps AI-assisted delivery fast and safe: automated quality guardrails, test coverage, review policies and secure use of AI tools.
* Measure the impact with clear engineering metrics such as DORA, release reliability and capacity, and share practices and results with all R&D teams.
  

*Engineering Excellence*

* Own CI/CD, test automation, release management and engineering standards for the portfolio.
* Make R&D measurable: capacity, flow, quality and delivery metrics visible to product, BU leadership and EXCO.
  

*Working with Other Departments*

* Work as one team with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce: product defines, R&D builds and runs.
* Work closely with the Director of Engineering & Platform on shared platform services, architecture and cloud.
* Work closely with the COO’s delivery and support organisation on implementation, hypercare and support.
* Work closely with Security, Infrastructure and the CCO organisation on compliance, partnerships and customer commitments.
  

  
  
  

##### **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities :**

* Proven leadership of distributed R&D organisations of 20+ engineers across several teams, countries and time zones, including managers and tech leads.
* Deep experience with integration platforms and APIs: microservices, event-driven architecture, API standards and high-volume B2B integrations.
* Strong cloud-native engineering background: public cloud, containers, CI/CD, observability, SRE and cost management.
* Hands-on leadership of AI-assisted engineering and agentic architecture, including MCP server integration and AI tooling in the SDLC.
* Experience with payments or fintech platforms, digital booking or e-commerce channels is a strong plus.
* Air cargo, freight or logistics domain knowledge is a strong plus.
* Data-driven management of engineering performance; disciplined, with high standards of quality and delivery.
  

##### **Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience
  

*Employment is subject to satisfactory reference and background checks, where applicable and permitted by local law.*

### **Our culture and values**

We believe happy employees create thriving work environments. With over 500 team members from 32 countries, speaking over 30 languages, CHAMP is a uniquely diverse and welcoming place to work. Our globally minded staff collaborates with clients and vendors worldwide from our offices in London, Frankfurt, Manila, and our Headquarters in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.

The purpose of this role is to work closely with the Retail Leadership Team and several Country Leadership Teams to optimise and evolve our capability in labour planning and embed best practice for forecasting and scheduling in our Workforce Management system. The role will be the subject matter expert on Workforce Management for their allocated markets and will work with the most senior stakeholders in Retail to optimise the largest budget in Primark. The role will be responsible for identifying opportunities to deploy labour hours in a more meaningful way ensuring better outcomes for customers by placing the right people, in the right place, at the right time, working on the right tasks.

* Utilize the UKG Workforce Management System to optimize scheduling and ensure labour hours are prioritised toward high-value, customer-facing tasks.

* Minimum 4 years’ experience as a Store Manager or equivalent experience in alternative complex international retail role.
* Strong understanding of in store retail processes across all aspects of store operations.
* Detailed understanding of current store labour planning processes from forecasting, scheduling and in-day deployment and management of labour.

* Analytical mindset with the ability to assess risks and impacts quickly and make informed decisions.

description:
**About Mormedi**

We are a global boutique, strategic design and innovation consultancy. We help our clients create products, services, and experiences that delight customers and that fuel growth. By blending strategy, creativity, technology and business insight to design and deliver the most meaningful solutions.

**Our Mission:** To help businesses navigate change confidently.

We accomplish our mission by:

* Developing practical, human-centred solutions that drive growth, sustainability, and transformative impact;
* Making strategy and visions of the future tangible as a way to gain and maintain momentum;
* Establishing partnerships across industries for non-traditional approaches and better connected ecosystems;
* Creating strategies that help our clients lead the future with purpose.

**Our Values**

* **Long-term thinking:** We are passionate about finding the most profound, lasting opportunity in each innovation challenge, looking and testing from multiple angles.
* **Meaningful experiences:** We strive for positive impact in people's everyday lives by inviting diverse human perspectives and creating relevant and meaningful experiences.
* **Systemic elegance:** We believe that design can make a real difference when approached with a holistic, inclusive and sustainable mindset.
* **Maker mentality:** We can't help but make the abstract practical through visualization, models and prototypes to drive alignment and speed up progress.

**About the role**

**Role overview**  
As Relationship Associate, you will work at the heart of how Mormedi grows through trust: existing clients, referrals, our Senior Advisors network and the proposals that turn conversations into projects. Reporting directly to the Director of Clients, New Business and Institutional Relations, you will help nurture long-term relationships with senior executives and make sure every opportunity is followed through to a strong proposal.

**This role is for you if**  
You enjoy people as much as ideas. You like understanding what a client really needs, writing with precision, and being the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. You want to learn how long-term client relationships are built at the highest level.

**What you will own**

* **Client relationship management:** tracking key accounts, preparing meeting briefings, capturing next steps and following up so every conversation moves forward.
* **Account growth:** identifying new opportunities within existing clients and through referrals, and helping prepare proactive points of view to bring to them.
* **Senior Advisors network:** coordinating Mormedi's network of Senior Advisors, including the monthly advisor newsletter, introductions, meetings and follow-up on the opportunities they open.
* **Proposals and tenders:** analysing RFPs and public tenders, drafting proposal sections in English and Spanish, coordinating documentation and making sure every submission is complete and on time.
* **Content library:** maintaining a library of case studies, references, methodologies and team profiles ready for proposals.
* **Institutional relations:** supporting Mormedi's presence in business associations, institutional forums and executive gatherings.
* **Cross-disciplinary collaboration:** working with Strategic Design, Industrial Design, UX/UI and Business Innovation teams to align proposals with how projects are delivered.
* **Quality and Environmental standards (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001):** following Mormedi's Quality and Environmental Management System procedures in client documentation and proposals.

**How success is measured**

* **Proposals and client follow-up (~60%):** quality and timeliness of proposals, follow-up discipline and opportunities moved forward.
* **Relationships and network (~40%):** opportunities originated from existing clients, referrals and Senior Advisors, and quality of advisor engagement.

**What you bring**

* **Relationship mindset:** Natural ability to build trust and communicate with senior professionals.
* **Excellent writing:** Precise, elegant writing in English and Spanish, suitable for C-level audiences.
* **Structured thinking:** Ability to break down complex requirements and manage several workstreams at once.
* **Attention to detail:** You notice what is missing before anyone else does.
* **AI literacy:** Comfortable using Generative AI tools for drafting, translation and research, under strict confidentiality rules.

**Software & Tools**

* **Office Suite:** Microsoft Office (advanced Word and PowerPoint, Excel).
* **CRM:** Copper or similar.
* **Collaboration Platforms:** Miro or similar.
* **Nice to have:** Adobe InDesign.

**Languages**  
High professional proficiency in English and Spanish; Italian, German or French is highly appreciated.

**Qualifications**

* Final-year student or recent graduate in Business Administration, Law, International Relations, Communication or a related field.
* Eligibility for an internship agreement (convenio de prácticas).
* Valid work permit for Spain/Europe.

**What we offer**

* A six-month paid internship at our Madrid office, with a real possibility of joining the team afterwards.
* Direct work with the New Business leadership from the first week, without layers in between.
* Exposure to international clients and projects across aviation, rail, banking, energy and retail.
* A way of understanding business through design and innovation that very few places can teach.

VSI is a leading localisation company providing dubbing, subtitling, voice-over, and digital media services to the entertainment and corporate industries. Headquartered in London’s West End, with offices worldwide, VSI partners with some of the world’s leading global brands and content producers.

##### **About the role**

As Dubbing Production Supervisor, you will lead the dubbing project management team at our Spanish facility. You will make sure our international clients' projects are delivered efficiently and on time. You will work with colleagues across VSI's global network to bring high-quality Castilian and Catalan dubbed content to audiences.

This role suits someone who enjoys dubbing, likes coordinating several projects at once and is happy working with creative teams. You will find practical solutions in a dynamic environment. You will work closely with clients, suppliers, project managers, casting and production coordinators, the technical team and the Head of Account Management.

* Previous project management experience in localisation, media or a similar fast-paced production environment.

* A collaborative approach and the ability to coordinate multimedia requirements across production teams while keeping work consistent.
* Excellent organisation and the ability to prioritise when deadlines overlap.
* A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with sound problem-solving skills.
* Flexibility when requirements or priorities change at short notice.
* Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to client service.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Power BI reporting, with good general technology skills and the ability to support the testing and adoption of new systems.
* Availability and willingness to travel regularly between our Barcelona and Madrid facilities.

* Experience with OOONA or a similar project management platform.

At VSI, you will join a passionate, highly driven team helping entertainment travel the world. You will have the opportunity to work on high-profile global content, collaborate with talented colleagues and make a visible contribution in a creative, international and fast-moving environment.

We support people to grow their careers alongside experienced colleagues and some of the best talent in the localisation industry.

In this role, you will translate seasonal design directions and market trends into functional, consumer-focused, and commercially relevant products across categories such as neckwear, caps, knitted accessories, gloves, and socks.

Combining creativity, technical expertise, material knowledge, and sustainability, you will contribute to developing collections that reflect BUFF’s outdoor heritage and meet the evolving needs of consumers worldwide.

* Develop innovative outdoor accessory collections across categories such as neckwear, caps, knitted accessories, gloves, and socks.
* Ensure alignment with the seasonal creative direction defined by the Head of Design.

* Ensure design calendars, milestones, and deadlines are consistently met.
* Drive material selection in collaboration with Purchasing and suppliers to ensure quality, functionality, sustainability, and cost alignment.
* Support the use of natural, renewable, and recycled materials across collections whenever possible.
* Ensure all designs meet target FOB requirements and commercial objectives.
* Create and maintain accurate Tech Packs, fitting comments, and product documentation using PLM, Illustrator, and Photoshop.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Development, Purchasing, and other relevant stakeholders throughout the product creation process.

##### **About you:**

* Product Design/Textile formation.

* Good knowledge of Photoshop/Illustrator and Pack Office, CLO3D is a plus, any PLM system is a plus .

Permanent contract.

Competitive compensation: €35–45K gross base salary depending on experience and demonstrated skills + up to 10% performance-based bonus.

Flexible compensation: Save through benefits such as meals, transport, childcare and health insurance.

22 working days of holidays per year and 3 extra days off per collective agreement.

Birthday day off.

Fresh fruit & nuts available during the workday.

Commuting allowance for employees living more than 15 km from the office.

And more benefits on our website, because taking care of you goes beyond what we can fit in here.

Our employees are people with different strengths, experiences and backgrounds, who share a passion for the outdoors and believe in a more sustainable world. title: Expert Senior Manager, Process Excellence – Source to Pay (S2P)
description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
  
  
You will join the Process Excellence team within Bain’s Applied Technology & AI practice. The team helps clients rethink how they operate, combining deep process expertise with SAP and AI to deliver measurable business results. You will be embedded in multidisciplinary teams with Bain consultants and other experts in architecture, technology delivery, data science, engineering and design, serving leading companies across industries in large SAP S/4HANA and AI-enabled transformations.
  
  
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  
  
Mission
  
  

* Lead end-to-end Source to Pay transformations, from spend analysis, sourcing and contracting to supplier management, purchasing, invoicing and payment.
* Redesign S2P processes with AI built in, deciding where AI agents, machine learning and automation should run a task, support a person or stay out, with the goal of simple, touchless and well-controlled processes.
* Act as business architect and trusted advisor in SAP- and AI-enabled programs, making sure technology choices serve business outcomes rather than drive them.
* Shape the value case, operating model, governance and controls of S2P transformations, from early diagnostic through implementation and scale-up.
* Deliver measurable impact across procurement and accounts payable: savings, spend under management, compliance, productivity, user experience and working capital.

Essential functions
  
  

* Lead current-state diagnostics, fact base development and future-state blueprinting across the S2P process: spend analytics, category and sourcing strategy for direct and indirect spend, contract management, supplier onboarding and management, requisition to order, goods and service receipt, and invoice to pay.
* Define target-state process design and key design principles, including where to standardize globally and where local, statutory or control requirements call for variation.
* Identify, size and prioritize AI use cases along the S2P process, such as spend classification, sourcing and negotiation assistants, contract analysis, supplier risk monitoring, supplier collaboration on direct materials forecasts and orders, guided buying and AI-based request intake, invoice capture and matching, and agents that resolve exceptions or answer supplier queries.
* Advise clients on how AI is changing what they expect from procurement and accounts payable, and turn it into end-to-end S2P process redesign rather than isolated use cases.
* Design how people and AI agents will work together, including roles, approval and decision rights, controls, audit trail, and the supplier, material and contract data that AI needs to work at scale.
* Identify gaps between business needs and the standard capabilities of SAP S/4HANA and leading S2P platforms, and recommend standardization versus customization trade-offs.
* Shape value cases, KPIs and benefits tracking, so that transformations and AI investments are anchored in measurable outcomes.
* Design target operating models for procurement and accounts payable, including shared services, centers of excellence and the split of responsibilities between global, regional and local teams.
* Drive integration with adjacent domains such as Finance (R2R), Plan to Fulfil (including direct materials planning, supplier scheduling and inbound), Master Data and Tax.
* Lead client workshops and decision-making sessions, challenging legacy ways of working and aligning stakeholders on leading-practice choices.
* Act as process design authority through implementation, including end-to-end test scenarios for system integration and user acceptance testing, keeping the system integrator, technical and AI teams aligned with the intended outcomes.
* Support proposal development and commercial shaping for major SAP, AI and procurement transformation programs.
* International travel is required up to 50% of working time.

ABOUT YOU
  
  
Education
  
  

* Required: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in business administration, economics, engineering, information technology, business informatics or related fields.
* Preferred: Additional training in procurement or supply management (for example CIPS), finance, analytics or AI.

Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of professional experience, including significant experience in S2P process transformation within large SAP-enabled programs, ideally SAP S/4HANA.
* Extensive experience in process design and transformation across procurement, accounts payable and shared services organizations.
* Deep expertise in indirect spend and the purchase-to-pay backbone; strong preference for hands-on experience in direct procurement (for example raw materials and packaging sourcing, contracting and supplier management) and how it connects with planning and manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience with AI or advanced automation in S2P processes within the last 1-2 years (for example shaping, designing, delivering or advising on a use case), with a clear view of the value delivered, the process changes it required and the lessons learned.
* Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement and leading S2P platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, GEP or equivalent, including their AI capabilities. Deep technical SAP architecture expertise is not required; the focus is functional process depth with a solid grasp of what the platforms can do.
* Able to describe what best-in-class S2P processes look like, what SAP S/4HANA and leading S2P platforms support as standard, and where companies typically customize.
* Proven success engaging senior stakeholders such as CPOs, CFOs and heads of shared services, and acting as a trusted advisor in complex transformations.
* Experience in one or more relevant industries such as consumer products, retail, industrials, life sciences or manufacturing.
* Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Knowledge, skills and abilities
  
  

* Deep end-to-end S2P expertise, connecting sourcing, contracts and supplier management with purchasing, receipt, invoicing and payment into one coherent process design.
* Ability to define and articulate the main value drivers in S2P transformations, such as savings and savings leakage, spend under management, contract compliance, maverick spend, touchless PO and invoice rates, cycle times, cost per invoice, payment accuracy, payment terms and working capital, direct material cost and supply continuity, and supplier risk.
* Solid understanding of AI and how to apply it in procurement and finance operations: the main types (generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, process mining and automation), what each does well, its limits and the data it needs.
* Working knowledge of SAP Business AI (including Joule), SAP Business Network and the AI roadmaps of leading S2P platforms, and how they fit with the SAP S/4HANA core.
* Good judgment on when AI is the right answer and when process simplification, standardization or classic automation is enough.
* Strong understanding of internal controls, compliance and audit requirements in S2P, and how they need to change when AI agents take over tasks.
* Ability to lead both executive-level discussions and detailed L3/L4 process conversations, adapting the level of detail to the audience and project phase.
* Ability to use spend data, process mining and performance metrics to find bottlenecks, quantify opportunities and track benefits.
* Familiarity with change management and adoption approaches for requesters, buyers and accounts payable teams, including building trust in AI-supported decisions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a hands-on ability to create clear, ready-to-use client materials.
* Leadership skills to guide and develop small teams of junior consultants or experts.

Nice to have
  
  

* Has built simple AI prototypes or agents, for example with low-code tools such as SAP Build or Microsoft Copilot Studio, or has basic Python or SQL skills.
* Experience with process mining tools such as SAP Signavio or Celonis in S2P.
* Experience with AI-native procurement or accounts payable automation tools, including autonomous negotiation for tail spend.
* Professional certifications, such as CIPS or SAP certifications in SAP Ariba or S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement.

title: Associate Director of Digital Strategy
description:
### **Who We Are**

Teal Media is a full-service creative and design agency with a conscience. We believe purposeful design can transform organizations, inspire action, and enable progress. Our clients and nonprofit partners are committed to creating positive social change—and we pour every ounce of our passion and skill into helping them succeed.

We offer a variety of strategic, creative, and technical services, including brand strategy, web design and development, and creative support.

We’re a woman-founded and woman-led firm with a team that reflects a broad range of lived experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. At Teal, we value our people above all else and choose to work with partners and clients who share those values.

**Associate Director of Digital Strategy**
==========================================

Base salary $120,000–$140,000

**Put your digital strategy skills to work for causes worth fighting for.**

The organizations we work with are taking on some of the biggest issues of our time. They need people to pay attention, get involved, and give. We help make that happen.

Teal is a full-service creative agency partnering with nonprofits and mission-driven organizations to build brands, create websites, and turn digital engagement into action. We care deeply about the causes we serve. We ask hard questions, push the thinking, and sweat the details because our clients need work that delivers.

We’re looking for an Associate Director of Digital Strategy who brings that same conviction to their work. Someone who can earn a client’s trust, make a strong strategic call, and get into the platforms when a campaign needs attention. If you care about progressive causes and have the digital chops to help them move forward, we’d love to meet you.

**Why this role matters**
=========================

You’ll lead strategy for a portfolio of complex digital marketing engagements, helping clients connect their ambitions to clear priorities and measurable results. That means understanding their audiences, making smart choices about where to invest, and bringing paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content, SEO, and analytics together around shared goals.

You’ll report to our Senior Director of Digital Strategy and provide senior leadership on client accounts and projects. You’ll also mentor teammates and help grow Teal’s digital marketing practice through proposals, pitches, and stronger client partnerships.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* **Lead the strategy and own the follow-through**. Guide discovery, digital audits, audience research, and planning for complex engagements. Turn what you learn into practical roadmaps with clear goals, responsibilities, and measures of success.
* **Be the partner clients count on**. Build relationships with senior stakeholders, lead workshops and tough conversations, and help teams make decisions. Bring a clear point of view, listen closely, and respectfully challenge assumptions when a better approach will serve the mission.
* **Connect the channels**. Develop integrated strategies that grow audiences, deepen engagement, support advocacy, and raise money. Make recommendations that fit each client’s goals, budget, and capacity.
* **Make the numbers useful**. Establish KPIs, benchmarks, and measurement plans. Translate data and audience insights into clear recommendations, explain the story behind performance, and ensure approved optimizations make it into the work.
* **Stay close to execution**. Move comfortably between the big picture and the details. Review a campaign, troubleshoot a platform issue, or help execute when the work calls for it. We’re a small, agile team, and this role needs someone who is ready to jump in.
* **Make the creative stronger**. Partner with creative leads on campaign concepts, messaging, and ongoing communications. Give useful feedback and make sure the work reflects the client’s brand, reaches the right people, and supports the strategy.
* **Keep delivery on track**. Work with project managers, creatives, developers, and channel specialists to manage scopes, budgets, timelines, and quality. Spot risks early, recommend solutions, and keep clients and teammates informed before a problem becomes a surprise.
* **Help good partnerships grow**. Identify opportunities to expand client relationships where additional services would advance their goals. Work with the Senior Director and business development team on proposals, scopes, pitches, and prospect conversations.
* **Raise the team’s game**. Mentor colleagues, share what’s working across accounts, and improve the tools and frameworks behind our work. Support recruiting and onboarding as needed, and bring useful developments in digital marketing back to the team.
* **Balance great work with a healthy practice**. Meet the role’s billable utilization expectations while making room for approved business development and practice-building priorities. Understand how your decisions affect client outcomes and agency performance.

**What you bring**
==================

* A track record of leading complex, integrated digital marketing engagements, ideally for nonprofits, advocacy organizations, foundations, or other organizations working toward positive change.
* Broad knowledge of paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content strategy, SEO, and analytics, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one area. You can connect the disciplines and work confidently within the platforms you know best.
* The confidence and judgment to advise senior clients, facilitate productive conversations, and build agreement among people with competing priorities.
* Strong analytical instincts. You can connect performance data, audience behavior, and qualitative research to a recommendation people can act on.
* Clear, persuasive writing and presentation skills. You can explain what you recommend, why it matters, and how you’ll know it worked.
* Experience leading work across disciplines and helping colleagues grow, whether or not they report to you. You give clear direction, welcome feedback, and follow through.
* Sound agency judgment around scope, budgets, utilization, and competing priorities. You know when to dig deeper, when to make the call, and when to raise a concern.
* A real connection to the work. **You’re energized by progressive, mission-driven clients** and take their trust, resources, and results seriously.

**What we offer**
=================

Work you can care about. Colleagues who care about the craft. And benefits that support a full life beyond your next deadline.

Base salary of $120,000–$140,000. Where you land depends on your experience and skills.

Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage begin the first of the month after you join.

**Health coverage that puts you first**
---------------------------------------

* $0 premiums for employee-only coverage on our high-deductible health plan, plus an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account. Your HSA is yours to keep and use for eligible health expenses now or later.
* A generous contribution toward family coverage, plus a choice of medical plans, including $1,000-deductible and $0-deductible options. We contribute toward premiums on every plan.
* Free counseling sessions, virtual therapy, and 24/7 virtual care.

**Dental and vision covered**
-----------------------------

* $0 premiums for employee-only coverage on our base dental and vision plans, with buy-up options that include orthodontia and larger allowances for glasses and contacts.

**Additional support at no cost to you**
----------------------------------------

* Basic life and AD&D insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage, all 100% employer-paid.

**Time to recharge**
--------------------

* 10+ paid company holidays each year, starting on day one, plus a few bonus days off when we can.
* Flexible Time Off after three months. We encourage new teammates to take three weeks of vacation in their first year.

**Investing in your future**
----------------------------

* After three months, contribute 5% of your pay to your 401(k), and we’ll add 4%. The employer match is fully vested immediately.

**Support for growing families**
--------------------------------

* After three months, new parents receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave at full pay, up to $3,500 per week, to bond with their new addition.

**Location**
============

We are a fully remote team! So any US-based location works for us.

**Let’s make something happen**
===============================

Bring us your experience, your perspective, and your curiosity. We’d love to hear how you’ve helped an organization turn a digital strategy into results.

Teal Media is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know.

If your experience doesn’t exactly match the qualifications listed, but you believe you’d thrive in this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply and tell us why you’re the right person for the job.

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized communities to apply—including Black and Indigenous people, people of color, immigrants, women, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disabilities, neurodiverse individuals, and those who have been system-impacted.

title: Marketing Director (ABM & Brand)
description:
**About MVF**  
MVF connects people who are ready to buy with the brands that want them as customers. Founded in London in 2009, with a US hub in Austin, we run 20+ marketing channels, 4m first-party data records and our own technology and AI to create demand, capture it and turn it into sales.  
  
Our clients sit in 200+ verticals, from enterprise names like Salesforce and Ford to fast-growing challengers, and the business generates more than £140m a year. We work as a full-funnel go-to-market partner: we build awareness, capture intent and lift conversion through customer-facing brands such as Expert Market.  
  
**Our Team**  
Every other marketing team at MVF markets our clients' brands. This team markets MVF itself, to the companies we want as clients, and it sits inside the sales organisation so that everything it does ends in a sales conversation.  
  
We're partway into a three-year sales and commercial transformation, aiming for net revenue retention of 100% and approx 6% of revenue from new logos. Over the next six months that includes a refreshed client value proposition, an MVF rebrand launching by March 2027, and account-based marketing into the 200 accounts we most want. You'll work closely with our sales teams in London and Austin, and with the brand and design team who own the MVF identity.

**What we're offering you:**

* Summer Fridays
* Competitive holiday benefits - 25 days a year paid holiday, plus 8 bank holidays (increases 1 day a year up to 30 days)
* Hybrid working - 3 days a week in the office
* Closed for Christmas holidays - Extra days not taken from your annual holiday allowance.
* Work from anywhere for 2 weeks a year
* Life Assurance and Income Protection to protect your loved ones
* Benefits allowance for health, dental, and vision coverage
* Six months paid maternity leave, and one month paid paternity leave (subject to qualifying conditions) inclusive of same-sex and adoptive parents
* Defined Contribution Pension and Salary Sacrifice Scheme
* Be Well: Our award-winning wellbeing and mental health programme to support all MVFers and their families
* Family Forward support for our MVF parents and their mini-mes
* 2 charity days a year

**The Role**  
  
Our addressable market is small enough to name company by company. Around 200 businesses make up the accounts we most want, and you'll own the plan that gets MVF known by, and in the room with, every one of them. You'll tier the list, build a marketing plan for each top account and each cluster, and run it across LinkedIn, events, podcasts, content and gifting alongside the salespeople who own those relationships.  
  
You'll be measured on first meetings, pipeline and return on spend. Every programme you run will have a meeting target, a budget and trial period so we scale what works quickly and stop what doesn't.  
  
There's no inherited team or playbook here. You'll set the function up from scratch, do most of the work yourself at the start, and add people once the numbers justify it. The role suits someone who wants to build something with their own hands, and has the know how to execute effectively  
  
**In short: get MVF in front of every account we want to win, and show the result in pipeline.**  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
**The role has four areas of accountability.**  
  
**1. Build the plan for every account we want**

* Agree the target account list with sales leadership, mapped to our zones and hubs, and tier it
* Map the buying committee in every top-tier account, so we know who we're talking to, what they care about and what would get them to take a meeting.
* Write a marketing plan for each top-tier account and each cluster, agreed with the salesperson who owns it.
* Set up the data and tools the programme needs, including intent signals, LinkedIn account targeting and source tracking in Pipedrive, using what we already have before buying more.
* Own our agency relationship with our organic linkedin Agency and set out parameters for success and ways of working with them
* Create content suites and libraries for sales people for their outbound outreach  
    
  **2. Run the programmes**

* LinkedIn, organic and paid: grow MVF's and our leaders' presence with the people on the list, and run paid campaigns aimed at named accounts.
* Events and conferences: pick the industry events our target accounts attend in the UK and US, and get MVF on stage, on the stand and hosting the dinners around them. Run our own small, invite-only events for target accounts and our largest clients.
* Podcasts and content: get our leaders onto the podcasts and panels our buyers follow, and turn MVF's research, starting with our $1bn report, into content written for specific accounts and clusters.
* Gifting and direct mail: design personal gifting for target accounts and key clients, with a sales follow-up planned for every send.
* Online: own account-specific landing pages, retargeting and the outreach sequences sales use, working with our web and brand teams.
* Manage the agencies and partners we use, holding them to the same meeting and pipeline targets you're held to.  
    
  **3. Prove the return**

* Agree a meeting target, budget and kill date for every programme before it starts, then scale what works and stop what doesn't.
* Trace every first meeting to its source in Pipedrive, and report sourced and influenced pipeline separately so the numbers stand up with finance.
* Report monthly to the Group Sales Director on accounts engaged, first meetings, pipeline, win rate and cost per opportunity.
* Build the business case for any further investment needed  
    
  **4. Work as part of the sales team**

* Sit with the sales team, join account planning, and make sure every reply or hand-raise from a target account reaches the right salesperson the same day.
* Give sales the collateral, talk tracks and social content to pitch MVF as a full-funnel go-to-market partner once the new proposition and brand launch.
* Train salespeople in social selling and account-based selling

**Our ideal MVFer**

* 8+ years in B2B marketing, including at least 3 running account-based marketing into enterprise or mid-market accounts.
* Has built an ABM or field marketing function from scratch, and can show the meetings, pipeline and revenue it produced.
* Has done the work personally: written the campaigns, run the LinkedIn ads, booked the stands and briefed the agencies. May have led a sizeable team, and is happy to work without one while the function proves itself.
* Hands-on experience across organic and paid LinkedIn, events and conferences, podcasts and thought leadership, client gifting and online campaigns.
* Has marketed to marketing and sales leaders, ideally from a marketing services, media, lead generation or B2B software business.
* Measures success in meetings and pipeline, is fluent in a CRM such as Pipedrive, HubSpot or Salesforce, and understands the difference between sourced and influenced pipeline.
* Enjoys working with salespeople, wants a seat in account planning, and is comfortable being held to a number.
* A self-starter who writes well, spends a budget as if it were their own, and makes calls without waiting to be told.
* Comfortable working across London and Austin time zones, and travelling to events in the UK and US.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
*Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are the foundation for MVF to build, promote and sustain a culture of trust, safety, growth and belonging where everyone can thrive. Our DEI guiding principles underpin how we build our teams, develop our talent, provide a fair working environment and create an ambitious company that reflects the diversity of our employees, customers, clients and partners, globally.*  
  
*As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage all MVFers to respect, value and celebrate our differences, and commit to actions that ensure that we can belong and be authentic at MVF, without limitations or barriers.*  
  
*We’re committed to providing support and/or adjustments to those who may need them during employment. If you consider yourself someone who may need support or adjustments, please speak with your Line Manager, Department DEI Ambassador or People Partner.*  
  
*We are diverse by nature, but inclusive by choice.*

**About the role**
------------------

As Project Director within The Exchange, BT Group’s in-house creative agency, you’ll lead the Project Management function across three creative studios, managing and developing a team of Project Managers while remaining close to the work yourself.

  

The Exchange is evolving. We’re bringing increasingly ambitious and complex creative work in-house and you’ll play a central role in that growth, creating the project discipline, capacity and ways of working that allow brilliant creative ideas to become brilliantly executed work.

  

It’s a role with breadth and visibility, combining people leadership, operational ownership and hands-on creative project delivery.This is an opportunity to shape how great creative work gets delivered across some of the UK’s best-known brands.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* Lead and develop the Project Management team, creating a strong, consistent PM practice across The Exchange’s three studios.
* Deliver complex, multi-discipline creative projects from brief through to completion, stepping into priority work where your experience can make the greatest difference.
* Shape how project management works across our growing in-house agency, establishing practical standards and processes that help teams deliver at pace without compromising quality.
* Oversee capacity and resource planning across the agency, anticipating pressure points and making informed decisions to keep work moving.
* Coach Project Managers through regular one-to-ones, project reviews and development conversations, building capability and confidence across the team.
* Manage a varied portfolio of creative work spanning marketing campaigns, brand, sponsorship, CRM, product launches, experiential, video, animation and physical production.
* Partner with Account Managers, creative teams, clients and production specialists to navigate dependencies, approvals, risks and changing priorities.
* Own the effective use of Screendragon as the agency’s project management platform, strengthening workflow, adoption and visibility across projects.

title: Director of AI Experience Design
description:
**About OpenLoop**
------------------

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

We are the digital health infrastructure powering modern medicine. Healthcare and non-healthcare brands use our white-label platform to launch, scale and run virtual and hybrid care without the operational complexity. We bring together one of the largest telehealth clinician networks in the country, nationwide payer coverage, integrated pharmacy and lab partners, EHR connectivity, 24/7 patient support and full revenue cycle management. Our partners put their brand on the front end, and everything behind it runs on us. We serve more than 3 million patients a year and power over 1 million visits a month.

**About the Role**
------------------

As **Director of AI Experience Design** at OpenLoop Health, you'll lead design across everything we build: patient and client-facing experiences, our White-Label platform and Launchpad, AI agents and copilots, and the operational platforms our teams use every day.

You'll set a multi-year design vision, grow and lead the team, and own the system our products are built on. That system won't only guide human designers. It becomes the contract AI follows, precise enough that AI tools can build UI that meets our bar. You'll also help designers, engineers, and PMs use AI effectively and at scale, so the team can do more without lowering the bar on quality.

You'll treat design like a business: own the outcomes, make focused bets, and iterate based on customer truth and data. This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of strategy and execution.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Set the design vision and strategy across patient, client, and internal products, and turn bold ideas into outcomes patients, clients, and the business can measure.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of designers. Establish clear career paths, strong critique, and a culture with a high bar for craft.
* Own the design system as the source of truth, not a side artifact. That covers tokens, components, information hierarchy, and interaction principles, with theming across the many client brands our White-Label platform supports.
* Make the system AI-ready. Ship standards as code (tokens, patterns, and components wired into the engineering pipeline) so the correct, accessible, compliant pattern is the default for people and AI coding agents alike.
* Measure the system like a product, using adoption in code, pattern reuse, override rates, and first-pass quality, and retire patterns the data shows are failing.
* Help the Product & Tech org use AI effectively and at scale, with the workflows, tools, and standards that let the team ship more without sacrificing quality.
* Set the standard for how AI shows up in our products, across voice, chat, and autonomous agents. That covers trust patterns like transparency, citations, confidence, error recovery, escalation, and human handoff in a regulated healthcare setting.
* Ground decisions in research. Run discovery and usability testing with patients, clinicians, and clients, and prototype in code with real data to validate ideas before they scale.
* Audit existing and acquired surfaces, such as Hey Revia and Season Health, and drive convergence toward a single coherent experience.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leaders on problem definition, roadmap, and scoping.
* Own design KPIs and instrument the experience to quantify impact. Represent Design in executive forums with clear narratives, tradeoffs, and results.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, with 3+ years leading teams directly. B2B or B2B2C SaaS experience preferred.
* A portfolio showing end-to-end systems thinking, exceptional craft, and shipped work at scale across web and mobile.
* A track record of designing and shipping AI-powered or agentic experiences in production, and of changing how teams and AI tools actually build.
* Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain great design talent.
* Inspired by products where systematic design creates clarity, and you know what separates great product experiences from good ones.
* Meticulous and opinionated, able to hold the line on standards while moving fast.
* Comfortable being both hands-on (Figma, tokens, specs, prototyping in code with tools like Claude Code) and strategic (principles, governance, cross-team alignment).
* A strong command of accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and of designing for trust in high-stakes settings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, able to align executives around crisp narratives and metrics.
* Healthcare or other regulated-industry experience is a plus.

**Our Benefits**
----------------

In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
* Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts
* Flexible PTO
* 401(k) + Company Match
* Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more

**Our Company**
---------------

We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.

Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

title: Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers
description:
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of up 2.1 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.

Visit our website at **www.cleanspark.com**.

**Job Overview**

The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines
* Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs
* Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning
* Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate
* Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority
* Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness
* Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements
* Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work
* Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans
* Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums
* Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance
* Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows
* Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership

This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team-oriented, inclusive environment.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline
* 15+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission-critical, or large-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role
* Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high-density compute
* Demonstrated experience defining redundancy and resilience topologies and translating availability targets into design criteria
* Hands-on experience with utility interconnection, substation design, and energization planning for large loads
* Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission-critical projects
* Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners
* Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred
* Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid-cooled and high-density rack deployments
* Owner-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer
* Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites
* Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and applicable energy codes
* Master’s degree in engineering or an MBA
* Experience in a fast-growth owner organization building in-house technical capability

This position may involve duties that require operation of a company vehicle or travel between job sites. As such, candidates must be insurable under CleanSpark's vehicle insurance policy.

CleanSpark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Head of Growth
description:
**About Lendable**
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:
  
  

* One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people
* Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
* Profitable since 2017
* Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
* Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch:
**loans, credit cards and car finance**
. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.
  
  
We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks
**with dated systems and painful processes.**
**Join us if you want to**

* Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
* Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions
* Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

**Growth Lead**
We’re looking for a senior Growth Lead with deep expertise in brand and trade marketing to shape how Mexican consumers see our brand and to build our in-store acquisition channel. Your mission is not just to grow volume, but to grow the right customers: attracting higher-quality, lower-risk and more profitable cardholders for our Mexico Credit Card.
  
  
A big part of the opportunity is a channel few card issuers in Mexico are present in: in-store acquisition through our merchant partners. Physical retailers already distribute our cards at the point of sale, and the channel is largely untapped. We want someone who can turn it into a growth engine through trade marketing, in-store promotions, POP and co-marketing with our merchants.
  
  
You’ll also own our brand in Mexico: positioning, messaging and creative direction across socials, digital and in-store. You’ll work closely with our UK growth and analytics team, who lead performance marketing, tracking and attribution, and with our Credit team to make sure every campaign brings in customers who are good for the business.
  
  
This role is central to scaling our Mexico Credit Card, a mobile-app–first product designed for credit builders in Mexico.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build Trade & Retail Marketing at the Point of Sale
* Own the growth strategy for our in-store acquisition channel with physical merchant partners.
* Build and run a trade marketing calendar with each merchant: promotions such as a free card with the purchase of selected products or above a spend threshold, in-store activations and brand ambassadors.
* Develop POP and in-store advertising, from concept to production and rollout across store networks, that drives awareness and sign-ups at the shelf and at checkout.
* Launch co-marketing campaigns with merchants through their own channels (apps, loyalty programs, catalogues, socials) and joint offers.
* Work with merchant partners, Operations and Engineering on execution: store staff incentives and training, systems integration and reconciliation of promotion costs.
* Build a repeatable playbook so we can launch new merchant partners quickly.
* Own & Build Our Brand in Mexico
* Own brand positioning, messaging and identity, shaping how Mexican consumers perceive us so we attract the customers we want to serve.
* Define creative direction and lead brand campaigns across socials, digital, out-of-home and in-store.
* Build a creative engine (in-house, agencies, creators) that produces high-quality assets at speed.
* Grow our organic social presence, content and community.
* Track brand health (awareness, consideration, perception) and connect brand work to acquisition results.
* Connect Brand, Retail & Digital
* Design digital-to-store campaigns with merchants that drive customers into stores to get their card (e.g. geo-targeted social, merchant channels).
* Keep the brand consistent across every touchpoint, and provide messaging and creative for our performance campaigns.
* Partner with the UK growth and analytics team, who own performance marketing execution, tracking and attribution, so brand and trade campaigns are properly measured and learnings flow both ways.
* Measure What Matters
* Own the brand and trade marketing budget, and the return on it.
* Define clear KPIs for every campaign and merchant: cost per account, approval and activation rates, and customer quality.
* Work with Credit and the UK analytics team to understand which campaigns, merchants and promotions bring in profitable customers, and how CAC compares to LTV.
* Use results to reallocate spend across merchants, promotions and campaigns.

**Required Experience**
**What We’re Looking For**

* 6+ years in brand, trade, retail or shopper marketing, with senior ownership of meaningful budgets and targets, ideally at consumer brands, retailers or financial services in Mexico.
* A proven track record of launching trade marketing and in-store campaigns with retailers: promotions, POP, activations and co-marketing.
* Experience building or repositioning a consumer brand: positioning, messaging, creative direction and campaigns.
* Strong experience working with and negotiating with Mexican retailers and their store teams.
* Experience managing creative, BTL and production agencies and vendors.
* Commercially minded and data-literate: comfortable setting KPIs, reading campaign results and tying spend to outcomes.
* Strong execution across many stakeholders (merchants, Operations, Finance, Credit).
* Proficiency in English and Spanish (you’ll work closely with our UK team).
* Deep understanding of Mexican consumers.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience in performance marketing across Meta, Google, TikTok or app marketing.
* Familiarity with tracking and data integrations, such as Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google offline conversions, MMPs and attribution.
* Analytical skills such as SQL, cohort analysis or unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback).
* Experience in credit cards, lending or other financial services, ideally with an understanding of credit risk.
* Previous start-up or scale-up experience, ideally building a channel from zero.
* Experience leading a team.

**The Type of Work You’ll Be Doing**

* Plan and launch trade marketing promotions with merchant partners.
* Create POP and in-store materials, and roll them out across store networks.
* Negotiate co-marketing plans with merchants and onboard new partners.
* Define our brand positioning and lead brand campaigns.
* Brief and manage creative work, agencies and creators.
* Design digital-to-store campaigns with merchants.
* Review campaign and merchant performance with Credit and the UK analytics team, and reallocate budget.
* Report on growth performance to leadership and keep the team focused on what moves the needle.
* Help hire and build out the growth team as we scale.

**How You’ll Contribute To Lendable**

* Ownership: You own brand and in-store acquisition end to end, from strategy and budget to results.
* Brand Building: You create a brand that Mexican consumers trust and want to be part of.
* Retail Savvy: You know how to win at the point of sale and how to work with retailers.
* Quality Over Volume: You optimize for good, profitable customers, not vanity metrics.
* Data-Informed: You measure everything and let results guide where spend goes.
* Creativity: You find new ways to reach customers, in store and online.
* Prioritization: You focus ruthlessly on high-impact bets.
* Speed: You thrive in an environment where shipping fast and iterating is the norm.
* Collaboration: You work smoothly with merchants, agencies, Credit and our UK team.

**Interview Process**

* CV Screening
* Intro Call with Talent
* Hiring Manager Call
* Case Study + Presentation (e.g. a brand positioning and in-store campaign plan with a merchant partner, and how you’d measure it)
* Final Round:

+ Cultural interview with wider team leads
+ Mexico MD interview
+ Credit leadership
+ Executive leadership

**Location**

* In-office in Mexico City.
* In exceptional cases, remote may be considered, but frequent presence in the Mexico City office is required.

**Compensation**

* $150,000 - $200,000 Mexican pesos, per month, before taxes
* Potential stock option plan
* All legal benefits
* Private Health Insurance

**Life at Lendable**

* **Winning team:**
  the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies
* **Flexible working:**
  flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites
* **Socials & connection:**
  opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls
* **Health coverage:**

* **Retirement & savings:**

* **Employee referral programme:**
  earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members
* **Office meals & snacks:**
  enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations
* **Sustainable commuting:**
  cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

***Please note:**
The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.*
