title: Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design
description:
### **ROLE OVERVIEW**

Pivot Energy is seeking a motivated individual to join our Technical Operations team and lead the company’s Energy Storage modeling and design. The role covers market analysis, technical vendor evaluation, pricing, modeling, sizing, and design recommendations for our storage (DC-coupled with PV solar and standalone storage) project pipeline. This role combines aspects of engineering, collaboration with finance, operations, and policy teams with a goal of deploying and optimizing our storage pipeline.

The Director will be responsible for technical analysis of all solar- plus-storage (DC-coupled) and standalone energy storage market opportunities, including optimal system sizing. The Director will work with the market strategy, policy, and finance teams on revenue modeling and financial analysis, and with Estimation, Procurement, and Commercial Operations to optimize CAPEX and OPEX. The role also works regularly with project development leads and cross-team leads in Project Development Origination, Grid Interconnection, Engineering, Finance, Delivery, O&M, and Asset Management.The Director will have the opportunity to identify and vet potential areas of new energy storage business development, such as new geographies, programs, incentives, or procurements.

This is an opportunity to join a small team in a fast-growing market at an exciting and expanding company. This position offers significant growth potential at a B Corporation with operations across the USA.

### **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and maintain MATLAB and Excel based revenue projections for solar plus storage and standalone storage projects by maintaining and / or creating new custom tools or using third-party applications
* Use internal Excel-based financial models, determine the cost and overall value of distribution-scale solar plus storage, and standalone storage projects
* Train internal personnel use energy modeling tools (MATLAB or third-party) with a goal of scaling Pivot’s ability to model storage projects and markets.
* Train, teach, guide, and collaborate with external personnel that will review our energy models, inputs, assumptions, equations, and code.
* Work with other Pivot teams on detailed modeling and design and on external quoting of storge model inputs including CAPEX and OPEX
* Support internal opportunity leads from the Commercial team to define project value and pricing terms to developer partners and for utility RFPs through market and project level modeling and design assumptions
* Work with key hardware and software vendors on technical evaluation, pipeline discussions, modeling assumptions, design, pricing, and equipment specifications to optimize project-level design
* Provide design direction including sizing and equipment selection to the Engineering team for project-level design and interconnection applications.
* Support the Market Strategy team in vetting potential new markets through quantitative analysis of sample projects
* Advance individual and team BESS knowledge through structured training, self-directed learning, and educational opportunities across Pivot.
* Build, manage and guide a small team of BESS experts consisting of engineering, analytics, modeling, and other expertise necessary to guide sound market and project decisions related to BESS.
* Support team members’ career growth by helping them think through the market drivers affecting BESS.
* Regularly document and share key insights from energy storage analysis process with relevant internal teams
* Track opportunities and analysis requests in Pivot’s CRM tools

### **REQUIRED COMPETENCIES**

Primary qualifications include demonstrated abilities to work collaboratively within a team, work collaboratively in cross team formats with other team leads, creatively solve quantitative problems, prioritize and manage a mix of short- and long-term deadlines, and professionally represent Pivot Energy externally. Experience in renewables and/or energy storage is required. The Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design must be able to think critically and work with experienced renewables professionals to decipher the needs of a project/portfolio and find the best solutions in each scenario.

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (preferably Electrical Engineering with a focus on power system and energy system)
* Minimum 5 years of experience in the energy storage industry and storage project development
* Experience in the solar industry and solar project development
* Quantitative & qualitative problem-solving skills and strong communication skills
* Knowledge of renewable energy and project finance concepts
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple critical deadlines
* Passion for learning new things through self-directed study and structured settings
* High degree of proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel
* Willingness to work in databases such as Salesforce

### **PREFERRED COMPETENCIES**

* Master’s degree in a relevant field
* At least 10 years of experience in the renewable energy industry
* Experience in energy trading, wholesale energy markets, or other energy economics disciplines
* Experience with Ascend Analytics, Fractal or similar energy modeling software
* Ability to create and modify energy models and finance models using MATLAB or a similar tool.

$160,000 - $190,000 a year

### **COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

The base salary range for this position is $160,000-$190,000 depending on relevant experience, along with eligibility for the company’s substantial bonus plan, with a target bonus of 30% of annual salary (prorated in the first year based on start date).

  

Pivot Energy is dedicated to providing a great work experience for all employees, placing an emphasis on company culture and a focus on our people. To that end, Pivot offers an outstanding benefits package that includes:

* Excellent health/dental/vision insurance benefits with up to 100% of premiums covered by the company
* Four weeks of vacation in year 1, with increasing vacation accrual rates based on work anniversary date
* Company paid life insurance and short- & long-term disability coverage
* Generous parental leave
* 401(k) matching (after vesting period)
* Work from home stipend for new employees
* Public transit reimbursement
* PTO for volunteering in the community

A complete list of all the benefits Pivot offers may be provided upon request.

Pivot Energy is a national renewable energy provider that develops, finances, builds, owns, and manages solar and energy storage projects that help decarbonize our nation’s electricity, increase equitable access to clean energy for local communities, and provide real cost-savings to American businesses and

families.

We are fiercely dedicated to accelerating the rapid transition taking place in the energy industry to a more decentralized and cleaner approach to power generation. IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

  

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

  

Sourcing & Contracting Strategy

* Lead procurement of AE/design consultant services (civil, structural, MEP, electrical distribution, low-voltage) and third-party Commissioning (Cx) agents across all project phases (Cx, IST, and turnover).

Substation EPC

* Negotiate substation EPC contracts and manage EPC contractor performance across design, procurement, and construction phases, including interface management with the GC and utility.

Cost, Risk & Schedule Management

* Monitor project schedules jointly with Construction Management to identify sourcing risk (labor, equipment, long-lead materials) and proactively mitigate GC/Cx-driven schedule slippage.
* Track and report portfolio-level spend, savings, and contract compliance to procurement and executive leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Serve as the primary procurement business partner to Construction, Engineering, and Development leadership from site selection through project turnover.
* Represent Procurement in GC/AE/Cx/Substation EPC bid evaluations, contract award recommendations, and executive steering committee reviews.
* Build and mentor a team of category managers and buyers supporting the GC, design consultant, substation EPC, and commissioning categories as the portfolio scales.
* Establish standardized RFP templates, evaluation scorecards, and contract playbooks to drive consistency and speed across a growing project portfolio.

  

* 10+ years of progressive procurement, construction management, or supply chain leadership experience in hyperscale or mission-critical data center construction; prior experience at a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or major GC/EPC firm strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated command of GC/EPC sourcing, AE/design consultant procurement, Substation EPC contracting, and third-party commissioning agent engagement for large-scale data center or industrial facility builds. Deep working knowledge of GMP, lump sum, CMAR, Design-Build, and Progressive Design-Build contracting models, and of OFCI/CFCI/ODCI scope structuring.
* Strong grounding in construction cost negotiations, project scheduling interdependencies, and Substation EPC and shell/core/fit-out delivery.

title: Director, Game Design
description:

title: Director of Brand Design
description:
**About Cardiff**

Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help.

**Location:** San Diego, CA or Remote (U.S.)

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Department:** Product and Design/Marketing

**Reports to:** CMO

**Why This Role Matters**

Our customers are small business owners who need capital quickly and clearly. Every screen, form, and message they see shapes whether they trust us enough to apply, finish, and come back. As Director of Brand Design, you'll set the standard for how Cardiff looks, feels, and works across our product, our brand, and every customer touchpoint, and you'll build the team and design system that keep that standard high as we grow.

**What You'll Own**

  

* Set the design vision and strategy for Cardiff's customer-facing products, internal tools, and brand, in partnership with Engineering, Marketing, and leadership
* Lead end-to-end product design for the borrower journey, from first visit and application through underwriting, funding, and repeat borrowing
* Design internal tools for our underwriting, funding, sales, and servicing teams so they can move faster with fewer errors
* Build and maintain a scalable design system in Figma, with documented components, patterns, and accessibility standards that engineering can ship from directly
* Own brand and visual identity across web, paid media, email, direct mail, and sales materials, partnering closely with Marketing on campaign creative
* Ground design decisions in evidence through customer research, usability testing, funnel analytics, and split testing, with clear metrics tied to conversion and customer experience
* Ensure designs meet accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and the disclosure and compliance requirements of a regulated lending business
* Hire, lead, and develop the design team, running a predictable cadence of critique, delivery, and accountability
* Use AI tools throughout the design process, from research synthesis to prototyping, and help the team do the same

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 years leading designers and owning design outcomes for a digital product at a growth-stage company. Experience in fintech, lending, or financial services is a strong plus.
* **Product Design Craft:** A portfolio that shows strong interaction design, visual design, and information architecture on complex, multi-step flows such as applications, onboarding, or dashboards.
* **Design Systems:** Hands-on experience building and scaling a design system, and working closely with engineers to implement it in code.
* **Tools:** Expert-level Figma skills, fluency with prototyping and AI-assisted design tools, and a working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and how front-end code gets built.
* **Research and Data:** Comfort running user research and usability tests, and reading product analytics to find friction and measure the impact of design changes.
* **Leadership Style:** Hands-on, execution-focused leader with strong cross-functional communication skills; able to give clear feedback, make decisions with incomplete information, and explain design choices to non-designers. **Must have experience managing at least 4 direct reports.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Industry Perspective:** Experience designing for small business owners, B2B customers, or regulated, high-trust products such as lending, payments, or banking.
* **Conversion Design:** A track record of improving funnel conversion, application completion, or activation through measured design changes.
* **Brand Leadership:** Experience leading a brand refresh or building a visual identity system that works across product and marketing channels.
* **Content Design:** Skill at writing and shaping clear product copy, especially for financial terms, disclosures, and error states.
* **Organizational Scale:** Experience building a design function at an early or growth-stage company, including hiring, career leveling, and managing freelance and agency partners.

**This Role May Not Be a Fit If You**

* Want a strategy or advisory seat rather than hands-on ownership of the work that ships
* Have been out of the tools long enough that you'd need someone else to build the file or the prototype
* Prefer structured corporate environments with clear lanes and layers between you and the business
* Solve problems offline and come back with polished results, instead of sharing work early and communicating while you work
* Use AI tools to assist your old workflow, rather than having rebuilt your workflow around them

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary range: $195,000+
* Performance bonus of up to 20% of base, tied to delivery and business outcomes
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Flexible PTO and observed holidays
* Remote-first, with support for your home-office setup
* Direct access to leadership and to the problems that matter

Cardiff, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Marketing Events Specialist
description:
**About First Due**

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Marketing Events Specialist**

**Location**: Remote - US Only  
**Country**: United States  
**Department**: Marketing  
**Reports To**: Director, Field Marketing & Events  
**Position Type**: Full-Time  
**Salary**: $80,000

### **Job Summary:**

As a leading provider of Public Safety Software, First Due hosts and participates in high-impact events across the country. We are seeking a strategic, detail-oriented Marketing Events Specialist to lead the planning and execution of conferences and trade shows, while also supporting First Due–hosted events such as our Companywide Offsite and Annual User Summit.
  
  
Reporting to the Director, Field Marketing & Events, the Field Marketing & Events Specialist is responsible for executing integrated field marketing campaigns and managing event logistics that drive brand awareness, lead generation, customer engagement, and revenue growth. This role works cross-functionally with Sales, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and external vendors to deliver high-impact marketing programs aligned with business objectives. The ideal candidate is a proactive project manager with strong event execution skills, experience in SaaS marketing, and a passion for creating memorable customer and prospect experiences.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Events Management & Execution**

* Plan and execute in-person events, including trade shows, industry conferences, regional field marketing programs, and First Due–owned events.
* Manage end-to-end event logistics, including venue sourcing, vendor coordination, registration, travel, shipping, booth setup, sponsorship deliverables, branding, signage, and attendee communications.
* Coordinate event timelines, run-of-show planning, and internal communications with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Partner with Creative and Content teams to develop event materials, signage, presentations, and attendee-facing assets.
* Support onsite event execution, including registration, session coordination, booth management, staff coordination, and sponsor activities.
* Serve as the onsite point of contact for event logistics, vendor coordination, and brand execution.
* Ensure a seamless attendee experience from initial invitation through post-event follow-up.
* Travel to select events as needed to support planning and onsite execution.
* Gather attendee feedback and post-event insights to identify opportunities for improvement.

**Vendor, Sponsorship & Budget Management**

* Coordinate with external vendors, venues, suppliers, and event partners to manage logistics, branding assets, booth design, and onsite activations.
* Manage sponsorship deliverables and support negotiations to maximize event value and return on investment (ROI).
* Assist with event and campaign budgets, marketing spend, contracts, invoices, and purchase orders in accordance with company policies.
* Manage event-related vendor relationships and expenses to ensure cost-effective execution.

**Marketing Operations, Reporting & Administration**

* Maintain accurate event and campaign records in CRM and project management platforms, including Salesforce, Airtable, and Notion.
* Support event lead capture, lead routing, and post-event sales follow-up.
* Track campaign and event performance using CRM and marketing automation platforms.
* Measure and report on key performance indicators (KPIs), including:
  + Registrations and attendance
  + Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)
  + Sales Accepted Leads (SALs)
  + Influenced pipeline and revenue attribution
* Support pre- and post-event communications with vendors, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Manage event inventory, shipping, and marketing asset logistics.
* Compile performance reports and post-event insights to evaluate effectiveness and inform future marketing initiatives.

### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business, Event Management, or related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in B2B marketing, field marketing, event marketing, or demand generation.
* Experience working within a SaaS, software, cloud, or technology company.
* Proven experience planning and executing corporate events and trade shows.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.

title: Cluster Director of Revenue Management
description:
***This is a remote position.***

**Position Summary**

The Cluster Director of Revenue Management leads revenue management and collaborates closely with the sales & marketing functions for a property cluster. This individual will be responsible for driving top-line performance through strategic planning, collaboration, and execution across all commercial disciplines, optimizing business mix and rate strategy across a multi-brand, single-market cluster spanning full-service, select-service, extended-stay, and lifestyle segments. This role partners closely with the Corporate Director of Revenue Management to ensure alignment with portfolio-wide commercial strategy.

**Position Duties and Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and monitor revenue management strategies, collaborating closely with Sales and Marketing leadership to optimize performance across all distribution and reservation channels.
* Optimize room rates, availability, and inventory in accordance with brand and company guidelines to maximize occupancy, ADR, and RevPAR at each property.
* Lead weekly Revenue Strategy Meetings for each hotel, covering rate and inventory strategy, transient and group pace, competitive positioning, total revenue strategies and financial forecasts.
* Optimize business mix and displacement decisions across the cluster, and analyze market trends, competitor behavior, and STR reports to direct demand to the appropriate property and brand and maximize total cluster revenue.
* Partner closely with property-level sales, marketing, and operations teams across all hotels to ensure consistent execution of commercial strategies and achievement of revenue targets.
* Prepare and manage weekly, monthly, and rolling forecasts; conduct displacement analysis for group, contract, and negotiated business opportunities across the cluster.
* Collaborate with hotel ownership, corporate leadership, and operations teams to develop budgets, forecasts, and strategic plans, and stay involved in all aspects of monthly reforecasting.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the properties and the Corporate Director of Revenue Management, ensuring alignment on strategy, reporting, and brand standards.
* Drives business evaluation process for all negotiated Business Transient offerings, group rooms, and group opportunities that include Banquet & Catering (B&C) functions across the cluster, and facilitates all daily and weekly Sales, Revenue, and Daily Business Reviews for the cluster.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and shifts in group, transient, and extended-stay demand, integrating insights into strategy across the full-service, select-service, and extended-stay segments represented in the cluster.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and high performance within the commercial organization.

**Knowledge and Skill**

* Minimum 3-5 years of progressive experience in hotel revenue management, sales, and marketing.
* Multi-brand experience required, including revenue management systems GRO for the Hilton property and One Yield for the Marriott-branded properties
* Delphi sales experience a plus for the Hilton property.
* Previous experience with systems such as Kalibri, TravelClick Agency/Demand 360, and OTA Insight/Lighthouse a plus.
* Experience managing a mix of full-service, select-service, extended-stay, and lifestyle brands within a single market preferred.
* Proven ability to manage and influence cross-functional teams across multiple properties in a matrixed environment.
* Strong analytical, financial acumen, and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing market dynamics and to balance competing priorities across multiple brands in the same market.
* Strong knowledge of industry KPIs such as RevPAR, GOPPAR, RPI, ROGR, ROAS, and $POR, and the strategies that optimize their performance.

**Qualifications**

* Multi-property/cluster and multi-brand (Hilton and Marriott) revenue management experience strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, distribution, and e-commerce strategies in the hospitality space, and ability to travel locally between the properties as well as to support corporate initiatives.

title: Director, Marketing & Communications
description:
**About mStreet Fiber**
-----------------------

mStreet Fiber is a future-enabling, community-centered fiber network developer, deploying infrastructure designed to deliver long-term value to commercial partners and the communities it serves.

The company designs, builds, finances, and operates fiber networks that power economic opportunity, remote work, education, telehealth, and Smart City applications for residents, businesses, and cities. mStreet Fiber’s investments are durable and scalable: future-ready networks with virtually unlimited capacity to support emerging technologies and applications, meeting today's demands and anticipating those decades ahead.

By combining deep local partnerships with fiber expertise, mStreet Fiber drives growth, digital participation, and lasting community impact across all income levels.

**Executive Summary**
---------------------

mStreet Fiber is seeking a Director, Marketing & Communications, to lead mStreet Fiber's brand, content, public relations, and digital presence across all markets. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the Director owns content development, from press releases and social media to executive and campaign content, as well as the company website and all mStreet Fiber social media channels.

Working with the CEO, executive leadership, Meridiam, Market Presidents & General Managers, commercial and MDU sales teams, ISP partners, and municipal stakeholders, the Director tells a consistent story about mStreet Fiber's open-access networks and community impact, builds awareness and demand in each market, and protects the company's reputation.

-------------------------

  

### **Brand & Communications Strategy**

* Develop and execute the enterprise marketing and communications strategy, aligned with company goals and market growth plans.

### **Content Development**

* Manage development of all external content, including press releases, social media posts, website content, newsletters, case studies, presentations, and collateral.

* Lead media relations, build relationships with trade, business, and local press, and secure earned coverage.

* Brand awareness and share of voice in each market.
* Volume and quality of earned media coverage.

* Experience owning corporate social media channels, with strong knowledge of LinkedIn, Facebook, and other platforms, and their analytics.
* Media relations and crisis communications experience, with established press relationships.
* Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone for executives, communities, partners, and media.

### **Preferred**

* Experience in broadband, telecommunications, infrastructure, or utilities.
* Experience marketing open-access, wholesale, or B2B2C business models, including commercial and MDU sales support.
* Experience working with private equity or infrastructure investors on communications and compliance.
* Experience with public-private partnerships and communicating with municipal and government stakeholders.
* Hands-on HubSpot experience, covering CRM, lead and pipeline management, and marketing automation.

**Work Model & Travel**
-----------------------

**Benefits**
------------

Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan, and paid time off.

--------------------------------

mStreet Fiber is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Art Direction Lead
description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

**This is a hands-on craft role.** The Art Director raises the visual quality of everything the Experience Design practice produces — primarily the user interfaces of the responsive web and native mobile applications and periodically the presentations, publications, campaign materials and identity work that surround them.

**This is not a people-management role.** The Art Director leads through craft: setting the visual bar, directing the look and feel of work produced by other designers through critique and example, and defending design rationale directly to delivery teams, stakeholders and customers. There are no direct reports, and the position is not structured as a step toward running a creative group. Candidates who want to manage a department will not find that here. Candidates who want to do the best visual work of their career, on products that people depend on, will.

This role will be located near one of the following locations: Falls Church, VA, San Antonio, TX, Aurora, CO, or Tacoma, WA. May be remote if approved by customer.

The work is judged against commercial standards, not government-average ones. The measure of success is simple: the things this practice produces should be visibly better than what surrounds them.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Interface Design & Visual Direction**

* Design beautiful, distinctive, production-ready user interfaces for responsive web and native mobile applications.

* Set and hold the visual standard across the portfolio — typography, layout, color, hierarchy, iconography, imagery and motion.

* Direct the look and feel of work produced by other designers through design critique, pairing and example rather than assignment.

* Translate UX direction, wireframes and functional requirements into high-fidelity design that makes a product feel considered rather than assembled.

* Build and maintain the visual layer of the design system: type scales, color systems, spacing, grids, components and iconography.

* Explore multiple distinct directions before converging and be able to say why one is stronger than another.

**Brand, Collateral & Marks**

* Design the materials that surround the products — advertisements, brochures, posters, one-pagers, infographics, campaign and event collateral.

* Produce executive-ready presentation design for leadership, customers and internal reviews, with real information hierarchy and visual storytelling.

* Design logos, seals, marks and small identity systems for programs, departments and business units as requested, including variants in service colors.

* Work within organization systems and brand standards, and establish durable patterns where standards do not yet exist.

**Collaboration & Design Rationale**

* Work directly with UX designers, researchers, front-end developers, solution delivery teams, product managers and government stakeholders.

* Present and defend design rationale to technical and non-technical audiences and ask pointed questions early to find the real problem rather than the stated one.

* Translate vague, conflicting or late-arriving feedback into clear direction without losing the idea underneath it.

* Take part in design critique on both sides — giving specific, useful feedback and receiving it without defensiveness.

* Participate in Agile ceremonies for the delivery teams where there is active work.

**Craft Standards & Handoff**

* Deliver production-ready files: SVG assets, exported sources, component states, responsive behavior and specifications a developer can build from without guessing.

* Review implemented work against approved design and identify where the build has drifted.

* Benchmark the practice's output against leading commercial digital products and bring examples rather than opinions.
* Use AI-assisted design tools to explore more directions faster — and verify everything before it leaves. The standing instruction in this practice is that whatever comes out of a tool is yours: you own it, and you will be asked to defend it.

**Accessibility & Quality**

* Ensure designs meet Section 508 and WCAG requirements — color contrast, type legibility, focus and state design, touch targets, and meaningful visual hierarchy.

* Build accessibility into the design rather than treating it as a compliance review at the end.

* Treat accessibility and visual ambition as compatible. Constraints are a design problem, not an excuse for plain work.

##### **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* 5 years with a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, Fine Arts or a related field, 7 years with an AS degree or 9 years with a High School diploma.
* A current, accessible online portfolio is required with application.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.
* U.S. Citizenship required.

* **An outstanding portfolio** — this is the primary qualification. Interface design first; collateral and identity work second. Show range and show finished work.

* **Five or more years** — of professional experience in art direction, visual design or interface design, in an agency, internal creative group or product organization.

* **Exceptional typographic and layout craft** — demonstrated across both screen and print.

* **Advanced Figma** — components, variants, variables, Auto Layout, shared libraries, interactive prototyping and Dev Mode.

* **Adobe Creative Cloud Experience** — primarily Illustrator, and Photoshop; After Effects an advantage.

* **Strong presentation design** — and genuine fluency in PowerPoint, which is where most of this work is seen.

* **Working understanding of software design and the solution delivery lifecycle** — enough to know where design sits, what engineering needs, and when.

* **Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and modern front-end concepts** — enough to judge what is buildable and to hold a credible conversation with developers.

* **Command of design principles, patterns and practices** — across digital, print, mobile and video.

* Working knowledge of Section 508 and current WCAG accessibility requirements.

* **Ownership** — the ability to carry a piece of work from brief to delivery, hold a deadline, and raise a risk before it becomes a miss.

**Preferred Skills**

* Identity and mark design: logos, seals, badges, and small icon systems.

* Experience with the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS) or other enterprise or government design systems.

* Motion design and micro-interaction design.

* Hands-on experience with AI image and design generation tools, and clear judgment about where they do and do not belong.

* Experience designing healthcare, federal government, or other mission-critical enterprise environments.

* Familiarity with front-end frameworks and component-based development.

* Illustration, data visualization, or photography and video art direction.

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Marketing Manager, North America
description:
Job Summary:

**JOB DESCRIPTION** – Marketing Manager

**Location** : Remote - Los Angeles, California preferred

**Division** : Ticketmaster

**Line Manager** : Associate Director, Marketing

**Contract Terms** : Full Time, Permanent

  

**THE TEAM**

Ticketmaster is the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the global market leader in live event ticketing products and services. Through official partnerships with thousands of venues, artists, sports teams, festivals, performing arts centers and theatres, Ticketmaster now processes over 500 million tickets a year. As part of Live Nation Entertainment, the largest live entertainment company in the world, Ticketmaster is traded on the New York Stock Exchange as NYSE: LYV. Ticketmaster operates in over 30 countries across North America, South America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Overall, the company employs over 6,500 people. Ticketmaster was established in Phoenix, Arizona in 1976.

Ticketmaster Music manages our global concert line of business. We’re the commercial engine behind the world’s biggest tours and we represent touring artists and their promoters inside of Ticketmaster. Our mission is to develop, configure, and manage innovative and distinctive software solutions on behalf of these artists that capture and convert concert ticket demand, optimize prices, and provide key insights and fan interactions. Our deep understanding of touring artists’ business needs, and our access to the technological scale and expertise of the global leader in ticketing enables “Artist-Driven, Ticketmaster-Powered” outcomes that are transforming the global concert industry.

**THE JOB**

The **Marketing Manager** plays a critical role in the tactical planning, management, and execution of B2C marketing and communications strategies supporting Ticketmaster Music’s suite of products and services. As the primary marketing point of contact for assigned touring artist and promoter clients across the United States and Canada, core responsibilities also include delivering consultative insights, expertise, and recommendations, as well as providing exceptional customer service.

This position works closely with teams across Ticketmaster Music (including Artist & Promoter Relations and Operations) and actively collaborates with marketing stakeholders throughout Ticketmaster and Live Nation Entertainment. The ideal candidate excels at building deep relationships with clients and internal teams. They skillfully manage both client expectations and internal teams supporting client deliverables. Adaptable and versatile, they are comfortable playing a variety of roles depending on the situation and successfully balance strategic and operational functions in an ever-changing environment. **This role requires fluency in both English and Spanish** for client communication.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**

* Support the adoption and success of Ticketmaster Music’s products and services, designed to help artists and promoters meet their touring goals.
* Develop impactful B2C marketing and communications strategies that leverage Ticketmaster-owned media to drive demand, fan education, and ticket sales for our clients and products.
* Liaise with Ticketmaster Music teams globally to collaborate on campaign strategies and drive consistency across territories, with additional focus on the Latin America (LATAM) region as needed.
* Personally execute day-to-day marketing operations for assigned tours and campaigns, including CRM campaign builds, copywriting, creative asset resizing, and other activity.
* Serve as the internal “expert” on our clients: understand their business challenges/opportunities, how Ticketmaster’s current offerings benefit them, and advocate for new offerings.
* Guide client marketing contacts in effective product usage, including reporting and marketing solutions.
* Attend and lead meetings with clients, deliver compelling content and information via formal presentations.
* Translate demand and marketing data, proactively turn into actionable insights and learnings.
* Support reporting, data, and analytics projects, utilizing both internal and web tools (i.e. Google Analytics).
* Partner with B2B Product Marketing in the development of compelling presentations, sales decks, and marketing materials that effectively communicate our products and services to client stakeholders.
* Capture client stories to demonstrate the value clients are deriving from our solutions and provide feedback to B2B Product Marketing teams to produce case studies and related content.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, clients, and peers.
* Provide excellent communication with clients and internal teams, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
Stay current on live entertainment and marketing industry knowledge.  

**WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS/COMPETENCIES)**

* BA/BS in Marketing or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in a role with similar requirements in digital marketing or live entertainment industry.
* **Bilingual in English and Spanish (verbal and written)** for direct client communication; able to deliver presentations, lead educational meetings, and write effectively.
* Understanding and interest in the business side of the live music industry. Knowledge of Latin music industry and familiarity with evolving artists and trends in the space preferred.
* Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) in a professional setting, applied to improve the speed, quality, and impact of work.
* Strong proficiency required in Microsoft Office products - particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Proficiency in Salesforce, Asana, Airtable, Photoshop, and Google Analytics preferred.
Strong quantitative skills including analytical abilities.  

  

**YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS/COMPETENCIES)**

* Ability to work effectively under pressure and tight deadlines.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to effectively interact with clients and colleagues across the executive, mid-manager, and day-to-day operations levels in a professional, service-oriented manner.
Strong written and verbal communication and comprehension skills, ability to adjust style based on audience.  

  

**BENEFITS & PERKS**

Through our ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ program, we provide benefits across six key pillars:

* **HEALTH** : Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
* **YOURSELF** : Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
* **WEALTH** : 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
* **FAMILY** : New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
* **CAREER** : Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
* **OTHERS** : Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

**LIFE AT TICKETMASTER**

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our mission at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. Ticketmaster is the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the global market leader in live event ticketing products and services. Through official partnerships with thousands of venues, artists, sports teams, festivals, performing arts centers and theaters, Ticketmaster processes 550 million tickets per year across 35+ different countries.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

**Our work is guided by our values:**

**Reliability** - Fans and clients count on us to power their live event experiences and we rely on each other to make it happen.

**Teamwork** – While we celebrate individual achievements, we know have more success as a team.

**Integrity** - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent.

**Belonging** - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive.

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

**Key Outcome(s) Owned:**

* A consistently high-quality, accessible, and cohesive product experience across all Menlo surfaces that measurably improves customer adoption, satisfaction, and retention.
* A high-performing, well-led design organization with the systems, standards, and talent to scale with the business.

**Success Metrics / KPIs:** *(suggested; hiring manager to confirm)*

* Improvement in product usability and customer satisfaction measures (e.g., task success rates, SUS/CSAT, or NPS for key workflows) year over year.
* Accessibility conformance (e.g., WCAG 2.2 AA) across core product surfaces, tracked through defined quality gates.
* Design system adoption and consistency across product teams, along with fewer design-related defects reaching production.
* Measurable time saved or quality improved through AI-enabled design workflows adopted across the team.
* Team health and growth indicators, including engagement scores, retention of top talent, and internal promotion readiness.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead, grow, and coach a team of product designers and design managers, investing meaningful time in talent development, setting clear performance expectations, and making timely talent decisions.
* Define the craft philosophy, quality standards, and review processes that govern interaction design, visual design, and accessibility across the full product organization, and build the design systems and frameworks that sustain them at scale.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Go-to-Market leaders to shape multi-quarter and multi-year product vision, influence roadmap and investment decisions, and protect design intent through implementation.
* Establish the organization's research and accessibility practice, embedding evidence-based decision-making and company-wide accessibility standards into roadmap planning and product quality gates.
* Demonstrate design's business impact through outcome tracking and clear business cases, and represent design strategy and results at the VP and executive level.
* Design and scale AI-enabled workflows for the team, such as using AI to synthesize research and customer feedback, generate and explore early concepts, and support accessibility and consistency checks, and evaluate AI tools for fit, risk, and ROI.
* Build cross-functional forums and operating rhythms that bring the customer's perspective into how Menlo plans, prioritizes, and makes decisions.

**Functional Competencies**
---------------------------

**Required:**

* 12+ years of product design experience, including 5+ years leading design teams with managers reporting to you, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS.
* A portfolio showing advanced craft in UX, interaction, and visual design for complex products, and how you have raised quality standards across multiple teams.
* Experience building or scaling a design system and establishing design review and quality processes across a product organization.
* Depth in user research methods and accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG), with a track record of embedding both into product decisions.
* Proven ability to influence executive and C-suite stakeholders, connect design work to business outcomes, and shape product strategy and roadmaps.
* Hands-on fluency with AI tools in design and research workflows, with experience guiding a team's adoption of them responsibly.

**Preferred / Nice to Have:**

* Experience designing for cybersecurity, networking, or IT/security administrator audiences.
* Experience designing AI-powered or agentic product experiences.
* Experience leading content design or UX writing alongside product design.
* External presence in the design community, such as speaking, writing, or mentoring.
* Bachelor's degree in design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Menlo Mindsets**
------------------

The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success.

* **Proactive Leadership** — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same.
* **Straight Talk** — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same.
* **United Impact** — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You align with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders on shared priorities and build the forums that make design quality a company-wide responsibility, not just the design team's.
* **Elevated Talent** — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You spend real time developing designers and design managers, set a clear bar for craft and leadership, and know and actively grow the top talent across your organization.
* **Customer-Compelled** — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You bring research and customer insight into strategic planning, and work across teams to find and remove root-cause friction in the product before customers feel it.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

**Why Menlo?**

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: **Proactive Leadership**, **Straight Talk**, **United Impact**, **Elevated Talent**, and **Customer-Compelled**. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

**Description**

The Associate Editorial Director with GSW is responsible for managing editorial workflow within assigned teams and serving as an editorial point of contact for client management, medical, creative, and other cross-functional partners. This person can manage editors and helps facilitate cross-office staffing as needs arise. In addition, the Associate Editorial Director maintains assigned brand responsibilities, editing, and fact-checking print and digital materials across clients' various disease areas of focus. The Associate Editorial Director is proficient in editorial processes and the pharmaceutical advertising communications industry and independently handles a wide range of client projects.

Reporting to the VP, Editorial Director, the Associate Editorial Director supports the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of editorial processes and standards that ensure high-quality output for our clients. This role can include direct people-management responsibilities but ensuring editors have the support, resources, and guidance needed to succeed.

The Associate Editorial Director understands the broader goals of the department and organization, supports leadership objectives, contributes to a positive department culture, and takes a solutions-oriented approach to challenges. In this leadership position, the Associate Editorial Director serves as a role model and mentor, helping team members achieve department goals while supporting their professional growth.

**Key Job Responsibilities**
  
Duties may include, but are not limited to, all or some of the following:

Leadership and People Management

* Support the day-to-day management of the Editorial department and serve as a primary editorial leadership contact for assigned teams or offices.
* Provide day-to-day leadership and management for assigned direct reports (if people managing), including resource management, conflict resolution, communication of processes and expectations, performance evaluations, professional development plans, and MBO plans.
* Work to ensure editorial systems, processes, and standards are followed and issues are escalated appropriately.
* Train and onboard new Editorial hires and familiarize them with department processes, standards, tools, and ways of working.
* Train and foster the development of newer editors while coaching experienced staff and providing ongoing feedback and guidance.
* Plan and lead editorial team meetings as appropriate.
* Foster a positive, collaborative department culture and serve as a role model for editorial standards and professional expectations.

Workflow, Resourcing, and Operations

* Proactively assess workload, capacity, deadlines, and potential bottlenecks among editors they support.
* Develop coverage solutions and coordinate cross-office support as needed, escalating broader staffing and resource needs to the Editorial Director.
* Help manage editorial workflow and priorities to support appropriate coverage and timely delivery of work.
* Resolve day-to-day editorial staffing, workflow, and process issues within assigned areas, identifying solutions and escalating issues requiring broader department direction or support.
* Provide regular updates to the Editorial Director regarding workload, staffing needs, project risks, process concerns, and other issues requiring broader departmental oversight.
* Maintain and enforce established editorial best practices and process standards within assigned teams and accounts, escalating broader process issues and opportunities to the Editorial Director.
* Identify opportunities to improve editorial workflows and processes and partner with Editorial leadership on solutions and implementation.

Editorial and Brand Responsibilities

* Maintain assigned brand-editor responsibilities while balancing people-management (if managing), operational, and department leadership responsibilities.
* Supervise the editorial process across assigned accounts and teams, ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, and consistency.
* Perform various levels of editing, proofreading, and fact-checking on print and digital materials.
* Edit with a demonstrated understanding of pharmaceutical and medical content, including recognition of drug trade and generic names and identification of potential reference or claims issues.
* Edit to enhance clarity, readability, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to brand and editorial standards without significantly altering intended meaning.
* Check the accuracy and consistency of information and supporting references.
* Produce accurate, high-quality work while managing competing priorities and tight deadlines.
* Stay current on relevant medical communications and editorial best practices.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Problem-Solving

* Work closely with account managers, medical, writers, designers, creative teams, project managers, and other partners to support cohesive and efficient development and review of client work.
* Serve as an editorial resource to cross-functional teams, helping clarify editorial processes, requirements, and expectations.
* Anticipate and identify roadblocks that may affect quality, timing, resources, or deadlines and develop practical solutions.
* Independently address routine brand- and team-level challenges while recognizing when issues require escalation or broader leadership involvement.

**Job Qualifications**

Skills

* High level of familiarity and comfort with AMA style and knowledge of FDA requirements relevant to pharmaceutical advertising and promotional communications.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong people-management and coaching skills, including the ability to guide editors with varying levels of experience.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and people simultaneously with a high degree of organization, initiative, and efficiency.
* Strong judgment and the ability to prioritize competing demands and identify when an issue should be resolved independently versus escalated.
* Ability to motivate and support people through change and evolving roles or processes.
* Solutions-oriented approach to challenges involving quality, timing, resources, workflow, and deadlines.
* Self-starter who can identify unmet needs, raise issues proactively, and recommend practical solutions.
* Ability to work effectively with minimal direction and adapt to shifting priorities, assignments, and business needs.
* Strong commitment to editorial quality, consistency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

* Candidates must be able to work PST hours
* Bachelor's degree in Journalism, English, Communications, Advertising, or a related field.
* Minimum of 7 years of editorial experience, including experience in healthcare communications.
* Firm grasp of AMA style and FDA guidelines applicable to pharmaceutical communications, including fair balance and claims referencing.
* Proven track record of producing high-quality editorial work and managing editorial processes.
* Strong people-management, coaching, and staff-development skills.
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and fact-checking skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational and project-management abilities.
* Proficiency with relevant editorial tools and content-management systems.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage tight or competing deadlines.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $100,000 to $125,000. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

At GSW, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

GSW is a full-service healthcare communications agency that goes beyond advertising to create personalized brand experiences that involve, inspire, educate and activate people through ongoing brand journeys. As one of the world's ten most-awarded healthcare advertising agencies, GSW is hell-bent not to replace the same old with the same old. This is achieved through a provocative premise — if other brands communicated the way healthcare brands do, how many customers would they have? GSW turns against this premise through discovery of beneath-the-surface customer insights that we impact with stories, simplicity and authenticity.
